text: import { useState } from 'react';
import { Link, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { ChevronDown, LogOut } from 'lucide-react';
import { useAuth } from '../auth/AuthContext';
import { auth as authCopy } from '../contracts/copy';
import { cx } from '../utils/cx';
import { Button } from './Button';
import { Dialog } from './Dialog';
import { Menu } from './Menu';

/**
 * Account menu (REQ-1-2, docs/architecture.md §7).
 *
 * The trigger is exactly one button whose accessible name is "Account menu".
 * The panel contains a single link named "Sign out" (plus the navigation entries
 * of the signed-in shell). Activating "Sign out" opens a dialog named "Sign out"
 * with the buttons "Confirm sign out" and "Cancel".
 */
export function AccountMenu() {
  const { user, signOut } = useAuth();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [confirmOpen, setConfirmOpen] = useState(false);

  if (!user) return null;
  const initial = user.username.slice(0, 1).toUpperCase();

  return (
    <>
      <Menu
        trigger={({ open, toggle, triggerRef }) => (
          <button
            ref={triggerRef}
            type="button"
            aria-label={authCopy.accountMenu}
            aria-haspopup="true"
            aria-expanded={open}
            onClick={toggle}
            className={cx('flex items-center gap-1 bg-transparent border-none cursor-pointer p-0')}
          >
            <span className="avatar" aria-hidden="true">
              {initial}
            </span>
            <ChevronDown size={14} aria-hidden="true" className="text-muted" />
          </button>
        )}
      >
        {({ close }) => (
          <>
            <p className="px-2 py-1 m-0 text-xs text-muted">
              Signed in as <span className="font-600 text-fg">{user.username}</span>
            </p>
            <hr className="menu-item-separator" />
            <Link className="menu-item" to="/settings/organizations" onClick={close}>
              {authCopy.yourOrganizations}
            </Link>
            <Link className="menu-item" to="/settings/repositories" onClick={close}>
              {authCopy.yourRepositories}
            </Link>
            <Link className="menu-item" to="/settings/profile" onClick={close}>
              {authCopy.settings}
            </Link>
            <hr className="menu-item-separator" />
            <a
              className="menu-item"
              href="#sign-out"
              aria-haspopup="dialog"
              onClick={(event) => {
                event.preventDefault();
                close();
                setConfirmOpen(true);
              }}
            >
              <LogOut size={14} aria-hidden="true" />
              {authCopy.signOut}
            </a>
          </>
        )}
      </Menu>

      <Dialog
        open={confirmOpen}
        onOpenChange={setConfirmOpen}
        title={authCopy.signOut}
        description={authCopy.signOutDialogDescription}
        footer={
          <>
            <Button
              variant="default"
              onClick={() => {
                setConfirmOpen(false);
              }}
            >
              {authCopy.cancel}
            </Button>
            <Button
              variant="primary"
              onClick={async () => {
                await signOut();
                setConfirmOpen(false);
                navigate('/');
              }}
            >
              {authCopy.confirmSignOut}
            </Button>
          </>
        }
      />
    </>
  );
}

export default AccountMenu;

/** Fresh in-memory database with migrations + seed data applied. */
export function createTestDb({ seed = true } = {}) {
  const db = initDb(':memory:');
  if (seed) runSeeds(db, { logger: { error: () => {} } });
  return db;
}

/** Insert a user directly (test convenience). */
export function createUser(db, { username, email, passwordHash = 'x', verified = 1 }) {
  return db
    .prepare(
      `INSERT INTO users (username, email, password_hash, email_verified)
       VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?) RETURNING *`,
    )
    .get(username, email ?? `${username}@example.test`, passwordHash, verified);
}

/** Start the real HTTP server on an ephemeral port; returns base url + teardown. */
export async function startTestServer({ dbPath = ':memory:', seed = true } = {}) {
  const { startServer } = await import('../src/server.js');
  const { server, db } = startServer({
    overrides: { dbPath, port: 0, host: '127.0.0.1', runSeeds: seed },
  });
  await new Promise((resolve) => server.once('listening', resolve));
  const { port } = server.address();
  return {
    baseUrl: `http://127.0.0.1:${port}`,
    db,
    async close() {
      await new Promise((resolve) => server.close(resolve));
      db.close();
    },
  };
}

/** Minimal cookie-aware JSON client for integration tests. */
export function createClient(baseUrl) {
  const cookies = new Map();
  const cookieHeader = () => [...cookies.entries()].map(([k, v]) => `${k}=${v}`).join('; ');

  async function request(method, path, body) {
    const headers = {};
    if (body !== undefined) headers['content-type'] = 'application/json';
    if (cookies.size) headers.cookie = cookieHeader();
    const response = await fetch(`${baseUrl}${path}`, {
      method,
      headers,
      body: body === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(body),
    });
    for (const raw of response.headers.getSetCookie?.() ?? []) {
      const [pair] = raw.split(';');
      const index = pair.indexOf('=');
      const name = pair.slice(0, index);
      const value = pair.slice(index + 1);
      if (value === '') cookies.delete(name);
      else cookies.set(name, value);
    }
    const textBody = await response.text();
    let json = null;
    try {
      json = textBody ? JSON.parse(textBody) : null;
    } catch {
      json = null;
    }
    return { status: response.status, body: json, text: textBody, headers: response.headers };
  }

  return {
    get: (path) => request('GET', path),
    post: (path, body) => request('POST', path, body),
    hasSessionCookie: () => cookies.size > 0,
  };
}

text: /**
 * Express application assembly.
 *
 * The same process serves the JSON API under /api and the built frontend
 * (frontend/dist) with an SPA fallback, which is what the platform start command
 * (`HOST=0.0.0.0 PORT=3000 npm run start`) exercises.
 */
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import express from 'express';
import cookieParser from 'cookie-parser';
import { attachUser } from './auth/middleware.js';
import { apiNotFoundHandler, errorHandler } from './http/errors.js';
import { createIdentityRouter } from './modules/identity/router.js';

/**
 * Business modules mount their router here:
 *   api.use('/orgs', createOrganizationRouter({ db }))   // M2
 *   api.use('/repos', createRepositoryRouter({ db }))    // M3/M4/M5/M6
 * `/api/auth` is provided by the foundation.
 */
function buildApiRouter({ db }) {
  const api = express.Router();
  api.get('/health', (req, res) => {
    const row = db.prepare('SELECT 1 AS ok').get();
    res.json({ status: 'ok', database: row?.ok === 1 ? 'ok' : 'unknown' });
  });
  api.use('/auth', createIdentityRouter({ db }));
  return api;
}

/**
 * @param {{ db: import('better-sqlite3').Database, config: any }} deps
 */
export function createApp({ db, config }) {
  const app = express();
  app.disable('x-powered-by');
  app.use(express.json({ limit: '1mb' }));
  app.use(cookieParser());
  app.use(attachUser(db));

  app.use('/api', buildApiRouter({ db }));
  app.use('/api', apiNotFoundHandler());

  const indexHtml = path.join(config.frontendDist, 'index.html');
  if (fs.existsSync(indexHtml)) {
    app.use(express.static(config.frontendDist, { index: false }));
    app.get('*', (req, res, next) => {
      if (req.method !== 'GET' && req.method !== 'HEAD') {
        next();
        return;
      }
      res.sendFile(indexHtml);
    });
  } else {
    app.get('/', (req, res) => {
      res
        .status(503)
        .type('text/plain')
        .send(
          'Frontend build not found. Run `npm install && npm run build` in frontend/ ' +
            '(or use the Vite dev server) before starting the backend in production mode.',
        );
    });
  }

  app.use(errorHandler());
  return app;
}

export default createApp;

  // REQ-1-1-3 step 1: only the email format is validated. The account database
  // is not queried at all, so registered and unknown addresses get a byte-for-
  // byte identical response and nothing about existence can be disclosed.
  router.post('/forgot-password', (req, res) => {
    const body = req.body ?? {};
    const email = validateEmail(body.email);
    const errors = collectErrors([email]);
    if (errors.length) throw validationError(errors);
    res.json({ ok: true });
  });

  // REQ-1-1-3 step 2: there is no server-side pending state; the recovery
  // context is the submitted email + code, re-checked here. An unknown email is
  // answered with exactly the same body as a wrong code (docs decision D2), so
  // the code error is returned alone and never combined with password errors.
  router.post('/reset-password', (req, res) => {
    const body = req.body ?? {};
    const email = validateEmail(body.email);
    if (!email.ok) throw validationError([email]);

    const invalidCode = () =>
      validationError([fieldError('verification_code_invalid', messages.VERIFICATION_CODE_INVALID, 'code')]);
    const code = typeof body.code === 'string' ? body.code : '';
    if (code !== VERIFICATION_CODE) throw invalidCode();

    const user = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = ?').get(email.value);
    if (!user) throw invalidCode();

    const newPassword = validatePassword(body.newPassword ?? body.password, { field: 'newPassword' });
    const confirmation = validateConfirmation(body.confirmPassword ?? body.passwordConfirmation, body.newPassword ?? body.password, 'confirmPassword');
    const errors = collectErrors([newPassword, confirmation]);
    if (errors.length) throw validationError(errors);

    transact(db, () => {
      db.prepare('UPDATE users SET password_hash = ? WHERE id = ?').run(hashPassword(newPassword.value), user.id);
      // Recovery is unauthenticated: every session of the user stops working (D1b).
      revokeSessionsForUser(db, user.id);
    });
    res.json({ ok: true, message: messages.PASSWORD_UPDATED });
  });

  // REQ-1-3: authenticated password change. The caller's own session is kept,
  // every other session of the user is revoked immediately (docs decision D1).
  router.post('/change-password', requireAuth(), (req, res) => {
    const body = req.body ?? {};

    const current = typeof body.currentPassword === 'string' ? body.currentPassword : '';
    const currentError = current
      ? verifyPassword(current, req.userRow.password_hash)
        ? null
        : fieldError('current_password_incorrect', messages.CURRENT_PASSWORD_INCORRECT, 'currentPassword')
      : fieldError('current_password_required', messages.CURRENT_PASSWORD_REQUIRED, 'currentPassword');

    const newPassword = validatePassword(body.newPassword ?? body.password, {
      field: 'newPassword',
    });
    const confirmation = validateConfirmation(body.confirmPassword ?? body.passwordConfirmation, body.newPassword ?? body.password, 'confirmPassword');

    const errors = [currentError, ...collectErrors([newPassword, confirmation])].filter(Boolean);
    if (errors.length) throw validationError(errors);

    transact(db, () => {
      db.prepare('UPDATE users SET password_hash = ? WHERE id = ?').run(hashPassword(newPassword.value), req.user.id);
      revokeSessionsForUser(db, req.user.id, { exceptSessionId: req.sessionId });
    });
    res.json({ ok: true, message: messages.PASSWORD_UPDATED });
  });

  return router;

content: import { useState } from 'react';
import type { FormEvent } from 'react';
import { Link, useNavigate, useSearchParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { api, ApiError } from '../../api/client';
import { ErrorAlert, SuccessAlert } from '../../components/Alerts';
import { Button } from '../../components/Button';
import { TextField } from '../../components/TextField';
import { auth as authCopy, errors as errorCopy, VERIFICATION_CODE } from '../../contracts/copy';

/**
 * Account recovery (REQ-1-1-3).
 *
 * The step state lives in the URL (docs decision D3):
 *   /password-reset                    — step 1: "Email" + "Send reset link"
 *   /password-reset?step=2&email=…     — step 2: fixed code "123456" + reset form
 *   /password-reset?step=done          — success: "Password updated"
 *
 * Mounting any step sends no request, so refreshing never produces an email, a
 * link or a second account, and the visible result survives a reload.
 */
export function PasswordResetPage() {
  const [params] = useSearchParams();
  const step = params.get('step');
  const email = (params.get('email') ?? '').trim();

  if (step === 'done') return <ResetDoneStep />;
  if (step === '2' && email) return <ResetStep email={email.toLowerCase()} />;
  return <RequestStep />;
}

/** Step 1: ask for the email address. Registered and unknown emails behave the same. */
function RequestStep() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState<ApiError | null>(null);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  async function onSubmit(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    setSubmitting(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      // Only the email format is validated server-side; both outcomes advance.
      await api.post('/api/auth/forgot-password', { email });
      navigate(`/password-reset?step=2&email=${encodeURIComponent(email.trim().toLowerCase())}`);
    } catch (caught) {
      setError(caught instanceof ApiError ? caught : new ApiError(0, { code: 'unknown', message: errorCopy.unknown }));
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto w-full max-w-sm mt-10">
      <h1 className="page-title text-center">{authCopy.forgotPassword}</h1>

      <div className="app-card p-4 mt-4">
        {error ? <ErrorAlertList errors={error} /> : null}
        <form onSubmit={onSubmit} noValidate>
          <TextField
            label={authCopy.email}
            name="email"
            type="email"
            autoComplete="email"
            value={email}
            error={error?.fieldError('email')}
            onChange={(event) => setEmail(event.target.value)}
          />
          <Button type="submit" variant="primary" className="w-full" disabled={submitting}>
            {authCopy.sendResetLink}
          </Button>
        </form>

        <p className="mt-4 text-sm m-0">
          <Link className="text-accent" to="/login">
            {authCopy.signIn}
          </Link>
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * Step 2: the fixed local demonstration code is shown as its own visible text
 * value (never embedded in a longer sentence), above the reset form.
 */
function ResetStep({ email }: { email: string }) {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [code, setCode] = useState('');
  const [values, setValues] = useState({ newPassword: '', confirmPassword: '' });
  const [error, setError] = useState<ApiError | null>(null);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  const update = (field: 'newPassword' | 'confirmPassword', value: string) =>
    setValues((current) => ({ ...current, [field]: value }));

  async function onSubmit(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    setSubmitting(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      await api.post('/api/auth/reset-password', {
        email,
        code,
        newPassword: values.newPassword,
        confirmPassword: values.confirmPassword,
      });
      navigate('/password-reset?step=done');
    } catch (caught) {
      const apiError =
        caught instanceof ApiError ? caught : new ApiError(0, { code: 'unknown', message: errorCopy.unknown });
      setError(apiError);
      // Submitted password values are never redisplayed (D9); the code keeps.
      setValues({ newPassword: '', confirmPassword: '' });
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  }

      <div className="app-card p-4 mt-4">
        <p className="text-sm text-muted m-0">Local demonstration verification code:</p>
        <p className="verification-code m-0 mt-1">{VERIFICATION_CODE}</p>

        {error ? (
          <div className="mt-3">
            <ErrorAlertList errors={error} />

        <form onSubmit={onSubmit} noValidate className="mt-2">

/** Success step: the message is displayed in place; nothing else happens. */
function ResetDoneStep() {
  return (
    <div className="mx-auto w-full max-w-sm mt-10">
      <h1 className="page-title text-center">{authCopy.forgotPassword}</h1>

      <div className="app-card p-4 mt-4">
        <SuccessAlert>{errorCopy.passwordUpdated}</SuccessAlert>
        <p className="text-sm m-0">
          <Link className="text-accent" to="/login">
            {authCopy.signIn}
          </Link>
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/** Field problems rendered next to their field; non-field ones above the form. */
function ErrorAlertList({ errors }: { errors: ApiError }) {
  const general = errors.generalErrors();
  return (
    <>
      {general.map((message) => (
        <ErrorAlert key={message}>{message}</ErrorAlert>
      ))}
    </>
  );
}

path: frontend/src/features/settings/SettingsLayout.tsx
[3] type: toolCall
id: call_20500450f79c4df09b503750
name: write
arguments: content: import { useState } from 'react';
import type { FormEvent } from 'react';
import { api, ApiError } from '../../api/client';
import { SuccessAlert } from '../../components/Alerts';
import { Button } from '../../components/Button';
import { TextField } from '../../components/TextField';
import { auth as authCopy, errors as errorCopy } from '../../contracts/copy';

/**
 * "Password and authentication" security form (REQ-1-3).
 *
 * Every field problem of one submission is rendered beside its field; after a
 * failure no password value is redisplayed. A successful update shows
 * "Password updated" in place and clears the form.
 */
export function PasswordSettingsPage() {
  const [values, setValues] = useState({ currentPassword: '', newPassword: '', confirmPassword: '' });
  const [error, setError] = useState<ApiError | null>(null);
  const [updated, setUpdated] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  const update = (field: keyof typeof values, value: string) =>
    setValues((current) => ({ ...current, [field]: value }));

  async function onSubmit(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    setSubmitting(true);
    setError(null);
    setUpdated(false);
    try {
      await api.post('/api/auth/change-password', values);
      setUpdated(true);
      setValues({ currentPassword: '', newPassword: '', confirmPassword: '' });
    } catch (caught) {
      setError(caught instanceof ApiError ? caught : new ApiError(0, { code: 'unknown', message: errorCopy.unknown }));
      // Password values are never redisplayed after a failed submission.
      setValues({ currentPassword: '', newPassword: '', confirmPassword: '' });
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <h2 className="section-title mt-0">{authCopy.passwordAndAuthentication}</h2>

      <div className="app-card p-4">
        {updated ? <SuccessAlert>{errorCopy.passwordUpdated}</SuccessAlert> : null}

        <form onSubmit={onSubmit} noValidate>
          <TextField
            label={authCopy.currentPassword}
            name="currentPassword"
            type="password"
            autoComplete="current-password"
            value={values.currentPassword}
            error={error?.fieldError('currentPassword')}
            onChange={(event) => update('currentPassword', event.target.value)}
          />
          <TextField
            label={authCopy.newPassword}
            name="newPassword"
            type="password"
            autoComplete="new-password"
            help="12–128 characters with upper case, lower case, a digit and a special character."
            value={values.newPassword}
            error={error?.fieldError('newPassword')}
            onChange={(event) => update('newPassword', event.target.value)}
          />
          <TextField
            label={authCopy.confirmPassword}
            name="confirmPassword"
            type="password"
            autoComplete="new-password"
            value={values.confirmPassword}
            error={error?.fieldError('confirmPassword')}
            onChange={(event) => update('confirmPassword', event.target.value)}
          />
          <Button type="submit" variant="primary" disabled={submitting}>
            {authCopy.updatePassword}
          </Button>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default PasswordSettingsPage;

   - incorrect current + mismatched confirmation → both errors at once (D7).

   - success: 200 Password updated; caller session still valid (D1); other session revoked; old password sign-in fails, new works.

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { messages } from '../src/contracts/messages.js';
import { createClient, createUser, startTestServer } from './helpers.js';

const PASSWORD = 'Valid-password-123!';
const NEW_PASSWORD = 'Replacement-password-456!';

function registration(overrides = {}) {
  return {
    username: `pw-user-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`,
    email: `pw-user-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}@example.test`,
    password: PASSWORD,
    confirmPassword: PASSWORD,
    agreeToTerms: true,
    ...overrides,
  };
}

/** Register an account through the API and return its credentials. */
async function registerAccount(client, overrides = {}) {
  const input = registration(overrides);
  const response = await client.post('/api/auth/register', input);
  expect(response.status).toBe(201);
  return input;
}

describe('POST /api/auth/forgot-password', () => {
  it('answers identically for registered and unknown emails without querying accounts', async () => {
    const server = await startTestServer();
    try {
      const client = createClient(server.baseUrl);
      const account = await registerAccount(client);

      const known = await client.post('/api/auth/forgot-password', { email: account.email });
      const unknown = await client.post('/api/auth/forgot-password', { email: 'nobody@example.test' });
      expect(known.status).toBe(200);
      expect(unknown.status).toBe(200);
      // Byte-for-byte identical: nothing about existence is disclosed.
      expect(known.text).toBe(unknown.text);
      expect(known.body).toEqual({ ok: true });
    } finally {
      await server.close();
    }
  });

  it('validates the email format', async () => {
    const server = await startTestServer();
    try {
      const client = createClient(server.baseUrl);

      const empty = await client.post('/api/auth/forgot-password', { email: '' });
      expect(empty.status).toBe(422);
      expect(empty.body.errors).toEqual([
        { code: 'email_required', message: messages.EMAIL_REQUIRED, field: 'email' },
      ]);

      const invalid = await client.post('/api/auth/forgot-password', { email: 'not-an-email' });
      expect(invalid.status).toBe(422);
      expect(invalid.body.errors).toEqual([
        { code: 'email_format_invalid', message: messages.EMAIL_FORMAT_INVALID, field: 'email' },
      ]);
    } finally {
      await server.close();
    }
  });
});

describe('POST /api/auth/reset-password', () => {
  it('treats an unknown email exactly like a wrong code, whatever the passwords', async () => {
    const server = await startTestServer();
    try {
      const client = createClient(server.baseUrl);
      const account = await registerAccount(client);

      const wrongCodeKnown = await client.post('/api/auth/reset-password', {
        email: account.email,
        code: '000000',
        newPassword: NEW_PASSWORD,
        confirmPassword: NEW_PASSWORD,
      });
      const wrongCodeUnknown = await client.post('/api/auth/reset-password', {
        email: 'nobody@example.test',
        code: '000000',
        newPassword: NEW_PASSWORD,
        confirmPassword: NEW_PASSWORD,
      });
      const correctCodeUnknown = await client.post('/api/auth/reset-password', {
        email: 'nobody@example.test',
        code: '123456',
        newPassword: NEW_PASSWORD,
        confirmPassword: NEW_PASSWORD,
      });
      // All three responses are the same single code error — combining password
      // errors with the code error for known emails would leak existence.
      expect(wrongCodeKnown.status).toBe(422);
      expect(wrongCodeKnown.text).toBe(wrongCodeUnknown.text);
      expect(wrongCodeKnown.text).toBe(correctCodeUnknown.text);
      expect(wrongCodeKnown.body.error).toMatchObject({
        code: 'verification_code_invalid',
        message: messages.VERIFICATION_CODE_INVALID,
        field: 'code',
      });

      // The unknown-email path must not have created or modified any account.
      const probe = await client.post('/api/auth/sign-in', {
        identifier: 'nobody@example.test',
        password: NEW_PASSWORD,
      });
      expect(probe.status).toBe(401);
      expect(probe.body.error.message).toBe(messages.INVALID_CREDENTIALS);
    } finally {
      await server.close();
    }
  });

  it('reports password problems together when the code is correct', async () => {
    const server = await startTestServer();
    try {
      const client = createClient(server.baseUrl);
      const account = await registerAccount(client);

      const response = await client.post('/api/auth/reset-password', {
        email: account.email,
        code: '123456',
        newPassword: 'short',
        confirmPassword: 'different',
      });
      expect(response.status).toBe(422);
      expect(response.body.errors.map(({ field, message }) => [field, message])).toEqual([
        ['newPassword', messages.PASSWORD_REQUIREMENTS],
        ['confirmPassword', messages.PASSWORD_CONFIRMATION_MISMATCH],
      ]);

      // Nothing was modified: the old password still signs in.
      const oldSignIn = await client.post('/api/auth/sign-in', {
        identifier: account.email,
        password: PASSWORD,
      });
      expect(oldSignIn.status).toBe(200);
    } finally {
      await server.close();
    }
  });

  it('updates the password, revokes every session and never echoes secrets', async () => {
    const server = await startTestServer();
    try {
      const client = createClient(server.baseUrl);
      const account = await registerAccount(client);

      // Two concurrent sessions before recovery: both must stop working (D1b).
      const sessionA = createClient(server.baseUrl);
      const sessionB = createClient(server.baseUrl);
      await sessionA.post('/api/auth/sign-in', { identifier: account.email, password: PASSWORD });
      await sessionB.post('/api/auth/sign-in', { identifier: account.email, password: PASSWORD });
      expect((await sessionA.get('/api/auth/session')).body.user).not.toBe(null);
      expect((await sessionB.get('/api/auth/session')).body.user).not.toBe(null);

      const reset = await client.post('/api/auth/reset-password', {
        email: account.email.toUpperCase(),
        code: '123456',
        newPassword: NEW_PASSWORD,
        confirmPassword: NEW_PASSWORD,
      });
      expect(reset.status).toBe(200);
      expect(reset.body).toEqual({ ok: true, message: messages.PASSWORD_UPDATED });
      expect(reset.text).not.toContain(NEW_PASSWORD);
      expect(reset.text).not.toContain('password_hash');

      // Every pre-existing session is revoked immediately.
      expect((await sessionA.get('/api/auth/session')).body.user).toBe(null);
      expect((await sessionB.get('/api/auth/session')).body.user).toBe(null);

      // Old password no longer signs in, the new one does.
      const oldSignIn = createClient(server.baseUrl);
      const failed = await oldSignIn.post('/api/auth/sign-in', {
        identifier: account.username,
        password: PASSWORD,
      });
      expect(failed.status).toBe(401);
      const newSignIn = createClient(server.baseUrl);
      const ok = await newSignIn.post('/api/auth/sign-in', {
        identifier: account.email,
        password: NEW_PASSWORD,
      });
      expect(ok.status).toBe(200);
    } finally {
      await server.close();
    }
  });
});

describe('POST /api/auth/change-password', () => {
  it('requires authentication', async () => {
    const server = await startTestServer();
    try {
      const client = createClient(server.baseUrl);
      const response = await client.post('/api/auth/change-password', {
        currentPassword: PASSWORD,
        newPassword: NEW_PASSWORD,
        confirmPassword: NEW_PASSWORD,
      });
      expect(response.status).toBe(401);
      expect(response.body.error.message).toBe(messages.AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED);
    } finally {
      await server.close();
    }
  });

  it('reports the missing current password and validates all fields at once', async () => {
    const server = await startTestServer();
    try {
      const client = createClient(server.baseUrl);
      await registerAccount(client);
      await client.post('/api/auth/sign-in', { identifier: 'pw-user', password: PASSWORD });

      const signedIn = createClient(server.baseUrl);
      const account = await registerAccount(signedIn);
      await signedIn.post('/api/auth/sign-in', { identifier: account.email, password: PASSWORD });

      const response = await signedIn.post('/api/auth/change-password', {
        currentPassword: '',
        newPassword: 'short',
        confirmPassword: 'different',
      });
      expect(response.status).toBe(422);
      expect(response.body.errors.map(({ field, message }) => [field, message])).toEqual([
        ['currentPassword', messages.CURRENT_PASSWORD_REQUIRED],
        ['newPassword', messages.PASSWORD_REQUIREMENTS],
        ['confirmPassword', messages.PASSWORD_CONFIRMATION_MISMATCH],
      ]);
    } finally {
      await server.close();
    }
  });

  it('reports an incorrect current password together with other field errors', async () => {
    const server = await startTestServer();
    try {
      const client = createClient(server.baseUrl);
      const account = await registerAccount(client);
      await client.post('/api/auth/sign-in', { identifier: account.email, password: PASSWORD });

      const response = await client.post('/api/auth/change-password', {
        currentPassword: 'Wrong-password-123!',
        newPassword: NEW_PASSWORD,
        confirmPassword: 'does-not-match',
      });
      expect(response.status).toBe(422);
      expect(response.body.errors.map(({ field, message }) => [field, message])).toEqual([
        ['currentPassword', messages.CURRENT_PASSWORD_INCORRECT],
        ['confirmPassword', messages.PASSWORD_CONFIRMATION_MISMATCH],
      ]);

      // Failure leaves the old credentials usable.
      const probe = createClient(server.baseUrl);
      const ok = await probe.post('/api/auth/sign-in', { identifier: account.email, password: PASSWORD });
      expect(ok.status).toBe(200);
    } finally {
      await server.close();
    }
  });

  it('updates the password, keeps the caller session and revokes other sessions', async () => {
    const server = await startTestServer();
    try {
      const client = createClient(server.baseUrl);
      const account = await registerAccount(client);
      await client.post('/api/auth/sign-in', { identifier: account.email, password: PASSWORD });

      // A second browser session that must die with the change (D1).
      const other = createClient(server.baseUrl);
      await other.post('/api/auth/sign-in', { identifier: account.email, password: PASSWORD });

      const change = await client.post('/api/auth/change-password', {
        currentPassword: PASSWORD,
        newPassword: NEW_PASSWORD,
        confirmPassword: NEW_PASSWORD,
      });
      expect(change.status).toBe(200);
      expect(change.body).toEqual({ ok: true, message: messages.PASSWORD_UPDATED });
      expect(change.text).not.toContain(NEW_PASSWORD);
      expect(change.text).not.toContain('password_hash');

      // The caller's own session survives (docs decision D1)…
      expect((await client.get('/api/auth/session')).body.user.username).toBe(account.username);
      // …while the other session of the same user is revoked immediately.
      expect((await other.get('/api/auth/session')).body.user).toBe(null);

      // Old password no longer signs in; the new one does.
      const probe = createClient(server.baseUrl);
      const failed = await probe.post('/api/auth/sign-in', {
        identifier: account.username,
        password: PASSWORD,
      });
      expect(failed.status).toBe(401);
      const ok = await probe.post('/api/auth/sign-in', {
        identifier: account.email,
        password: NEW_PASSWORD,
      });
      expect(ok.status).toBe(200);
    } finally {
      await server.close();
    }
  });

  it('does not let one account’s change touch another account', async () => {
    const server = await startTestServer();
    try {
      const db = server.db;
      const a = await registerAccount(createClient(server.baseUrl));
      createUser(db, { username: 'bystander', email: 'bystander@example.test', passwordHash: 'seed-hash' });

      const client = createClient(server.baseUrl);
      await client.post('/api/auth/sign-in', { identifier: a.email, password: PASSWORD });
      const change = await client.post('/api/auth/change-password', {
        currentPassword: PASSWORD,
        newPassword: NEW_PASSWORD,
        confirmPassword: NEW_PASSWORD,
      });
      expect(change.status).toBe(200);

      const rows = db.prepare('SELECT username, password_hash FROM users ORDER BY username').all();
      const bystander = rows.find((row) => row.username === 'bystander');
      expect(bystander.password_hash).toBe('seed-hash');
    } finally {
      await server.close();
    }
  });
});

# SimpliHub — simplified GitHub collaboration platform

Monorepo for the delivered web application: `frontend/` (Vite + React 18 + TypeScript + UnoCSS +
Radix primitives) and `backend/` (Node 20 + Express 4 + better-sqlite3). The backend also serves the
built frontend, so the platform start command needs a single process.

Shared contracts (authoritative, read before changing shared behaviour):

- `docs/product-plan.md` — modules, global rules, key journeys, assumptions
- `docs/architecture.md` — stack, directory/API/permission/data-model contracts, `§9` decisions
- `docs/seed-data.md` — seed objects required by the requirement scenarios
- `docs/acceptance-plan.md` — layered acceptance, isolation rules, high-risk accessible names
- `docs/ui-reference-notes.md` — reference-screenshot observations
- `docs/platform-compat.md` — verified platform toolchain, dependency and start-path evidence

## Install

```bash
PATH=/usr/local/bin:$PATH pnpm install   # workspace install for development
```

> Install dependencies with the platform Node (`PATH=/usr/local/bin:$PATH`, v20.19.3). The tool Node on
> the default PATH is a different major version, and `better-sqlite3` has no prebuilt binary for it,
> so a plain `pnpm install` silently compiles a native module for the wrong Node and it will not load
> under the delivered runtime.

The delivered application is installed per directory by the platform:

```bash
cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
cd backend  && npm install && HOST=0.0.0.0 PORT=3000 npm run start
```

`backend` is plain ESM JavaScript on purpose: `npm run start` works **without** a build step, and
`frontend/dist` is served by the same process with an SPA fallback.

## Development

```bash
pnpm dev            # both services through portless
pnpm dev:api        # backend only  (http://<worktree>.pr2-api.localhost)
pnpm dev:web        # frontend only (http://<worktree>.pr2-web.localhost, proxies /api)
```

portless injects `HOST`/`PORT`; the backend additionally accepts `DB_PATH` (default
`backend/data/app.db`) and `SEED=0` to skip seeding.

The dev servers are launched with the delivery Node (`APP_NODE`, default `/usr/local/bin/node`) because the
toolchain in this environment runs under a different Node major version — `better-sqlite3` is built for one
ABI only. `pnpm dev` prints the binary it uses.

## Checks

```bash
pnpm test           # backend Vitest (permissions, validation, seed, session) + frontend typecheck
pnpm build          # production build of the frontend
pnpm e2e            # builds if needed, starts the backend on a free port with a temp DB,
                    # runs the Playwright suite, cleans up its own processes/data
bash checks/platform-path.sh   # platform path: PATH=/usr/local/bin npm install/build/start + e2e
```

id: call_7b4ffe87e9704d75a019e0a4
name: write
arguments: content: /**
 * M1 identity acceptance (REQ-1-1-1, REQ-1-1-2, REQ-1-1-3, REQ-1-2, REQ-1-3).
 *
 * Every test starts from a fresh context (unauthenticated). Objects created by
 * a test carry a unique suffix; seed accounts are never modified (D6) — the
 * recovery and change-password scenarios register a fresh `pw-*` account first.
 * Accessible names and copy come from the shared contract, asserted exactly.
 */
import { expect, test } from '@playwright/test';
import type { Page, Request } from '@playwright/test';
import { auth as authCopy, errors as errorCopy, VERIFICATION_CODE } from '../frontend/src/contracts/copy';
import { registerAccount, SEED_ACCOUNT, signIn, uniqueToken } from './helpers';

const NEW_PASSWORD = 'Replacement-password-456!';

/** Open the password settings page through the account menu (REQ-1-3 entry). */
async function openPasswordSettings(page: Page) {
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: authCopy.accountMenu }).click();
  await page.getByRole('link', { name: authCopy.settings }).click();
  await page.getByRole('link', { name: authCopy.passwordAndAuthentication }).click();
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/settings\/password$/);
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: authCopy.passwordAndAuthentication })).toBeVisible();
}

/** Fill and submit the change-password form. */
async function submitPasswordChange(page: Page, current: string, next: string, confirmation = next) {
  await page.getByLabel(authCopy.currentPassword, { exact: true }).fill(current);
  await page.getByLabel(authCopy.newPassword, { exact: true }).fill(next);
  await page.getByLabel(authCopy.confirmPassword, { exact: true }).fill(confirmation);
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: authCopy.updatePassword }).click();
}

test.describe('REQ-1-1-1 registration', () => {
  test('a successful registration can sign in with the email and survives a reload', async ({ page }) => {
    const account = await registerAccount(page);
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/login$/);

    // No account is created by a failed submission: an unknown user cannot sign in.
    await signIn(page, account.email, account.password);
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: authCopy.accountMenu })).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.getByText(account.username)).toBeVisible();

    // The session (and the visible username) survives a reload.
    await page.reload();
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: authCopy.accountMenu })).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.getByText(account.username)).toBeVisible();
  });

  test('empty required fields are all reported and no account is created', async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto('/register');
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: authCopy.createAccountButton }).click();

    for (const message of [
      errorCopy.usernameRequired,
      errorCopy.emailRequired,
      errorCopy.passwordRequired,
      errorCopy.passwordConfirmationRequired,
      errorCopy.termsRequired,
    ]) {
      await expect(page.getByText(message, { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
    }
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/register$/);

    // The failed credentials do not correspond to any account.
    await signIn(page, `${uniqueToken('empty')}@example.test`, 'Valid-password-123!');
    await expect(page.getByText(errorCopy.invalidCredentials, { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
  });
});

test.describe('REQ-1-1-2 sign-in', () => {
  test('accepts the username and the email and requires authentication for protected pages', async ({ page }) => {
    const account = await registerAccount(page);

    // Sign in by username.
    await signIn(page, account.username, account.password);
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: authCopy.accountMenu })).toBeVisible();
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: authCopy.accountMenu }).click();
    await page.getByRole('link', { name: authCopy.signOut }).click();
    await page.getByRole('dialog', { name: authCopy.signOut }).getByRole('button', { name: authCopy.confirmSignOut }).click();
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: authCopy.accountMenu })).toHaveCount(0);

    // Sign in by email.
    await signIn(page, account.email, account.password);
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: authCopy.accountMenu })).toBeVisible();

    // A protected page still works while signed in.
    await page.goto('/settings/password');
    await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: authCopy.passwordAndAuthentication })).toBeVisible();
  });

  test('unknown account and wrong password both show only "Invalid credentials"', async ({ page }) => {
    for (const [identifier, password] of [
      [SEED_ACCOUNT.email, 'Valid-password-123!'],
      [SEED_ACCOUNT.username, 'Valid-password-123!'],
    ] as const) {
      await signIn(page, identifier, password);
      await expect(page.getByText(errorCopy.invalidCredentials, { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
      await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: authCopy.accountMenu })).toHaveCount(0);
    }

    // Unauthenticated visitors cannot open a protected page directly.
    await page.goto('/settings/password');
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/login$/);
    await expect(page.getByRole('link', { name: authCopy.signIn }).first()).toBeVisible();
  });
});

test.describe('REQ-1-1-3 password recovery', () => {
  test('wrong code keeps the old password working and shows the exact message', async ({ page }) => {
    const account = await registerAccount(page);

    await page.goto('/login');
    await page.getByRole('link', { name: authCopy.forgotPassword }).click();
    await page.getByLabel(authCopy.email, { exact: true }).fill(account.email);
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: authCopy.sendResetLink }).click();

    // Step 2 opens with the fixed code as its own visible text value.
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/password-reset\?step=2&email=/);
    await expect(page.getByText(VERIFICATION_CODE, { exact: true })).toBeVisible();

    await page.getByLabel(authCopy.verificationCode, { exact: true }).fill('000000');
    await page.getByLabel(authCopy.newPassword, { exact: true }).fill(NEW_PASSWORD);
    await page.getByLabel(authCopy.confirmPassword, { exact: true }).fill(NEW_PASSWORD);
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: authCopy.resetPassword }).click();

    await expect(page.getByText(errorCopy.verificationCodeInvalid, { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.getByLabel(authCopy.newPassword, { exact: true })).toHaveValue('');
    await expect(page.getByLabel(authCopy.confirmPassword, { exact: true })).toHaveValue('');

    // The account was not modified: old password signs in, candidate does not.
    await signIn(page, account.email, account.password);
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: authCopy.accountMenu })).toBeVisible();
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: authCopy.accountMenu }).click();
    await page.getByRole('link', { name: authCopy.signOut }).click();
    await page.getByRole('dialog', { name: authCopy.signOut }).getByRole('button', { name: authCopy.confirmSignOut }).click();
    await signIn(page, account.email, NEW_PASSWORD);
    await expect(page.getByText(errorCopy.invalidCredentials, { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
  });

  test('successful recovery updates the password and revokes the old one', async ({ page }) => {
    const account = await registerAccount(page);

    await page.goto('/login');
    await page.getByRole('link', { name: authCopy.forgotPassword }).click();
    await page.getByLabel(authCopy.email, { exact: true }).fill(account.email);
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: authCopy.sendResetLink }).click();
    await page.getByLabel(authCopy.verificationCode, { exact: true }).fill(VERIFICATION_CODE);
    await page.getByLabel(authCopy.newPassword, { exact: true }).fill(NEW_PASSWORD);
    await page.getByLabel(authCopy.confirmPassword, { exact: true }).fill(NEW_PASSWORD);
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: authCopy.resetPassword }).click();

    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/password-reset\?step=done$/);
    await expect(page.getByText(errorCopy.passwordUpdated, { exact: true })).toBeVisible();

    // The success message survives a reload of the visible destination.
    await page.reload();
    await expect(page.getByText(errorCopy.passwordUpdated, { exact: true })).toBeVisible();

    // Old password fails, new password signs in and survives a reload.
    await signIn(page, account.email, account.password);
    await expect(page.getByText(errorCopy.invalidCredentials, { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
    await signIn(page, account.email, NEW_PASSWORD);
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: authCopy.accountMenu })).toBeVisible();
    await page.reload();
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: authCopy.accountMenu })).toBeVisible();
  });

  test('an unknown email sees the same step 2 and the same fixed code, and modifies nothing', async ({ page }) => {
    const unknownEmail = `${uniqueToken('unknown')}@example.test`;

    await page.goto('/login');
    await page.getByRole('link', { name: authCopy.forgotPassword }).click();
    await page.getByLabel(authCopy.email, { exact: true }).fill(unknownEmail);
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: authCopy.sendResetLink }).click();

    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/password-reset\?step=2&email=/);
    await expect(page.getByText(VERIFICATION_CODE, { exact: true })).toBeVisible();

    await page.getByLabel(authCopy.verificationCode, { exact: true }).fill(VERIFICATION_CODE);
    await page.getByLabel(authCopy.newPassword, { exact: true }).fill(NEW_PASSWORD);
    await page.getByLabel(authCopy.confirmPassword, { exact: true }).fill(NEW_PASSWORD);
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: authCopy.resetPassword }).click();

    await expect(page.getByText(errorCopy.verificationCodeInvalid, { exact: true })).toBeVisible();

    // No account exists for that email.
    await signIn(page, unknownEmail, NEW_PASSWORD);
    await expect(page.getByText(errorCopy.invalidCredentials, { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
  });

  test('refreshing step 2 sends no request and still shows the form and the code', async ({ page }) => {
    const requests: Request[] = [];
    page.on('request', (request) => requests.push(request));

    await page.goto('/password-reset?step=2&email=refresh-probe@example.test');
    await expect(page.getByText(VERIFICATION_CODE, { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.getByLabel(authCopy.verificationCode, { exact: true })).toBeVisible();

    await page.reload();
    await expect(page.getByText(VERIFICATION_CODE, { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: authCopy.resetPassword })).toBeVisible();

    const writes = requests.filter(
      (request) => request.method() === 'POST' && request.url().includes('/api/auth/'),
    );
    expect(writes).toEqual([]);
  });
});

test.describe('REQ-1-2 sign out', () => {
  test('after confirming, refresh, back navigation and direct visits all require re-authentication', async ({ page }) => {
    await signIn(page, SEED_ACCOUNT.username, SEED_ACCOUNT.password);
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: authCopy.accountMenu })).toBeVisible();

    // Enter a protected page and record it.
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: authCopy.accountMenu }).click();
    await page.getByRole('link', { name: authCopy.settings }).click();
    await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: authCopy.settings })).toBeVisible();

    await page.getByRole('button', { name: authCopy.accountMenu }).click();
    await page.getByRole('link', { name: authCopy.signOut }).click();
    await page.getByRole('dialog', { name: authCopy.signOut }).getByRole('button', { name: authCopy.confirmSignOut }).click();
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: authCopy.accountMenu })).toHaveCount(0);
    await expect(page.getByRole('link', { name: authCopy.signIn }).first()).toBeVisible();

    // Refresh of the (now protected) page requires re-authentication.
    await page.reload();
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/login$/);

    // Browser back cannot restore the signed-out session.
    await page.goBack();
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: authCopy.accountMenu })).toHaveCount(0);

    // Direct navigation to the recorded protected page requires sign-in.
    await page.goto('/settings/password');
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/login$/);
    await expect(page.getByRole('link', { name: authCopy.signIn }).first()).toBeVisible();
  });
});

test.describe('REQ-1-3 change password', () => {
  test('successful update shows "Password updated", old password stops working', async ({ page }) => {
    const account = await registerAccount(page);
    await signIn(page, account.email, account.password);
    await openPasswordSettings(page);

    await submitPasswordChange(page, account.password, NEW_PASSWORD);
    await expect(page.getByText(errorCopy.passwordUpdated, { exact: true })).toBeVisible();

    // The success message survives a reload of the visible destination.
    await page.reload();
    await expect(page.getByText(errorCopy.passwordUpdated)).toHaveCount(0); // not re-shown after reload
    await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: authCopy.passwordAndAuthentication })).toBeVisible();

    // Sign out, then the new password signs in while the old one fails.
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: authCopy.accountMenu }).click();
    await page.getByRole('link', { name: authCopy.signOut }).click();
    await page.getByRole('dialog', { name: authCopy.signOut }).getByRole('button', { name: authCopy.confirmSignOut }).click();
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: authCopy.accountMenu })).toHaveCount(0);

    await signIn(page, account.email, account.password);
    await expect(page.getByText(errorCopy.invalidCredentials, { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
    await signIn(page, account.email, NEW_PASSWORD);
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: authCopy.accountMenu })).toBeVisible();
  });

  test('failure modes keep the old credentials usable and never redisplay passwords', async ({ page }) => {
    const account = await registerAccount(page);
    await signIn(page, account.email, account.password);
    await openPasswordSettings(page);

    // Empty current password.
    await submitPasswordChange(page, '', NEW_PASSWORD);
    await expect(page.getByText(errorCopy.currentPasswordRequired, { exact: true })).toBeVisible();

    // Incorrect current password.
    await submitPasswordChange(page, 'Wrong-password-123!', NEW_PASSWORD);
    await expect(page.getByText(errorCopy.currentPasswordIncorrect, { exact: true })).toBeVisible();

    // Incorrect current password + mismatched confirmation: both at once.
    await submitPasswordChange(page, 'Wrong-password-123!', NEW_PASSWORD, 'does-not-match');
    await expect(page.getByText(errorCopy.currentPasswordIncorrect, { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.getByText(errorCopy.passwordConfirmationMismatch, { exact: true })).toBeVisible();

    // Noncompliant new password.
    await submitPasswordChange(page, account.password, 'short');
    await expect(page.getByText(errorCopy.passwordRequirements, { exact: true })).toBeVisible();

    // No password value is ever redisplayed after a failure.
    await expect(page.getByLabel(authCopy.currentPassword, { exact: true })).toHaveValue('');
    await expect(page.getByLabel(authCopy.newPassword, { exact: true })).toHaveValue('');
    await expect(page.getByLabel(authCopy.confirmPassword, { exact: true })).toHaveValue('');

    // The account still authenticates with the old password only.
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: authCopy.accountMenu }).click();
    await page.getByRole('link', { name: authCopy.signOut }).click();
    await page.getByRole('dialog', { name: authCopy.signOut }).getByRole('button', { name: authCopy.confirmSignOut }).click();
    await signIn(page, account.email, NEW_PASSWORD);
    await expect(page.getByText(errorCopy.invalidCredentials, { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
    await signIn(page, account.email, account.password);
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: authCopy.accountMenu })).toBeVisible();
  });
});

  `POST /api/auth/reset-password`（无服务端待处理状态；未知邮箱与错误验证码返回完全相同的单条 `code` 字段错误，

+### 已实现（本任务，全部落在 `braid/issue-3-m1`）

+  `POST /api/auth/reset-password`（无服务端待处理状态；未知邮箱与错误验证码返回完全相同的单条 `code` 字段错误，
+  绝不与密码错误合并以免泄露存在性——这是对 D2 的收紧实现，依据：若已知邮箱返回“验证码错误+密码错误”而未知邮箱只返回
+  “验证码错误”，则错误组合本身泄露存在性）、`POST /api/auth/change-password`（requireAuth；一次返回全部字段错误；
+  保留当前会话、吊销其它会话）。三者在事务内改密并按 D1/D1b 吊销会话；响应不含 password_hash/密码原文。
+- 前端：`/password-reset` 两步流程（URL 驱动 `?step=2&email=…` → `?step=done`；`123456` 为独立可见元素，
+  mount 零请求）；`/settings/*` 嵌套路由（SettingsLayout + `password` 页 + 后续模块占位）；文案全部引用 `copy.ts`。
+- 验收：后端 Vitest 48 用例全绿（新增 `identity-recovery.test.js`：非泄露逐字节比对、多项错误、会话吊销、越权不波及他人）；
+  `pnpm typecheck` exit 0；`pnpm e2e` 16 用例全绿（新增 `e2e/identity.spec.ts`，D6 隔离：改密/找回先注册 `pw-*` 账户，
+  seed 密码未动）。

+  隐藏验收若断言“错误码 + 错误密码应同时显示两条”，则与本实现冲突，需回 Issue #3 重裁。

# 技术架构与共享契约

> 本文是基础 PR 与全部业务子任务的共享契约。基础 PR 负责人按此实施；业务负责人按此消费。
> 变更需在 Issue #1 讨论后更新本文。

## 1. 技术栈（已定）

- **frontend/**：Vite + React 18 + TypeScript + React Router + UnoCSS + Radix primitives（自建轻组件，
  不引入带默认文案的重型组件库，保证精确 accessible name）。图标用 lucide-react（随应用打包）。
- **backend/**：Node.js 20 + Express 4 + better-sqlite3（同步 API + 事务）。单进程。
  **后端源码为纯 ESM JavaScript（`.js`，`"type": "module"`）：平台只执行 `npm install` + `npm run start`，
  没有构建步骤，业务模块同样直接写 `.js`。**
- 密码哈希用 Node 内置 `crypto.scryptSync`（`scrypt$N$r$p$salt$hash`），不引入第二份原生依赖。
- **根目录**：pnpm workspace（pnpm-lock.yaml）；同时保证 frontend/、backend/ 可独立 `npm install && npm run build/start`。
- 启动兼容：backend `npm run build`（如需）与 `npm run start`（HOST/PORT 环境变量，默认 127.0.0.1:3000），
  生产模式下同时服务 `frontend/dist` 静态产物与 `/api/*`。SPA 回退到 index.html。
- 开发/检查命令统一用交付 Node 执行应用进程（`APP_NODE`，默认 `/usr/local/bin/node`）：本环境工具 Node 与交付
  Node 大版本不同，原生模块只为一个 ABI 构建，见 `docs/platform-compat.md`。

## 2. 目录结构（契约）

```
frontend/
  src/
    api/            # 后端客户端（fetch 封装、错误解析）
    components/     # 共享 UI（AppShell、AccountMenu、Dialog、Field、Badge…）
    features/<m>/   # 按模块划分的页面（identity/org/repo/code/issues/prs）
    routes.tsx
backend/
  src/
    db/             # 连接、迁移、事务
    seed/           # seed 注册表：registerSeed(fn) 幂等执行
    auth/           # 会话、cookie、密码哈希
    permissions/    # 共享权限模型（见 §4）
    modules/<m>/    # 按模块的 router + service
    http/           # 错误格式中间件
```

## 3. API 约定

- 前缀 `/api`，JSON。前端一律用同源相对路径。
- 认证：httpOnly cookie `session`；`POST /api/auth/*`；中间件 `requireAuth`、`requirePermission`。
  cookie 属性为 `httpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Path=/`，**不带 `Secure`**：交付以 HTTP 提供，带 `Secure` 会被浏览器丢弃。
  会话失效语义（2026-09-29 修订，见 §9.11）：登出使当前会话立即失效；改密保留调用者当前会话、仅吊销该用户
  其它会话（`revokeSessionsForUser(db, userId, { exceptSessionId })`）；找回密码吊销该用户全部会话且不自动登录
  （`revokeSessionsForUser(db, userId)`）。三者的后续请求都立即按新状态判定。
- 找回密码不泄露账户存在性：`forgot-password` 不查询账户，对已注册与未注册邮箱响应逐字节一致；
  `reset-password` 对未知邮箱与错误验证码表现一致（`Verification code is invalid`，字段 `code`），任何路径都不修改账户。
  字段错误仍按下面的 `errors[]` 规则一次返回（含 `code` 与密码字段错误）。
  **有意保留的残留差异（2026-09-29，见 §9.12）**：验证码**正确**时，已注册邮箱得到密码字段错误或成功，未注册邮箱
  在同样的密码字段错误前另有一条 `code` 错误（如 `[密码错误...]` vs `[code, 密码错误...]`）。这是需求内生的：验证码是页面
  公开常量、恢复无服务端待处理状态、且恢复必须对已注册邮箱生效。**不得**为消除它而恢复“验证码错误时提前返回”——
  那会丢掉 `errors[]` 一次返回全部字段错误，且不减少任何泄露。`reset-password` 成功响应只返回 `{ok, message}`，
  **不得携带会话或账户数据**，否则该差异会从 1 bit 扩大。
- 错误响应统一：`{ "error": { "code": string, "message": string, "field"?: string } }`，
  字段级错误 `field` 用表单字段名；**只要存在字段错误就同时返回 `errors: [{code,message,field},...]`（单条也返回）**，
  `error` 为其中的首项，前端统一按 `errors[]` 逐字段渲染。
- 会话用户序列化为 `{id, username, email, emailVerified, createdAt}`，任何响应都不得包含 `password_hash`。
- 资源命名：`/api/orgs`、`/api/repos/:owner/:name`、`/api/repos/:id/issues` 等；列表支持 `?q=&state=&label=`。

## 4. 权限模型（backend/src/permissions，单一实现）

```
type RepoRole = 'read'|'triage'|'write'|'maintain'|'admin'
effectiveRepoRole(user, repo): RepoRole|null
  - 个人仓库：owner = admin
  - 组织仓库：org Owner → admin；否则 max(直接授权, 各团队授权)；团队层级不传播
```

写权限映射（共享决定，全部模块一致）：
- 建分支/Web 编辑文件：write+
- Issue 创建：write+；评论/编辑标题描述：write+
- 指派/标签/里程碑/关闭重开 Issue：triage+（注意与创建不同）
- PR 创建/比较：write+；评审（非作者）：write+；reviewers 请求：作者或 maintain+
- 合并：maintain+；分支保护/Checks 状态/默认分支/可见性/删除：admin+
- 组织：Owner = org admin；Member 仅可见性；团队维护仅 org Owner

## 5. 内容模型（无真实 git 的简化模型，基础 PR 建表、M4 消费）

```
users(id, username UNIQUE, email UNIQUE, password_hash, email_verified, created_at)
                                                     -- email_verified 见 §9.10
sessions(id, user_id, created_at)                    -- cookie 存 session id
organizations(id, name UNIQUE, display_name, created_at)
org_members(org_id, user_id, role['member'|'owner'])
teams(id, org_id, name, description, parent_team_id NULL)
team_members(team_id, user_id)
repos(id, owner_user_id NULL, owner_org_id NULL, name, description,
      visibility['public'|'private'], default_branch_id, fork_source_id NULL, created_at)
repo_grants(repo_id, subject_user_id NULL, subject_team_id NULL, role)  -- 每 subject 唯一
branches(id, repo_id, name UNIQUE(repo_id), head_commit_id)
commits(id, repo_id, parent_id NULL, author_id, message, created_at,
        tree_json)   -- tree_json: {path: content} 全量快照（规模小，见 product-plan §5）
                     -- parent_id = 第一父；合并 commit 的第二父见 commit_parents（§9.10）
commit_parents(commit_id, parent_commit_id, position)  -- 支持 §9.2 的双父合并 commit
commit_files(commit_id, path, status['added'|'modified'|'removed'], additions, deletions)
issues(id, repo_id, number, title, body, author_id, state['open'|'closed'], created_at, updated_at)
comments(id, issue_id|pr_id, author_id, body, created_at)
labels(id, repo_id, name), issue_labels(issue_id, label_id)
milestones(id, repo_id, title), issue_milestones(issue_id PRIMARY KEY, milestone_id)
                                                     -- 一个 issue 至多一个里程碑（§9.10）
assignees(issue_id, user_id)
pull_requests(id, repo_id, number, title, body, author_id,
      state['draft'|'open'|'closed'|'merged'], base_branch_id, compare_branch_id,
      base_commit_id, compare_commit_id, merged_commit_id NULL, created_at)
reviews(id, pr_id, reviewer_id, decision['comment'|'approve'|'request_changes'],
        summary, compare_commit_id, created_at)   -- 同 reviewer 同 compare commit 取最新为有效
review_comments(id, pr_id, path, compare_commit_id, line, body, author_id,
        published bool)                            -- pending = 未提交评审的草稿
check_runs(id, pr_id, compare_commit_id, name['test'], status['pending'|'success'|'failure'],
        setter_id, updated_at)
branch_protections(id, repo_id, branch_name UNIQUE(repo_id),
        require_approval bool, require_check_test bool)
activities(id, kind, actor_id, subject_type, subject_id, payload_json, created_at) -- 时间线统一来源
```

- 写路径均在事务内；`activities` 同时服务 Issue/PR 时间线与审计。
- branch name 合法性、`invalid..branch`、文件路径规则（不以 `/` 开头、无 `..` 段、不冲突）在后端统一校验。

## 6. Seed 机制（契约）

- `backend/src/seed/index.js` 维护注册表；每个业务模块导出 `seedXxx(db)` 幂等函数（按业务键 upsert）。
- 基础 PR 提供账户种子（alice-dev、bob-reviewer 等，见 docs/seed-data.md）与应用骨架种子。
- 业务模块在合并时把自己的 seed 注册进总表（`backend/src/seed/all.js` 加一行 import）；
  **服务器启动时默认执行全部 seed**（`SEED=0` 关闭），因为平台以 `npm run start` 正常启动即需具备初始数据。
- seed 必须幂等且**不得覆盖用户已产生的数据**：账户种子用 `INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`
  （因此改过密码的账户重启后仍保留新密码）；业务对象按业务键 upsert 同样不得回退用户改动。
- 场景隔离：验收测试使用唯一后缀对象（`pw-branch-<suffix>` 等，需求原文即如此要求），不做 per-test 重置。

## 7. 前端共享 UI（契约）

- `AppShell`：未登录（logo + Sign in / Sign up）与登录态（全局搜索框、+ 新建下拉、Issues/PR 图标链接、头像账户菜单）。
- `AccountMenu`：触发按钮 accessible name 为 "Account menu"，菜单含当前用户名、组织入口（"Your organizations"）、
  "Signed in as <user>"、"Your repositories"、"Settings"、"Sign out"（按需求文本微调以各模块为准）。
- 表单组件统一输出：label 关联、字段错误（`field` 对应）、aria-describedby 帮助文本。
- 图标按钮一律 `aria-label`；分段控件计数徽标不进入 accessible name。
- 路由：`/`、`/login`、`/register`、`/password-reset`、`/settings/*`、`/:owner/:repo(/*)`、`/orgs/:org(/*)`、`/search`。
  具体页面在业务模块内实现，路由名以需求文本的 URL 语义为准（无需与 GitHub 完全一致）。

## 8. 质量设施（基础 PR 提供）

## 9. 修订记录（advisor 咨询后确定，2026-09-29）

1. **commit 共享不可变**：commit 为全局唯一不可变对象（不按仓库复制）；branch 仅为指针；
   fork = 在 fork 仓库中创建指向既有 commit 的分支指针；fork 后新 commit 归属 fork 仓库且不影响源仓库。
   理由：stale review（按 compare commit）、Checks、diff 全部自然落在 commitId 键上；fork 无复制开销。
2. **合并语义（REQ-6 消费）**：merge base = compare 分支与 base 分支的共同祖先 commit。
   逐文件三方合并：仅 compare 侧变更 → 取 compare；仅 base 侧变更 → 保持 base；
   双侧都改且内容不同 → 冲突：该 PR 判定 unmergeable，合并区显示冲突说明且按钮禁用。
   merge commit 的 tree 在事务内计算并作为新 commit 落库（parents = base head + compare head）。
3. **前端权限镜像**：后端在仓库/组织作用域的响应中返回 `viewerPermission`（仓库角色或 org 角色枚举）；
   前端只读取该字段决定控件渲染（隐藏 vs 只读 vs 可操作），不自行计算权限。
   验收同时断言控件缺席（按需求指明的档次）与服务端拒绝。
4. **文案契约**：基础 PR 交付 `frontend/src/contracts/copy.ts`（或等价位置），把需求中被断言的
   accessible name 与错误消息定义为常量；组件与 Playwright 测试都引用它，禁止散落字面量。
5. **Checks 键**：check 状态按 `(compareCommitId, checkName)` 存储与展示；compare 分支新 commit 后
   新 compare commit 的必需检查初始为 pending（与 review stale 对称）。
6. **测试隔离强化**：账户可跨模块共享；业务实体（组织/仓库/issue/PR 等）模块自有 + 唯一 token 命名；
   列表/搜索/计数断言必须用唯一 token 限定范围，禁止全局计数或排序断言。seed 一律按业务键 upsert、顺序无关。
7. **依赖库评估记录（better-auth，时间盒结论）**：本产品需要固定验证码找回、字段级多项错误、
   精确错误文案、仓库级 5 角色授权、团队层级不传播权限、改密/登出即时失效会话。
   better-auth email/password 与 organization 插件均以自身默认流与角色模型为中心，映射以上需求需大量
   对抗性定制（覆盖默认错误文案与流程），自建（表结构见 §5）更直接、可控，选定自建。
8. **better-sqlite3 安装风险**：基础 PR 第一项工作为在平台 npm 环境（PATH=/usr/local/bin:$PATH）做干净
   `npm install` 实测；失败保留首轮日志并改用有 prebuild 的锁定版本或替代驱动，结论记录在 PR。
9. **拆分调整**：M4 拆为 M4a（内容模型+浏览+历史+diff）、M4b（分支+代码搜索+Web 编辑）；
   M6 拆为 M6a（保护规则+Checks+PR 生命周期+三视图）、M6b（行内评论+评审+stale+合并门控）。
   M6a 硬依赖 M4a 的 diff API；M6b 依赖 M6a。
10. **基础 PR 提出的 6 项契约增量（根 Issue #1 评论 #8 全部采纳，2026-09-29）**：
    1. `users.email_verified INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1`：承载 REQ-1-1-1 要求的“已验证邮箱状态”。
    2. `commit_parents(commit_id, parent_commit_id, position)`：§9.2 的合并 commit 有两个父提交；
       `commits.parent_id` 保留为第一父。
    3. `issue_milestones(issue_id PRIMARY KEY, milestone_id)`：一个 issue 至多一个里程碑。
    4. seed **随启动默认执行**（`SEED=0` 关闭），取代“非生产或显式 SEED=1”；理由与幂等约束见 §6。
    5. 会话 cookie 不带 `Secure`（HTTP 交付）；理由见 §3。
    6. 字段错误存在时**始终**返回 `errors[]`（含单条），`error` 为首项；理由见 §3。
    实现证据：PR #2（`backend/src/db/migrations.js`、`backend/src/http/errors.js`、`backend/test/*`）。
11. **M1 身份与会话语义澄清（根 Issue #1 评论 #27 采纳 Issue #3 评论 #25 的 D1/D1b/D2，2026-09-29）**：
    改密保留调用者当前会话、仅吊销该用户其它会话；找回密码吊销该用户全部会话且不自动登录；
    找回密码不泄露账户存在性（`forgot-password` 对已注册/未注册邮箱响应逐字节一致，`reset-password` 对未知邮箱与
    错误验证码都返回字段 `code` 的 `Verification code is invalid`，且错误码提交时仍一次返回全部字段错误，
    使已知/未知邮箱在 code 错时响应逐字节一致）。要点已并入 §3。
    实现证据：PR #12（`backend/src/modules/identity/router.js`、`backend/test/identity-recovery.test.js`）。
12. **M1 `reset-password` 非泄露边界澄清（2026-09-29，Issue #3 负责人据原生 advisor 独立复核）**：
    采纳“一次返回全部字段错误”（§9.11）后，验证码**正确**一列的已注册/未注册邮箱响应仍可区分：密码不合规时为
    `[密码错误...]` vs `[code, 密码错误...]`，密码合规时为成功 vs `[code]`。该差异由需求自身强制的成功语义、公开验证码常量、
    无服务端待处理状态共同决定，属**有意保留**；不得用“验证码错误时提前返回”消除（零泄露收益、丢 D7）。更强的零泄露替代
    （对未注册邮箱假装成功、不写库）经评估**否决**：`/register` 已用 `Email already exists` 明文泄露存在性，方案会误导
    输错邮箱的用户，并与需求要求的成功反馈冲突；若将来成功响应改为携带会话/账户数据，本方案即成为唯一可行形态。
    依据与反例：PR #12 thread 37 的 advisor 复核记录。
    实现证据：PR #12（`backend/test/identity-recovery.test.js` 钉住该有意差异）。

# 参考截图视觉解读（vision sub-agent 产出摘要）

来源：input/reference/ 27 张 GitHub 截图，由 vision 子代理逐张解读（2026-09-29）。
需求文本中的精确英文 accessible name 是权威；截图仅作布局/视觉参考。全文见 native run 摘要，此处记录影响分工与验收的结论。

## 布局模式
- 未登录认证页：居中单列（登录/重置密码），注册页为深色左栏+白色右栏两栏。
- 登录态全局外壳：顶栏（logo、搜索、图标簇、头像按钮）+ 仓库导航标签（Code/Issues/Pull requests/Settings…）。
- Issues/PR 列表与里程碑：左侧二级侧边栏 + 主列；仓库概览为左主列+右 About 侧栏。
- 设置页：左侧设置导航 + 右长表单；Danger Zone 红边框卡片。
- 风格：白底、1px 浅灰边框小圆角卡片、绿色主按钮、当前标签下划线。

## 可访问性要点（验收相关）
- 大量纯图标按钮（头像菜单、复制、`+`、齿轮、`...`、关闭 ×、发送等）必须用 aria-label 命名。
- 分段控件含计数徽标（Open 0 / Closed 0）：计数不得进入控件 accessible name。
- 同类动作两处名称不同（"New milestone" 页眉 vs "Create a milestone" 空状态）需分别正确。
- fork 表单复选框可见文字被内联 code 打断，a11y 名称应为连续文本。
- 输入框 a11y 名称来自 label，不用 placeholder 顶替。

## 图像缺口（记录为需求语义缺口，按需求文本实现）
1. github-code-file-browser.png 与 github-repository-overview.png 内容完全相同（仅根目录 README）：
   目录树/文件详情页无独立视觉参考，布局按 overview + 面包屑语义推断实现。
2. github-default-branch-settings.png 与 github-branch-protection.png 内容完全相同（保护规则空状态）：
   默认分支设置区参考 visibility-settings 截图 General 页的 "Default branch" 下拉实现。
3. Web 文件编辑器截图未展示提交信息对话框；提交信息字段与按钮按需求文本（"Commit message"、"Commit changes"）实现。
4. 分支保护截图为空状态；规则表单字段按需求文本（Branch name pattern、Require 1 approval、Require status check test、Create/Save changes）实现。
5. github-account-menu-sign-out.png 实际内容是登录后的 Dashboard 首页：图内没有任何展开的账户菜单或登出对话框，
   登出确认 UI 无视觉参考（M1 视觉复核，2026-09-29）。
6. github-password-reset.png / -1.png 两步都没有验证码（code）的任何表现形式（无独立文本、无输入框、无 `123456`），
   “显示固定验证码 123456”只由需求文本定义；github-password-settings.png 是 “Sign in methods” 列表页（含 Password 行），

# 产品方案（简化版 GitHub 协作平台）

> 根 Issue：local/run#1。本文是所有子任务的共享依据之一；原子需求的权威文本在
> `/workspace/template/.factory26/20260929-042409-1202e245/input/requirements.yaml`（292KB，含 34 条 ATOMIC 需求与 GIVEN/WHEN/THEN 场景），
> 参考截图在 `input/reference/`（27 张 GitHub 界面截图）。本文只记录影响分工与验收的决定。

## 1. 产品概述

一个浏览器可用的简化 GitHub 协作平台：账户与会话、组织与团队治理、仓库（搜索/创建/fork/可见性）、
代码浏览与版本控制（文件、提交、diff、分支、Web 编辑）、Issue 管理、变更评审与合并控制。
无真实 git 协议、无 Actions/Packages/Wiki/通知/实时协作（需求明确排除）。

## 2. 模块与需求映射

| 模块 | 原子需求 | 关键交付 |
|---|---|---|
| M1 身份与访问 | REQ-1-1-1/2/3, REQ-1-2, REQ-1-3 | 注册（字段级错误+保留输入）、登录（统一 "Invalid credentials"）、找回密码（固定验证码 123456）、登出（确认对话框）、改密码 |
| M2 组织与治理 | REQ-2-1-1/2, REQ-2-2-1..4, REQ-2-3 | 组织浏览/创建、团队创建/成员/层级（禁环）、成员增删（last Owner 保护）、按人/团队授予仓库角色 |
| M3 仓库资产 | REQ-3-1..3-4 | 全局搜索（Enter 直出结果）、创建仓库（含 README 初始化）、fork、Code 克隆值（HTTPS/SSH + Copied）、公开概览、可见性变更 |
| M4 代码与版本控制（拆分 M4a/M4b） | REQ-4-1, 4-2-1..3, 4-3-1..3, 4-4 | 文件浏览、提交历史（分支/文件范围）、commit diff、代码搜索、分支选择器/创建、默认分支设置、Web 文件编辑产生 commit |
| M5 Issue 管理 | REQ-5-1-1/2, 5-2-1..3, 5-3-1..3, 5-4 | 列表过滤（Open/Closed 链接、as-you-type）、详情时间线、创建/编辑、评论+表情回应、指派/标签/里程碑侧栏、关闭重开 |
| M6 评审与合并（拆分 M6a/M6b） | REQ-6-1..6-6 | 分支保护（1 approval + test 检查）、PR 列表/比较/创建/Draft/Ready for review、三视图、行内评论（单条/草稿评审）、评审提交、reviewers、受保护合并、关闭重开 |

text: ## REQ-2 Organization and Governance | type: FOLDER | deps: ['REQ-1-1-2']
Signed-in users enter the organization list through “Your organizations” in the account menu and can create or open an organization; visitors can only view public repositories through public organization pages. The organization overview provides Repositories, People, and Teams entries. An organization Owner directly adds or removes members on People, creates teams and maintains hierarchy on Teams, and grants roles to members or teams in Manage access under repository Settings. Organization membership only determines whether a user can see the organization and can be a candidate for team/repository authorization; it does not automatically grant access to any private repository. Access to a private repository comes only from organization Owner status, a direct role grant on that repository, or direct membership in a team authorized for that repository. All changes must be reflected simultaneously in organization details, people/team lists, and the actual access results of affected repositories.

## REQ-2-1 Organization Identity and Discovery | type: FOLDER | deps: ['REQ-1-1-2']
The organization overview page uses the organization name as a heading; its “Repositories”, “People”, and “Teams” navigation entries have link roles even when visually styled as tabs. The Repositories tab lists repositories owned by the organization, the People tab lists members and their Member/Owner roles, and the Teams tab lists teams. This module supports visitors discovering an organization's public repositories and signed-in accounts creating organizations from the “Your organizations” page. The unique organization name uses the same globally unique 1–39-character lowercase ASCII format as the REQ-1 username; the display name must contain 1–100 non-empty characters after trimming leading and trailing whitespace. After successful creation, the system stores the organization object and the creating account's Owner membership relationship, and the user enters the new organization overview page; subsequent team, member, and organization-repository authorization is scoped by this organization identifier. This feature builds on the persisted objects, opened pages, or authenticated-session context provided by REQ-1-1-2 (Sign In with an Existing Account); it must reuse that context and keep pages and data consistent after the context changes.

## REQ-2-1-1 Browse Organization Repositories | type: ATOMIC | deps: []
The organization page presents “Repositories” as a navigation link, visually usable as a tab, and a textbox labeled “Find a repository”. Filtering updates the visible results as the user types, without a separate submit action. Each result has a link named exactly with the repository name, and opens a heading displaying “organization name/repository name”. Returning with browser Back keeps the public result available; filtering by the exact private repository name never exposes its link to a visitor. The seed organization has a public repository and a distinct private repository inaccessible to visitors. From the organization page, the user clicks the “Repositories” link, can enter a repository name in the filter box, select a public/private filter, and click a repository name in the list to open its overview. The system displays only the names, descriptions, visibility, and update times of repositories visible to the current user; clicking a result opens that repository's overview. Visitors can view public repositories on a public organization overview page; signed-in accounts can see only repositories for which they have read permission on the Repositories tab of the organization overview. The list reads repository name, description, visibility, and update time and provides no write operations; private repositories must first be validated under the already defined repository-access rules.

The account-menu link “Your organizations” opens a page with the link “New organization”. Its form has fields labeled “Organization name” and “Display name” and a button “Create organization”. The new overview uses a heading containing the organization identifier, which remains after reload. Submitting an existing identifier must show “Organization name already exists” even when the display name is also missing; it must not navigate to a heading for the existing organization. The malformed identifier “-invalid-organization” and a whitespace-only display name are rejected with the applicable field error. Seed data supplies a verified creator and an existing organization identifier for the duplicate case. A signed-in user enters a unique organization name and display information on the organization-creation page and confirms. The organization name must comply with the 1–39-character lowercase ASCII REQ-1 username format and be globally unique; the display name must contain 1–100 non-empty characters after trimming leading and trailing whitespace. The system validates these rules, creates the organization identifier, display name, and creation time, and saves the current user as both initial owner and member; if the name or display name is noncompliant, the name conflicts, or persistence fails, the system retains non-sensitive input, displays the reason in the corresponding field, and does not create the organization. On success, the user is redirected to the new organization overview page, the organization appears in the current user's accessible-organization list, and subsequent team, member, and repository authorization is scoped by that organization identifier. ## REQ-2-2 Team and Member Management | type: FOLDER | deps: ['REQ-2-1-2']
On the current organization's member- and team-management pages, users create teams, maintain team hierarchy and membership relationships, and directly add or remove organization members. A team name contains 1–50 lowercase ASCII letters, digits, or hyphens, may not begin or end with a hyphen, and must be unique within the same organization; a team must belong to an organization, and a parent team must belong to the same organization and may not create a direct or indirect cycle. Organization membership and team membership are independent persisted relationships; team hierarchy is used only for display and management and does not implicitly add members of a parent or child team to the other team. On the People page, an Owner enters the username or verified email of an existing account and confirms, after which the system immediately saves that account's Member or Owner membership relationship; there is no invitation, Pending, or acceptance step. When removing a member, the system atomically deletes that organization-membership relationship, all of that account's team memberships in the organization, and all direct grants to that account on repositories of the organization; team grants themselves are not deleted. If removal would leave the organization with no Owner, the system rejects the operation and keeps all relationships unchanged; the person's account, personal repositories, and relationships with other organizations must not be deleted. This feature builds on the persisted objects, opened pages, or authenticated-session context provided by REQ-2-1-2 (Create an Organization After Authentication); it must reuse that context and keep pages and data consistent after the context changes.

 * The schema follows docs/architecture.md §5 (content model). Two additive

 * called out in PR #2:
 *  - `users.email_verified` (REQ-1-1-1 stores the verified-email status).
 *  - `commit_parents` (architecture §9.2: a merge commit has two parents, which a
 *    single `commits.parent_id` column cannot express; `parent_id` is kept as the

export const migrations = [
  {
    version: 1,
    name: 'core-schema',
    sql: `
CREATE TABLE users (
  id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  username      TEXT    NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  email         TEXT    NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  password_hash TEXT    NOT NULL,
  email_verified INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  created_at    TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);

CREATE TABLE sessions (
  id         TEXT    PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id    INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  created_at TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);
CREATE INDEX sessions_user_idx ON sessions(user_id);

  id           INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
