/**
 * Shared permission model (docs/architecture.md §4 — single implementation).
 *
 * Roles are NOT an automatic cumulative ladder: an operation states the role it
 * needs and `roleAtLeast()` compares them in the documented order
 * read < triage < write < maintain < admin. An organisation Owner is an Admin
 * for every repository of that organisation.
 *
 * A user's effective repository role is the highest of
 *   - `admin` when the user owns the repository personally,
 *   - `admin` when the user is an Owner of the owning organisation,
 *   - direct grants on the repository,
 *   - grants to teams the user is a *direct* member of.
 * Team hierarchy never propagates membership or permissions.
 */

import { forbidden } from '../http/errors.js';

export const ROLE_ORDER = ['read', 'triage', 'write', 'maintain', 'admin'];

const ROLE_RANK = new Map(ROLE_ORDER.map((role, index) => [role, index]));

/** @param {string|null|undefined} role */
export function isRepoRole(role) {
  return typeof role === 'string' && ROLE_RANK.has(role);
}

/** Highest of two roles (null-safe). */
export function maxRole(a, b) {
  const rankA = isRepoRole(a) ? ROLE_RANK.get(a) : -1;
  const rankB = isRepoRole(b) ? ROLE_RANK.get(b) : -1;
  if (rankA < 0 && rankB < 0) return null;
  return rankA >= rankB ? a : b;
}

/** Does `role` satisfy `required`? Null role never satisfies anything. */
export function roleAtLeast(role, required) {
  if (!isRepoRole(role) || !isRepoRole(required)) return false;
  return ROLE_RANK.get(role) >= ROLE_RANK.get(required);
}

/**
 * Effective role of a user on a repository.
 *
 * @param {import('better-sqlite3').Database} db
 * @param {{id:number}|null} user  public or raw user row (null = anonymous)
 * @param {{id:number, owner_user_id:number|null, owner_org_id:number|null}} repo
 * @returns {'read'|'triage'|'write'|'maintain'|'admin'|null}
 */
export function effectiveRepoRole(db, user, repo) {
  if (!user || !repo) return null;
  if (repo.owner_user_id != null && Number(repo.owner_user_id) === Number(user.id)) return 'admin';

  let role = null;

  if (repo.owner_org_id != null) {
    const membership = db
      .prepare('SELECT role FROM org_members WHERE org_id = ? AND user_id = ?')
      .get(repo.owner_org_id, user.id);
    if (membership?.role === 'owner') return 'admin';
  }

  const direct = db
    .prepare('SELECT role FROM repo_grants WHERE repo_id = ? AND subject_user_id = ?')
    .get(repo.id, user.id);
  if (direct) role = maxRole(role, direct.role);

  // Direct team memberships only — hierarchy does not propagate permissions.
  const teamGrants = db
    .prepare(
      `SELECT g.role AS role
         FROM repo_grants g
         JOIN team_members tm ON tm.team_id = g.subject_team_id
        WHERE g.repo_id = ? AND tm.user_id = ?`,
    )
    .all(repo.id, user.id);
  for (const grant of teamGrants) role = maxRole(role, grant.role);

  return role;
}

/**
 * Role of a user inside an organisation ('owner' | 'member' | null).
 */
export function orgRole(db, user, orgId) {
  if (!user || orgId == null) return null;
  const membership = db
    .prepare('SELECT role FROM org_members WHERE org_id = ? AND user_id = ?')
    .get(orgId, user.id);
  return membership?.role ?? null;
}

/** Can the user see the repository at all (public repositories are readable)? */
export function canViewRepo(db, user, repo) {
  if (!repo) return false;
  if (repo.visibility === 'public') return true;
  return effectiveRepoRole(db, user, repo) != null;
}

/**
 * The `viewerPermission` value attached to repository/organisation responses
 * (docs/architecture.md §9.3). The frontend only reads this field; it never
 * computes permissions itself.
 *
 * @returns {{ repository?: string|null, organization?: string|null, canView: boolean }}
 */
export function viewerPermissionForRepo(db, user, repo) {
  return {
    repository: repo ? effectiveRepoRole(db, user, repo) : null,
    organization: repo?.owner_org_id != null ? orgRole(db, user, repo.owner_org_id) : null,
    canView: canViewRepo(db, user, repo),
  };
}

/**
 * Express middleware factory for repository-scoped routes. The route must have
 * loaded the repository onto `req.repo`.
 * @param {'read'|'triage'|'write'|'maintain'|'admin'} required
 */
export function requireRepoRole(db, required) {
  return (req, res, next) => {
    const repo = req.repo;
    if (!repo) {
      next(new Error('requireRepoRole() needs req.repo to be loaded first'));
      return;
    }
    const role = effectiveRepoRole(db, req.user, repo);
    if (!roleAtLeast(role, required)) {
      next(forbidden());
      return;
    }
    req.repoRole = role;
    next();
  };
}
/**
 * Import every seed module exactly once, then run the registry.
 *
 * Business modules append one import line here (or import this file from their
 * own bootstrap) so their `registerSeed(...)` calls are executed.
 */
import './accounts.js';

export { registerSeed, runSeeds, registeredSeeds, resetSeedRegistry } from './index.js';
/**
 * Seed registry (docs/architecture.md §6).
 *
 * Each business module exports an idempotent `seedXxx(db)` function and
 * registers it here; `runSeeds()` executes the registry inside transactions at
 * server startup. Seeds are keyed by business identity and must be safe to run
 * repeatedly without overwriting data the user already produced (for example an
 * account whose password was changed through the UI must keep its new password
 * after a restart).
 */
import { transact } from '../db/index.js';

/** @type {Map<string, (db: import('better-sqlite3').Database) => void>} */
const registry = new Map();

/**
 * @param {string} name unique seed name, e.g. 'accounts'
 * @param {(db: import('better-sqlite3').Database) => void} fn idempotent seed body
 */
export function registerSeed(name, fn) {
  if (registry.has(name)) {
    throw new Error(`Seed "${name}" is already registered`);
  }
  registry.set(name, fn);
}

export function registeredSeeds() {
  return [...registry.keys()];
}

/**
 * Run every registered seed. A failure rolls back only the failing seed, so a
 * broken module seed cannot corrupt data written by the others.
 * @returns {string[]} names that ran
 */
export function runSeeds(db, { logger = console } = {}) {
  const ran = [];
  for (const [name, fn] of registry) {
    try {
      transact(db, () => fn(db));
      ran.push(name);
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error(`[seed] "${name}" failed:`, error);
      throw error;
    }
  }
  return ran;
}

/** Test helper: clear the registry (only used between isolated test suites). */
export function resetSeedRegistry() {
  registry.clear();
}

/**
 * Server entry point.
 *
 * Reads HOST/PORT from the environment (platform start command and portless both
 * inject them), opens the SQLite database, applies migrations + idempotent seed
 * data, then serves the API and the built frontend.
 */
import path from 'node:path';
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';
import { config } from './config.js';
import { initDb } from './db/index.js';
import { createApp } from './app.js';
import './seed/all.js';
import { runSeeds } from './seed/index.js';

export function startServer({ overrides = {} } = {}) {
  const effective = { ...config, ...overrides };
  const db = initDb(effective.dbPath);
  if (effective.runSeeds) runSeeds(db);

  const app = createApp({ db, config: effective });
  const server = app.listen(effective.port, effective.host, () => {
    const actualPort = server.address()?.port ?? effective.port;
    const url = process.env.PORTLESS_URL || `http://${effective.host}:${actualPort}`;
    console.log(`[server] listening on ${url} (db: ${effective.dbPath})`);
  });

  let closing = false;
  const shutdown = (signal) => {
    if (closing) return;
    closing = true;
    console.log(`[server] ${signal} received, shutting down`);
    server.close(() => {
      try {
        db.close();
      } catch {
        /* ignore */
      }
      process.exit(0);
    });
    // Do not hang on keep-alive connections.
    setTimeout(() => process.exit(0), 3000).unref();
  };
  process.on('SIGINT', () => shutdown('SIGINT'));
  process.on('SIGTERM', () => shutdown('SIGTERM'));

  return { server, db, app };
}

// Only auto-start when executed directly (tests import startServer/createApp).
const entry = process.argv[1] ? pathToFileURL(path.resolve(process.argv[1])).href : null;
if (entry && import.meta.url === entry) {
  startServer();
}
/**
 * Runtime configuration. Everything is environment driven so the platform
 * (`HOST=0.0.0.0 PORT=3000 npm run start`) and portless `pnpm dev` both work
 * without changing code.
 */
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const backendRoot = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..');
const repoRoot = path.resolve(backendRoot, '..');

function intFromEnv(name, fallback) {
  const raw = process.env[name];
  if (raw === undefined || raw === '') return fallback;
  const value = Number.parseInt(raw, 10);
  return Number.isFinite(value) ? value : fallback;
}

  backendRoot,
  repoRoot,
  host: process.env.HOST || '127.0.0.1',
  port: intFromEnv('PORT', 3000),
  dbPath: process.env.DB_PATH || path.join(backendRoot, 'data', 'app.db'),
  frontendDist: process.env.FRONTEND_DIST || path.join(repoRoot, 'frontend', 'dist'),
  sessionCookieName: 'session',
  sessionTtlMs: 1000 * 60 * 60 * 24 * 30,
  // Seed data is idempotent (insert-if-absent by business key) and is applied on
  // every startup so a normally started app always has the required initial data.
  // `SEED=0` disables it (used by some focused test runs).
  runSeeds: process.env.SEED !== '0',
  isProduction: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production',

text: import { useState } from 'react';
import type { ReactNode } from 'react';
import { Link, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { GitBranch } from 'lucide-react';
import { useAuth } from '../auth/AuthContext';
import { APP_NAME, auth as authCopy, shell as shellCopy } from '../contracts/copy';
import { AccountMenu } from './AccountMenu';

/**
 * Application shell (docs/architecture.md §7).
 *
 * Signed out: brand + "Sign in" / "Sign up" entries.
 * Signed in: brand + global search + the account menu.
 * Business modules add their repository navigation inside the page content.
 */
export function AppShell({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const { user, loading } = useAuth();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-canvas text-fg font-sans">
      <header className="border-b border-solid border-border bg-subtle">
        <div className="mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl items-center gap-4 px-4 py-3">
          <Link to="/" className="flex items-center gap-2 text-fg no-underline font-600">
            <GitBranch size={20} aria-hidden="true" />
            {APP_NAME}
          </Link>

          <form
            role="search"
            className="flex-1 max-w-md"
            onSubmit={(event) => {
              event.preventDefault();
              const trimmed = query.trim();
              navigate(trimmed ? `/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(trimmed)}` : '/search');
            }}
          >
            <input
              type="search"
              aria-label={shellCopy.search}
              placeholder={shellCopy.search}
              value={query}
              onChange={(event) => setQuery(event.target.value)}
              className="form-input w-full"
            />
          </form>

          <nav className="ml-auto flex items-center gap-3">
            {loading ? null : user ? (
              <AccountMenu />
            ) : (
              <>
                <Link className="text-sm text-accent no-underline" to="/login">
                  {authCopy.signIn}
                </Link>
                <Link className="text-sm text-accent no-underline" to="/register">
                  {authCopy.signUp}
                </Link>
              </>
            )}
          </nav>
        </div>
      </header>

      <main>{children}</main>
    </div>
  );
}

export function requireAuth() {
  return (req, res, next) => {
    if (!req.user) {
      next(unauthorized());
      return;
    }
    next();
  };

## M3 技术方案与验收方案（负责人 @glm-4，2026-09-29）

依据 origin/develop（c338578）上的共享契约：architecture.md §3/§4/§5/§9.1、copy.ts、permissions/index.js、seed 机制。以下为本模块级落地决定；与共享契约冲突处一律以契约为准并在本 Issue 提出。

### 1. API 契约（backend/src/modules/repos/）
- `GET /api/search/repositories?q=`：仅返回 viewer 可见仓库（public，或 effectiveRepoRole ≠ null）。每项含 owner、name、description、visibility、updated_at。未授权私有仓库**不出现**（不泄露存在性）。未登录按访客规则。
- `GET /api/repos/:owner/:name`：不可见 → 404 `notFound`（与不存在同响应，防枚举）。可见 → `{owner, name, description, visibility, default_branch, viewerPermission, fork_source?, files(默认分支树顶层), updated_at}`。
- `POST /api/repos`：`{owner, name, description?, visibility, init_readme}`。命名空间创建权限：个人命名空间仅本人；组织命名空间仅 org Owner（依据 architecture §4：Member 仅可见性）。校验：空名/格式、同命名空间内重名（大小写不敏感）。README 初始化（默认分支 main + 初始 commit + commit_files + 分支指针）在**同一事务**，任一步失败全部回滚。
- `POST /api/repos/:owner/:name/fork`：`{namespace, name?, visibility?}`。源仓库需 read+（无 read → 404）；目标命名空间需创建权限（同上）。私有源**强制 private**（服务端强制，不依赖客户端）。冲突 → 字段错误，不创建。fork 不复制 commit 行：fork 仓库分支直接指向源仓库 commit（repo_id 保留为源仓库），fork 内新 commit 的 repo_id 为 fork 仓库（§9.1）。
- `PATCH /api/repos/:owner/:name`：`{visibility}`，仅 admin+，否则 403 `forbidden`。
- `GET /api/me/namespaces`：当前用户可创建仓库的命名空间 `[{name, kind:'user'|'org'}]`，供 Owner 下拉。

### 2. 更新时间（无 schema 变更）
`updated_at` = 该仓库最新 commit 的 created_at，无 commit 则用 created_at。不新增列；如后续需要独立 updated_at 列，属 schema 契约变更，提交根 Issue #1 裁决。

### 3. copy.ts 增量（PR 内落地，messages.js 镜像，copy-contract.test 校验）
`createRepository`、`fork`、`createFork`、`forkedFrom(name)`、`cloneCodeButton`（'Code'，button）、`copyCloneValue`、`copied`、`https`/`ssh`、`publicBadge`/`privateBadge`、`addReadme`、`owner`/`repositoryName`/`descriptionLabel`、`changeVisibility`、`confirmVisibility`、`general`；errors 增 `repoNameRequired`、`repoNameExists`。"Code" 一名两用：导航为 link、克隆入口为 button，测试按 role+范围区分。

### 4. 前端路由与页面（frontend/src/features/repo/、search/）
`/search?q=`（Enter 直出结果；页内 "Repositories" 类型过滤默认选中，满足场景步骤）、`/new`（Owner 下拉默认个人命名空间）、`/:owner/:repo`（概览：heading 含 owner/name、Public/Private 标记、描述、默认分支、文件列表、Code/Issues/Pull requests 导航 + Code 克隆按钮 + Fork 按钮）、`/:owner/:repo/fork`、`/:owner/:repo/settings`（General → Danger Zone "Change visibility" → 确认对话框：Public radio + "Confirm visibility"，不重输名称）。控件渲染只读 API 的 `viewerPermission`（§9.3）：Settings 链接对协作者可见，"Change visibility" 按钮仅 admin 渲染；Fork 按钮仅登录可见。

### 5. Seed（backend/src/seed/repos.js，注册进 all.js，全部幂等 upsert）
- `alice-dev/acme-docs`（public）：main（默认）+ feature-search；README.md（含 "search flow"）、src/search.ts、docs/；commit "Document search flow"（作者 alice-dev）——即 seed-data.md 中仓库/文件/commit 部分的 M3 份额。
- `alice-dev/secret-research`（private）。
- `alice-dev/acme-docs-fork`（REQ-3-2-2 冲突种子）。
- Acme Demo 组织 + alice-dev Owner + bob-reviewer Member，组织仓库 public/private 各一（若 M2 seed 先建则不覆盖，ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING 共存）。组织仓库具体命名由 PR 负责人定并**补登记进 docs/seed-data.md**。
- repo_grants：bob-reviewer write@acme-docs（seed-data 已列）。

### 6. Vitest（backend/test/repos.test.js）
命名空间创建权限（org Member 不能在组织命名空间建仓、不能在他人个人命名空间建仓）、空名/重名、fork 双侧权限（无源 read → 404；无目标创建权限 → 403）、私有源 fork 强制 private、可见性切换权限（write/maintain 协作者 403、admin 成功）、切换后访问规则（访客立即可见且搜索可见；反向同理）。

### 7. Playwright（e2e/repos.spec.ts）
覆盖 6 条需求场景 + 私密不泄露断言（搜索无结果链接 + 直达被拒）+ 刷新持久化 + clipboard 权限 grant（REQ-3-2-3）。登录 helper 走真实登录 API（已在 develop：POST /api/auth/sign-in，M1/PR #12 不改其形状，见更正记录 comment #29）；原"M1 合入前用临时 session helper"安排作废。访客场景（搜索、公开概览、未授权访问）可立即开展。

### 8. 记录的假设（如被推翻在本 Issue 更正）
1. 组织命名空间建仓权限 = org Owner only（依据 §4 权限映射，非新增契约）。
2. Fork 按钮/克隆入口对未登录访客不渲染（需求仅描述登录态动作；概览对访客仍完全可读）。
3. M3 seed 代建 Acme Demo 组织行与 M2 幂等共存，不改变 M2 对组织治理的所有权。

## 更正：登录 API 已在 develop，M3 无需等待 M1（2026-09-29）

依据 M1 负责人 @deepseek-3 在 PR #11 comment #26 的核实：登录 API 已随基础 PR #2 合入 develop，M1（现为 PR #12）只扩展 forgot/reset/change-password，不修改其形状。推翻 #20 §7 中"M1（#3）合入前登录态场景用临时 session helper 排障"的安排。

现行登录契约（origin/develop，backend/src/modules/identity/router.js）：
- `POST /api/auth/sign-in` `{identifier, password}` → 200 `{user:{...}}` + `Set-Cookie: session=...`（HttpOnly、SameSite=Lax、不带 Secure）；失败一律 401 `invalid_credentials`，不泄露存在性。
- `GET /api/auth/session` → `{user|null}`；`POST /api/auth/sign-out` 清会话。
- seed 账户 alice-dev / bob-reviewer / carol-writer / dave-reader / erin-admin，密码统一 `Valid-password-123!`（docs/seed-data.md）。

落地影响：
- Playwright 登录 helper 直接走真实 sign-in（request context 或 storageState），PR #11 已确认采纳（comment #28）。
- §7 的"合并前改为真实登录路径"前提提前满足，合并前提中不再有对 M1 的依赖；M1（#12）对 M3 剩余影响为零。
- #20 其余契约（API/seed/copy/路由）不变。

### 1. 更正 comment #20 假设 2：克隆入口对访客渲染
REQ-3-2-3 原文明确 "Visitors or signed-in users may use this capability on a repository page"，因此 "Code" 克隆按钮 + popover + "Copy clone value" 对未登录访客渲染（GIVEN 也含"登录且可查看私有仓库"的用户）。**Fork 按钮仍仅登录可见**（REQ-3-2-2 全篇 signed-in），维持 comment #20 §4 的档 a。PR #11 已按此实现并断言（访客：`button "Code"` 恰好 1 个、`button "Fork"` 0 个）。

### 2. 跨任务契约登记（M4a 消费）：文件/目录路由与 contents API
REQ-3-3 自己的 THEN 要求"访客点击文件名进入 file-content page"，只断言链接存在会让该场景不完整，所以 M3 按下列约定实现了**只读最小内容页**，M4a 在同一路由上扩展（分支选择器/提交历史/Commits 入口/diff/Web 编辑），不重复造第二套路由：

- 页面：`/:owner/:repo/blob/:branch/*path`（文件）、`/:owner/:repo/tree/:branch/*path`（目录）
- 数据：`GET /api/repos/:owner/:name/contents?branch=<branch>&path=<path>`
  → `{contents:{type:'file'|'directory', branch, path, name?, content?, commit?:{id,message,createdAt,author}, entries:[{name,type,path,url}]}}`
  不可见仓库与不存在的 branch/path 一律 404（与仓库详情同一防枚举语义）
- M3 的 e2e 同时断言链接的 accessible name 与 **href 值**，M4a 若采用不同路由会立即在 M3 套件里暴露

请 @deepseek-5 之外的相关负责人（M4 负责人）确认或回同步；若 M4 侧已有既定路由，我按契约优先原则改 M3 侧。

### 3. docs 契约冲突待裁决：`architecture.md §7` 与 REQ-3-1（访客全局搜索）
§7 写"未登录（logo + Sign in / Sign up）"，但 REQ-3-1 场景 1 全程未登录并使用"顶部全局搜索框"。实现侧自基础 PR #2 起一直是两种会话状态都渲染搜索框（`AppShell` 无条件渲染 searchbox "Search"），M3 的访客搜索场景因此可跑通。建议把 §7 改为"全局搜索框在登录与未登录态都渲染"；属共享契约文本修订，请根 Issue #1 裁决，我不直接改 `docs/architecture.md`。

### 4. seed 登记（已写入 `docs/seed-data.md`，PR #11 内）

## 根 Issue #1 裁决（#32 各项，2026-09-29）

已对照 requirements.yaml 原文与 head `8aeeed5` 实现核实，并经原生 advisor 独立审查（其逐条核对了 service.js / RepositoryContentsPage.tsx / e2e href 断言与 REQ-4-1/4-2-1/4-3-1/4-3-2 原文）。

### 1. §7 冲突：裁决修订 docs/architecture.md §7（采纳 #32 §3 建议）
REQ-3-1 场景 1 原文以未登录访客使用 "top global search box" 开场，AppShell 自 PR #2 起双态渲染 searchbox "Search"。§7 "未登录（logo + Sign in / Sign up）" 判为文档错误，修订为：**全局搜索框在登录与未登录态都渲染**。由 @deepseek-5 在 PR #11 内完成（§7 修订 + §9 追加修订条目），符合契约变更纪律。

### 2. contents/blob/tree 契约：采纳为 #6/#7 共享基线，附 5 条补充约定
登记文本经审查存在一个会实际炸开的约定缺口和三个语义缺口，发布前随 docs 修订一并写入 architecture.md（由 PR #11 承载）：

1. **编码规则**：页面路由 `:branch` 恒为单个 URL 段，由 `encodeURIComponent(branch)` 产生（分支名可含 `/`，REQ-4-3-2 的 `feature/api-v2` 即种子反例）；`*path` 按段 `encodeURIComponent` 后以 `/` 连接；禁止原始拼接。API 的 branch/path 为 query param 原始字符串，服务端 trim 首尾斜��。
2. **`entries[].url` 消费规则**：同源绝对路径、已按规则 1 完整编码，消费者原样使用，不得二次编码或重建。
3. **裸路由/默认分支语义**：`/:owner/:repo` 恒为默认分支根列表；分支切换 = 导航到 `/tree/<branch>[/<path>]`（分支必须在 URL 中，REQ-4-3-1/4-3-2 的刷新持久化判据强制此点）。
4. **`commit` 字段目标语义**：最后触碰该 path 的提交（REQ-4-1 原文 "most recent commit for that branch and path"）。**M3 现状（分支头 commit）为登记的已知近似**，不阻塞本 PR 合入；实现更正归 M4a（#6）。
5. **空分支 200 vs 缺失 404**：存在但无提交的分支返回 `{type:'directory', entries:[]}`（200）；仅未知 branch/path → 404。实现更正同样归 M4a（空分支在 M4b 建分支能力存在前不可达，M3 验收范围不可观测）。

责任划分：约定 1–3 M3 实现已满足，无需改代码；约定 4–5 的实现归 #6（已在 issue #6 契约登记中同步，指派后由其负责人接续）；diff API 形状留给 M4a 登记，但预先声明**以 commitId 为键**（§9.1，M6a/#9 硬依赖）。

text: /**
 * Repository seed data (docs/seed-data.md — M3 share: repositories, files,
 * branches and commits).
 *
 * Everything is keyed by business identity and written with insert-if-absent, so
 * running the seed again (every application start) never overwrites data a user
 * produced: an advanced branch keeps its head, an edited README keeps its
 * content, a changed password keeps its hash.
 *
 * Repositories must be created *after* the account seed; `seed/all.js` imports
 * this module after `accounts.js`, and the registry preserves that order.
 */
import { registerSeed } from './index.js';

/** Public demo repository (REQ-3-1/3-3 read scenarios). */
export const SEED_PUBLIC_REPO = { owner: 'alice-dev', name: 'acme-docs' };
/** Private repository a visitor must never see (REQ-3-1/3-3/3-4). */
export const SEED_PRIVATE_REPO = { owner: 'alice-dev', name: 'secret-research' };
/** Existing fork name in the personal namespace (REQ-3-2-2 conflict case). */
export const SEED_FORK_CONFLICT_REPO = { owner: 'alice-dev', name: 'acme-docs-fork' };
/** Acme Demo organisation repositories (one public, one private). */
export const SEED_ORG = { name: 'acme-demo', displayName: 'Acme Demo' };
export const SEED_ORG_REPOS = {
  public: { owner: 'acme-demo', name: 'org-handbook' },
  private: { owner: 'acme-demo', name: 'org-private' },
};

const ACME_DOCS_TREES = {
  base: {
    'README.md': '# acme-docs\n\nRepository documentation for the Acme demo project.\n',
    'src/search.ts': 'export function searchRepositories(query: string): string[] {\n  return [];\n}\n',
    'docs/guide.md': '# Guide\n\nHow to browse the acme-docs repository.\n',
  },
  searching: {
    'README.md': '# acme-docs\n\nThis repository documents the **search flow** of the platform.\n',
    'src/search.ts': 'export function searchRepositories(query: string): string[] {\n  return query ? [query] : [];\n}\n',
    'docs/guide.md': '# Guide\n\nHow to browse the acme-docs repository.\n',
  },
};

function userByUsername(db, username) {
  const row = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM users WHERE username = ?').get(username);
  if (!row) throw new Error(`seed(repos): account "${username}" must exist before the repository seed runs`);
  return row;
}

function ensureOrganisation(db, name, displayName) {
  db.prepare('INSERT INTO organizations (name, display_name) VALUES (?, ?) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING').run(
    name,
    displayName,
  );
  return db.prepare('SELECT * FROM organizations WHERE name = ?').get(name);
}

function ensureOrgMember(db, orgId, userId, role) {
  db.prepare('INSERT OR IGNORE INTO org_members (org_id, user_id, role) VALUES (?, ?, ?)').run(orgId, userId, role);
}

/** Insert-if-absent by business key; returns the (possibly pre-existing) row. */
function ensureRepository(db, { ownerUserId = null, ownerOrgId = null, name, description = '', visibility, forkSourceId = null }) {
  const existing =
    ownerUserId != null
      ? db.prepare('SELECT * FROM repos WHERE owner_user_id = ? AND name = ?').get(ownerUserId, name)
      : db.prepare('SELECT * FROM repos WHERE owner_org_id = ? AND name = ?').get(ownerOrgId, name);
  if (existing) return existing;
  return db
    .prepare(
      `INSERT INTO repos (owner_user_id, owner_org_id, name, description, visibility, fork_source_id)
       VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) RETURNING *`,
    )
    .get(ownerUserId, ownerOrgId, name, description, visibility, forkSourceId);
}

/** Commits are keyed by (repository, message) so re-seeding is idempotent. */
function ensureCommit(db, { repoId, authorId, message, tree, parentId = null, files = [] }) {
  const existing = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM commits WHERE repo_id = ? AND message = ?').get(repoId, message);
  if (existing) return existing;
  const commit = db
    .prepare(
      `INSERT INTO commits (repo_id, parent_id, author_id, message, tree_json)
       VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?) RETURNING *`,
    )
    .get(repoId, parentId, authorId, message, JSON.stringify(tree));
  const insertFile = db.prepare(
    'INSERT INTO commit_files (commit_id, path, status, additions, deletions) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',
  );
  for (const file of files) insertFile.run(commit.id, file.path, file.status, file.additions ?? 0, file.deletions ?? 0);
  return commit;
}

function ensureBranch(db, { repoId, name, headCommitId }) {
  const existing = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM branches WHERE repo_id = ? AND name = ?').get(repoId, name);
  if (existing) return existing;
  return db
    .prepare('INSERT INTO branches (repo_id, name, head_commit_id) VALUES (?, ?, ?) RETURNING *')
    .get(repoId, name, headCommitId);
}

text: import type { ReactNode } from 'react';
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import { cx } from '../utils/cx';

export interface SegmentedNavItem {
  /** Exact accessible name of the segment (the count is NOT part of it). */
  label: string;
  to: string;
  active?: boolean;
  /** Optional count badge; rendered aria-hidden so it never enters the name. */
  count?: number;
  icon?: ReactNode;
}

/**
 * Underlined segmented navigation used by Issue/PR lists (docs/ui-reference-notes.md).
 *
 * Count badges are `aria-hidden`, so `getByRole('link', { name: 'Open' })` matches
 * regardless of the number shown next to it.
 */
export function SegmentedNav({ items }: { items: SegmentedNavItem[] }) {
  return (
    <nav className="segmented">
      {items.map((item) => (
        <Link
          key={item.label}
          to={item.to}
          className={cx('segmented-item', item.active && 'segmented-item-active')}
          aria-current={item.active ? 'page' : undefined}
        >
          {item.icon}
          {item.label}
          {typeof item.count === 'number' ? (
            <span className="badge" aria-hidden="true">
              {item.count}
            </span>
          ) : null}
        </Link>
      ))}
    </nav>
  );
}

export default SegmentedNav;
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import type { ReactNode, RefObject } from 'react';
import { cx } from '../utils/cx';

interface MenuRenderApi {
  open: boolean;
  toggle: () => void;
  close: () => void;
  triggerRef: RefObject<HTMLButtonElement>;
}

export interface MenuProps {
  /** Renders the trigger element; attach the returned props to a real <button>. */
  trigger: (api: MenuRenderApi) => ReactNode;
  /** Renders the panel content; use `close` after an action that dismisses it. */
  children: (api: MenuRenderApi) => ReactNode;
  align?: 'start' | 'end';
}

/**
 * Accessible disclosure popover used by the account menu.
 *
 * It deliberately does NOT use `role="menu"`: the entries are real links
 * ("Sign out", "Your organizations", ...) and the requirements assert their link
 * role and name. Keyboard support covers Enter/Space on the trigger, Escape to
 * close (focus returns to the trigger) and Tab/Shift+Tab through the entries.
 */
export function Menu({ trigger, children, align = 'end' }: MenuProps) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const triggerRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const panelRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const close = useCallback(() => {
    setOpen(false);
    triggerRef.current?.focus();
  }, []);

  const toggle = useCallback(() => setOpen((value) => !value), []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const onPointerDown = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      const target = event.target as Node;
      if (panelRef.current?.contains(target) || triggerRef.current?.contains(target)) return;
      setOpen(false);
    };
    const onKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (event.key === 'Escape') {
        event.stopPropagation();
        close();
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', onPointerDown);
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousedown', onPointerDown);
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
    };
  }, [open, close]);

  const api: MenuRenderApi = { open, toggle, close, triggerRef };

  return (
    <div className="relative">
      {trigger(api)}
      {open ? (
        <div
          ref={panelRef}
          className={cx('menu-panel', align === 'end' ? 'right-0' : 'left-0')}
          data-testid="account-menu-panel"
        >
          {children(api)}
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

export default Menu;
import { useId } from 'react';
import type { InputHTMLAttributes, ReactNode, TextareaHTMLAttributes } from 'react';
import { cx } from '../utils/cx';

/**
 * E2E runner: owns the whole check topology.
 *
 *  - reuses the built frontend (or builds it with pnpm),
 *  - starts the backend on a free ephemeral port with a throwaway SQLite
 *    database, exactly like the platform start command (HOST/PORT, no NODE_ENV),
 *  - waits for /api/health before running Playwright,
 *  - always tears down the server it started and removes the temporary data.
 *
 * Usage:
 *   node e2e/run.mjs                    # build if needed, then run all specs
 *   node e2e/run.mjs --no-build         # reuse the existing frontend/dist
 *   node e2e/run.mjs --server "npm run start" --server-cwd backend
 *   node e2e/run.mjs --grep "sign out"  # forward a Playwright grep
 */

function run(command, { cwd, env, label }) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const child = spawn(command, { cwd, env, shell: true, stdio: 'inherit' });
    child.on('close', (code, signal) => resolve({ code: code ?? (signal ? 1 : 0), signal }));
    child.on('error', (error) => {
      console.error(`[e2e] failed to start ${label}:`, error.message);
      resolve({ code: 1, signal: null });
    });
  });
}

async function waitForHealth(baseUrl, child, timeoutMs = 60_000) {
  const deadline = Date.now() + timeoutMs;
  while (Date.now() < deadline) {
    if (child.exitCode !== null) return false;
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/api/health`);
      if (response.ok) return true;
    } catch {
      /* not up yet */
    }
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 300));
  }
  return false;
}

## 技术方案（2026-09-29，PR 负责人 @glm-7 登记）

### 后端（backend/src/modules/orgs/ + backend/src/modules/repos/grants.js）
- `GET /api/orgs`（auth）：当前用户的组织 `[{name, displayName, role}]`（"Your organizations" 页）。
- `POST /api/orgs`（auth）：`{name, displayName}`。校验一次返回全部字段错误：name 空/格式不合规/超长 →
  `Organization name format is invalid`（field `name`）；displayName trim 后为空 → `Display name is required`；
  重名 → `Organization name already exists`（**重名与缺 displayName 同时报**，REQ-2-1-2 明示）。
  事务内建 org + 创建者 owner 成员；201。
- `GET /api/orgs/:name`：`{organization, viewerPermission:{organization, canView}}`；组织页公开（访客可看公共仓库）。
- `GET /api/orgs/:name/repositories`：仅 viewer 可见仓库（public 或 effectiveRepoRole ≠ null；普通 Member 无默认私有访问）。
  每项 `{name, description, visibility, updatedAt}`；updatedAt = 最新 commit created_at，无则 created_at（同 M3 登记）。
- `GET /api/orgs/:name/people`：`{members:[{username, role}]}`，公开。
- `POST /api/orgs/:name/members`（org Owner）：`{usernameOrEmail, role:'member'|'owner'}`；按 username 或 verified email 查账户；
  未知 → `Account not found`；已是成员 → `Account is already a member`；无 Pending/邀请。非 Owner 403。
- `DELETE /api/orgs/:name/members/:username`（org Owner）：事务内级联 = 删 org_members + 该组织内全部 team_members +
  该组织仓库上对该账户的直接 repo_grants（**不删**账户/个人仓库/团队本身/团队授权）；最后一个 Owner 拒绝（422，
  `Cannot remove the last Owner of the organization`，非断言文案，已登记）。
- `GET|POST /api/orgs/:name/teams`、`GET /api/orgs/:name/teams/:team`、`POST|DELETE .../teams/:team/members`（org Owner 写）、
  `PATCH /api/orgs/:name/teams/:team`（改 parent）：团队名 1–50 小写/数字/连字符、不以致连字符开头结尾、组织内唯一 →
  空名/格式不合规 `Team name format is invalid`；重名 `Team name already exists`（登记）；parent 须同组织
  （`Parent team is invalid`，登记）；改 parent 做环检测（自新 parent 沿 parent 链上溯遇到自身）→
  `Cyclic team hierarchy is not allowed`，保持原 parent。加团队成员须为组织成员
  （`Account is not a member of this organization`，登记）。
- `backend/src/modules/repos/grants.js`（挂载在 `/api/repos`，先于 M3 repos router；仅处理 `/:owner/:name/grants`，
  其余 next()）：GET（admin+：grants + 候选 members/teams）；POST `{subjectType:'user'|'team', subject, role}`（admin+，
  org 仓库的 user 须为组织成员、team 须属于该组织；**同 subject 唯一**，重复提交 = 覆盖角色）；PATCH `:grantId` 改角色。
  权限判定复用 `permissions/index.js`（org Owner→admin 已内建）。

### 前端（frontend/src/features/org/）
- 路由：`/settings/organizations`（Your organizations 列表 + `New organization` 链接；接管 M1 占位）、`/orgs/new`、
  `/orgs/:org`（组织概览：heading=组织标识符，nav link `Repositories`/`People`/`Teams`——link role，视觉为 tab）、
  `/orgs/:org/people`、`/orgs/:org/teams`、`/orgs/:org/teams/new`、`/orgs/:org/teams/:team`（heading `org/team`，
  link `Members`/`Settings`）。仓库侧：`/:owner/:repo/settings/access`（Manage access；路由比 M3 的 `/settings` 更具体，
  React Router 排序天然优先；入口链接加在 M3 的 Settings 页 —— **依赖 PR #11 合入后完成**）。
- 组织仓库 tab：textbox `Find a repository` as-you-type 客户端过滤 + 可见性过滤 select（登记：label `Visibility filter`，
  选项 All/Public/Private，非断言名）；结果行 = 精确仓库名链接（可访问名不含 owner 前缀）+ 描述/可见性/更新时间。
- People：Owner 见 `Add member` 按钮 → 展开表单（触发按钮**保留在页面**，提交按钮 `Add member` 按页面顺序在其后，
  REQ-2-2-3 明示）；`Username or email` 字段 + native select `Role`（默认 Member，选项 Member/Owner）；失败保持表单打开。
  每个可移除成员有按钮 `Member menu <username>`（aria-label）→ menuitem `Remove from organization` → 确认按钮 `Remove`；
  唯一 Owner 行不渲染菜单（不可移除）；非 Owner 整组控件缺席（非禁用）。
- 团队 Members：Owner 见 `Add member` → 表单打开期间**隐藏触发按钮**（REQ-2-2-2：当前步骤只暴露一个可操作的
  `Add member`）；字段 `Username`；行按钮 `Remove <username>` 立即移除（无确认）。
- 团队 Settings：native select `Parent team`（选项 = 组织内团队名，排除自身；含 `No parent` 空选项，登记）+ `Save`；
  环错误展示且不改动选择（刷新后仍是原 parent）。
- Manage access：admin（org Owner 或仓库 admin）可见入口与页面；`Add people or teams` 激活时**隐藏触发按钮**；
  picker = textbox `Search`（as-you-type 过滤候选）+ 团队/成员 option（可访问名含团队名）+ select `Role`（Read/Triage/
  Write/Maintain/Admin）+ 按钮 `Add`；既有授权行 = 含主体名的行 + select `Role` + 按钮 `Save`；改角色保存后仍唯一行。
- 私有仓库越权显示：REQ-2-2-3 断言 `Access denied`。M3 现状对"不存在/无权限"统一渲染 `Not found`（防枚举）。
  **跨模块登记（见 Issue #4）**：已登录用户访问不可见仓库 → 页面显示 `Access denied`；访客保持 `Not found`。
  实现落在 M3 的 RepositoryMissing（按会话态区分显示文案），随 PR #11 合入后由本 PR 完成；访客 404 防枚举语义不变。

### Seed（backend/src/seed/governance.js，注册 'governance'，幂等）
- 组织 `acme-demo`（Acme Demo）+ alice-dev owner + bob-reviewer member（与 M3 seed 相同业务键，OR IGNORE 共存）。

### 测试

/**
 * Express middleware factory for repository-scoped routes. The route must have
 * loaded the repository onto `req.repo`.
 * @param {'read'|'triage'|'write'|'maintain'|'admin'} required
 */
export function requireRepoRole(db, required) {
  return (req, res, next) => {
    const repo = req.repo;
    if (!repo) {
      next(new Error('requireRepoRole() needs req.repo to be loaded first'));
      return;
    }
    const role = effectiveRepoRole(db, req.user, repo);
    if (!roleAtLeast(role, required)) {
      next(forbidden());
      return;
    }
    req.repoRole = role;
    next();
  };
}

export interface DialogProps {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  /** Becomes the dialog's accessible name (`getByRole('dialog', { name })`). */
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  children?: ReactNode;
  footer?: ReactNode;
}

/**
 * Radix dialog primitive. The accessible name comes from the title element and
 * the dialog is dismissed with Escape, the overlay, or the buttons in `footer`.
 * No implicit close icon is rendered so the required button set is exact.
 */
export function Dialog({ open, onOpenChange, title, description, children, footer }: DialogProps) {
  return (
    <DialogPrimitive.Root open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogPrimitive.Portal>
        <DialogPrimitive.Overlay className="dialog-overlay" />
        <DialogPrimitive.Content className="dialog-content">
          <DialogPrimitive.Title className="dialog-title">{title}</DialogPrimitive.Title>
          {description ? (
            <DialogPrimitive.Description className="dialog-description">{description}</DialogPrimitive.Description>
          ) : null}
          {children}
          {footer ? <div className="dialog-actions">{footer}</div> : null}
        </DialogPrimitive.Content>
      </DialogPrimitive.Portal>
    </DialogPrimitive.Root>
  );
}

/** Sign in through the UI. */
export async function signIn(page: Page, identifier: string, password: string) {
  await page.goto('/login');
  await page.getByLabel('Username or email', { exact: true }).fill(identifier);
  await page.getByLabel('Password', { exact: true }).fill(password);
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Sign in' }).click();
}
/**
 * E2E runner: owns the whole check topology.
 *
 *  - reuses the built frontend (or builds it with pnpm),
 *  - starts the backend on a free ephemeral port with a throwaway SQLite
 *    database, exactly like the platform start command (HOST/PORT, no NODE_ENV),
 *  - waits for /api/health before running Playwright,
 *  - always tears down the server it started and removes the temporary data.
 *
 * Usage:
 *   node e2e/run.mjs                    # build if needed, then run all specs
 *   node e2e/run.mjs --no-build         # reuse the existing frontend/dist
 *   node e2e/run.mjs --server "npm run start" --server-cwd backend
 *   node e2e/run.mjs --grep "sign out"  # forward a Playwright grep
 */

async function main() {
  const options = parseArgs(process.argv.slice(2));
  const distIndex = path.join(rootDir, 'frontend', 'dist', 'index.html');

  if (!fs.existsSync(distIndex)) {
    if (!options.build) {
      console.error('[e2e] frontend/dist/index.html is missing and --no-build was given');
      process.exit(1);
    }
    console.log('[e2e] frontend/dist missing — building the frontend first');
    const build = await run('pnpm --dir frontend run build', { cwd: rootDir, env: process.env, label: 'build' });
    if (build.code !== 0) {
      console.error('[e2e] frontend build failed');
      process.exit(build.code);
    }
  }

  const port = await freePort();
  const baseUrl = `http://127.0.0.1:${port}`;
  const dataDir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'simplihub-e2e-'));
  const logPath = path.join(dataDir, 'server.log');
  const logStream = fs.createWriteStream(logPath);

  const serverEnv = {
    ...process.env,
    HOST: '127.0.0.1',
    PORT: String(port),
    DB_PATH: path.join(dataDir, 'app.db'),
  };

  console.log(`[e2e] application node: ${appNode} (${nodeVersion(appNode)})`);
  console.log(`[e2e] starting "${options.server}" in ${options.serverCwd} on ${baseUrl} (db: ${serverEnv.DB_PATH})`);
  const server = spawn(options.server, {
    cwd: path.join(rootDir, options.serverCwd),
    env: serverEnv,
    shell: true,
    detached: true,
    stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'],
  });
  server.stdout.pipe(logStream);
  server.stderr.pipe(logStream);
  server.stdout.on('data', (chunk) => process.stdout.write(`[server] ${chunk}`));
  server.stderr.on('data', (chunk) => process.stderr.write(`[server] ${chunk}`));

  const stopServer = () => {
    if (server.exitCode === null && server.pid) {
      try {
        process.kill(-server.pid, 'SIGTERM');
      } catch {
        /* already gone */
      }
    }
  };
  process.on('SIGINT', () => {
    stopServer();
    process.exit(130);
  });
  process.on('SIGTERM', () => {
    stopServer();
    process.exit(143);
  });

  let exitCode = 1;
  try {
    const healthy = await waitForHealth(baseUrl, server);
    if (!healthy) {
      console.error(`[e2e] server did not become healthy; see ${logPath}`);
      const tail = fs.readFileSync(logPath, 'utf8').split('\n').slice(-30).join('\n');
      console.error(tail);
      exitCode = 1;
    } else {
      const playwrightArgs = ['test'];
      if (options.grep) playwrightArgs.push('--grep', options.grep);
      const result = await run(
        `"${path.join(rootDir, 'node_modules', '.bin', 'playwright')}" ${playwrightArgs.join(' ')}`,
        { cwd: rootDir, env: { ...process.env, BASE_URL: baseUrl }, label: 'playwright' },
      );
      exitCode = result.code;
    }
  } finally {
    stopServer();
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 300));
    logStream.end();
    if (exitCode === 0) fs.rmSync(dataDir, { recursive: true, force: true });
    else console.error(`[e2e] server log kept at ${logPath}`);
  }

  console.log(`[e2e] exit code ${exitCode} (base url ${baseUrl})`);
  process.exit(exitCode);
}

main().catch((error) => {
  console.error('[e2e] runner error:', error);
  process.exit(1);
});

    .prepare(`INSERT INTO organizations (name, display_name) VALUES ('acme-demo', 'Acme Demo') RETURNING *`)
    .get();
  db.prepare(`INSERT INTO org_members (org_id, user_id, role) VALUES (?, ?, 'owner')`).run(org.id, alice.id);
  db.prepare(`INSERT INTO org_members (org_id, user_id, role) VALUES (?, ?, 'member')`).run(org.id, bob.id);

  const parentTeam = db
    .prepare(`INSERT INTO teams (org_id, name, parent_team_id) VALUES (?, 'platform-team', NULL) RETURNING *`)
    .get(org.id);
  const childTeam = db
    .prepare(`INSERT INTO teams (org_id, name, parent_team_id) VALUES (?, 'frontend-child', ?) RETURNING *`)
    .get(org.id, parentTeam.id);

  const orgRepo = db
    .prepare(
      `INSERT INTO repos (owner_org_id, name, visibility) VALUES (?, 'acme-docs', 'private') RETURNING *`,
    )
    .get(org.id);
  const personalRepo = db
    .prepare(
      `INSERT INTO repos (owner_user_id, name, visibility) VALUES (?, 'secret-research', 'private') RETURNING *`,
    )
    .get(alice.id);

  return { alice, bob, carol, dave, org, orgRepo, personalRepo, parentTeam, childTeam };
}

[2] type: toolCall
id: call_24e66ca7d3b74dae94decd15
name: write
arguments: path: backend/src/modules/orgs/router.js
content: /**
 * Organizations & governance module (REQ-2, docs/architecture.md §3/§4/§5).
 *
 * Read endpoints of the public organization pages are open to visitors; every
 * write endpoint requires the organization Owner role (REQ-2-2: "Only an
 * organization Owner may maintain members or hierarchy"). Permission checks all
 * go through `permissions/index.js` — the single implementation of the model
 * (org Owner → admin, direct/team grants take the highest, hierarchy never
 * propagates).
 */
import { Router } from 'express';
import { transact } from '../../db/index.js';
import { requireAuth } from '../../auth/middleware.js';
import { ApiError, fieldError, forbidden, notFound, validationError } from '../../http/errors.js';
import { messages } from '../../contracts/messages.js';
import {
  collectErrors,
  validateDisplayName,
  validateOrgName,
  validateTeamName,
} from '../../http/validate.js';
import { effectiveRepoRole, orgRole } from '../../permissions/index.js';

/** `Member`/`Owner` (UI labels) and `member`/`owner` are both accepted. */
function normalizeOrgRole(raw) {
  const value = typeof raw === 'string' ? raw.trim().toLowerCase() : '';
  if (value === 'member' || value === 'owner') return value;
  return null;
}

/** Latest commit time of a repository, falling back to its creation time. */
function repoUpdatedAt(db, repo) {
  const row = db.prepare('SELECT MAX(created_at) AS at FROM commits WHERE repo_id = ?').get(repo.id);
  return row?.at ?? repo.created_at;
}

/**
 * Resolve the organization by identifier or throw 404. Only the identifier is
 * matched (never the display name), so nothing about display names leaks.
 */
function loadOrg(db, name) {
  const org = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM organizations WHERE name = ?').get(String(name));
  if (!org) throw notFound();
  return org;
}

/** Owner gate for every write endpoint (REQ-2-2). */
function requireOrgOwner(db, req, org) {
  if (orgRole(db, req.user, org.id) !== 'owner') throw forbidden();
}

/** Find an account by username or verified email (REQ-2-2-3). */
function findAccount(db, identifier) {
  const value = String(identifier ?? '').trim();
  if (!value) return null;
  return db
    .prepare('SELECT * FROM users WHERE username = ? OR (email = ? AND email_verified = 1)')
    .get(value, value.toLowerCase());
}

/** Public shape of an organization row. */
function publicOrg(org) {
  return { name: org.name, displayName: org.display_name, createdAt: org.created_at };
}

/**
 * Repositories of the organization visible to `user`: public ones always,
 * private ones only with a non-null effective role (an ordinary organization
 * Member has no default private access — REQ-2-3).
 */
function visibleOrgRepositories(db, user, org) {
  const repos = db
    .prepare('SELECT * FROM repos WHERE owner_org_id = ? ORDER BY name')
    .all(org.id);
  return repos
    .filter((repo) => repo.visibility === 'public' || effectiveRepoRole(db, user, repo) != null)
    .map((repo) => ({
      name: repo.name,
      description: repo.description,
      visibility: repo.visibility,
      updatedAt: repoUpdatedAt(db, repo),
    }));
}

/** True when setting `team`'s parent to `newParentId` would create a cycle. */
function wouldCreateCycle(db, team, newParentId) {
  let cursor = newParentId;
  const seen = new Set();
  while (cursor != null && !seen.has(cursor)) {
    if (cursor === team.id) return true;
    seen.add(cursor);
    const row = db.prepare('SELECT parent_team_id AS parent FROM teams WHERE id = ?').get(cursor);
    cursor = row?.parent ?? null;
  }
  return false;
}

export function createOrgsRouter({ db }) {
  const router = Router();

  /** "Your organizations" (REQ-2-1-2): the current user's memberships. */
  router.get('/', requireAuth, (req, res) => {
    const organizations = db
      .prepare(
        `SELECT o.name, o.display_name, m.role
           FROM org_members m JOIN organizations o ON o.id = m.org_id
          WHERE m.user_id = ? ORDER BY o.name`,
      )
      .all(req.user.id)
      .map((row) => ({ name: row.name, displayName: row.display_name, role: row.role }));
    res.json({ organizations });
  });

  /** Create an organization (REQ-2-1-2). All field problems are reported at once. */
  router.post('/', requireAuth, (req, res) => {
    const body = req.body ?? {};
    const name = validateOrgName(body.name);
    const displayName = validateDisplayName(body.displayName ?? body.display_name);

    const errors = collectErrors([name, displayName]);
    if (name.ok) {
      const existing = db.prepare('SELECT id FROM organizations WHERE name = ?').get(name.value);
      // The duplicate identifier is reported even when the display name is also
      // missing (REQ-2-1-2: both messages on one submission).
      if (existing) {
        errors.unshift(fieldError('org_name_exists', messages.ORG_NAME_EXISTS, 'name'));
      }
    }
    if (errors.length) throw validationError(errors);

    const org = transact(db, () => {
      const created = db
        .prepare('INSERT INTO organizations (name, display_name) VALUES (?, ?) RETURNING *')
        .get(name.value, displayName.value);
      db.prepare("INSERT INTO org_members (org_id, user_id, role) VALUES (?, ?, 'owner')").run(
        created.id,
        req.user.id,
      );
      return created;
    });

    res.status(201).json({ organization: publicOrg(org) });
  });

  /** Organization overview (public — visitors browse public organization pages). */
  router.get('/:org', (req, res) => {
    const org = loadOrg(db, req.params.org);
    res.json({
      organization: publicOrg(org),
      viewerPermission: { organization: orgRole(db, req.user, org.id), canView: true },
    });
  });

  /** Repositories tab (REQ-2-1-1): only repositories visible to the current user. */
  router.get('/:org/repositories', (req, res) => {
    const org = loadOrg(db, req.params.org);
    res.json({
      organization: publicOrg(org),
      repositories: visibleOrgRepositories(db, req.user, org),
      viewerPermission: { organization: orgRole(db, req.user, org.id), canView: true },
    });
  });

  /** People tab (REQ-2-2-3/2-2-4): the member list with Member/Owner roles. */
  router.get('/:org/people', (req, res) => {
    const org = loadOrg(db, req.params.org);
    const members = db
      .prepare(
        `SELECT u.username, m.role
           FROM org_members m JOIN users u ON u.id = m.user_id
          WHERE m.org_id = ? ORDER BY u.username`,
      )
      .all(org.id);
    res.json({
      organization: publicOrg(org),
      members,
      viewerPermission: { organization: orgRole(db, req.user, org.id), canView: true },
    });
  });

  /** Directly add a member (REQ-2-2-3) — Owner only, no invitation step. */
  router.post('/:org/members', requireAuth, (req, res) => {
    const org = loadOrg(db, req.params.org);
    requireOrgOwner(db, req, org);

    const body = req.body ?? {};
    const role = normalizeOrgRole(body.role ?? 'member');
    const errors = [];
    if (!role) errors.push(fieldError('role_invalid', messages.ROLE_INVALID, 'role'));
    const identifier = String(body.usernameOrEmail ?? body.username ?? '').trim();
    const account = identifier ? findAccount(db, identifier) : null;
    if (!account) errors.push(fieldError('account_not_found', messages.ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND, 'usernameOrEmail'));
    if (account) {
      const existing = db
        .prepare('SELECT 1 FROM org_members WHERE org_id = ? AND user_id = ?')
        .get(org.id, account.id);
      if (existing) {
        errors.push(fieldError('account_already_member', messages.ACCOUNT_ALREADY_MEMBER, 'usernameOrEmail'));
      }
    }
    if (errors.length) throw validationError(errors);

    transact(db, () => {
      db.prepare('INSERT INTO org_members (org_id, user_id, role) VALUES (?, ?, ?)').run(
        org.id,
        account.id,
        role,
      );
    });
    res.status(201).json({ member: { username: account.username, role } });
  });

  /**
   * Remove a member (REQ-2-2-4). Atomically deletes the organization membership,
   * all team memberships in this organization and all direct grants on this
   * organization's repositories. The account, personal repositories, the teams
   * themselves and team grants are never touched.
   */
  router.delete('/:org/members/:username', requireAuth, (req, res) => {
    const org = loadOrg(db, req.params.org);
    requireOrgOwner(db, req, org);

    const target = db
      .prepare(
        `SELECT u.id, u.username, m.role FROM org_members m
           JOIN users u ON u.id = m.user_id
          WHERE m.org_id = ? AND u.username = ?`,
      )
      .get(org.id, req.params.username);
    if (!target) throw notFound();

    const ownerCount = db
      .prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM org_members WHERE org_id = ? AND role = 'owner'")
      .get(org.id).n;
    if (target.role === 'owner' && ownerCount <= 1) {
      throw new ApiError(422, 'cannot_remove_last_owner', messages.CANNOT_REMOVE_LAST_OWNER);
    }

    transact(db, () => {
      db.prepare('DELETE FROM org_members WHERE org_id = ? AND user_id = ?').run(org.id, target.id);
      db.prepare(
        `DELETE FROM team_members WHERE user_id = ? AND team_id IN (SELECT id FROM teams WHERE org_id = ?)`,
      ).run(target.id, org.id);
      db.prepare(
        `DELETE FROM repo_grants WHERE subject_user_id = ? AND repo_id IN (SELECT id FROM repos WHERE owner_org_id = ?)`,
      ).run(target.id, org.id);
    });
    res.json({ ok: true });
  });

  /** Teams tab (REQ-2-2-1): the organization's teams with their parents. */
  router.get('/:org/teams', (req, res) => {
    const org = loadOrg(db, req.params.org);
    const teams = db
      .prepare(
        `SELECT t.name, t.description, p.name AS parent
           FROM teams t LEFT JOIN teams p ON p.id = t.parent_team_id
          WHERE t.org_id = ? ORDER BY t.name`,
      )
      .all(org.id);
    res.json({
      organization: publicOrg(org),
      teams,
      viewerPermission: { organization: orgRole(db, req.user, org.id), canView: true },
    });
  });

  /** Create a team (REQ-2-2-1) — Owner only. */
  router.post('/:org/teams', requireAuth, (req, res) => {
    const org = loadOrg(db, req.params.org);
    requireOrgOwner(db, req, org);

    const body = req.body ?? {};
    const name = validateTeamName(body.name);
    const description = typeof body.description === 'string' ? body.description.trim() : '';
    const errors = collectErrors([name]);
    if (name.ok) {
      const existing = db
        .prepare('SELECT id FROM teams WHERE org_id = ? AND name = ?')
        .get(org.id, name.value);
      if (existing) errors.push(fieldError('team_name_exists', messages.TEAM_NAME_EXISTS, 'name'));
    }

    let parentTeamId = null;
    const parentName = typeof body.parentTeam === 'string' ? body.parentTeam.trim() : '';
    if (parentName) {
      const parent = db
        .prepare('SELECT id FROM teams WHERE org_id = ? AND name = ?')
        .get(org.id, parentName);
      if (!parent) {
        errors.push(fieldError('parent_team_invalid', messages.PARENT_TEAM_INVALID, 'parentTeam'));
      } else {
        parentTeamId = parent.id;
      }
    }
    if (errors.length) throw validationError(errors);

    const team = transact(db, () =>
      db
        .prepare('INSERT INTO teams (org_id, name, description, parent_team_id) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?) RETURNING *')
        .get(org.id, name.value, description, parentTeamId),
    );
    res.status(201).json({ team: { name: team.name, description: team.description, parent: parentName || null } });
  });

  /** Team detail page (REQ-2-2-2) — heading is `org/team`. */
  router.get('/:org/teams/:team', (req, res) => {
    const org = loadOrg(db, req.params.org);
    const team = db
      .prepare(
        `SELECT t.*, p.name AS parent_name FROM teams t
           LEFT JOIN teams p ON p.id = t.parent_team_id
          WHERE t.org_id = ? AND t.name = ?`,
      )
      .get(org.id, req.params.team);
    if (!team) throw notFound();
    res.json({
      organization: publicOrg(org),
      team: {
        name: team.name,
        description: team.description,
        parent: team.parent_name ?? null,
      },
      viewerPermission: { organization: orgRole(db, req.user, org.id), canView: true },
    });
  });

  /** Change the parent team (REQ-2-2-2) — cycles are rejected, original kept. */
  router.patch('/:org/teams/:team', requireAuth, (req, res) => {
    const org = loadOrg(db, req.params.org);
    requireOrgOwner(db, req, org);
    const team = db
      .prepare('SELECT * FROM teams WHERE org_id = ? AND name = ?')
      .get(org.id, req.params.team);
    if (!team) throw notFound();

    const body = req.body ?? {};
    const rawParent = body.parentTeam ?? body.parent_team;
    let parentTeamId = null;
    let parentName = null;
    if (rawParent != null && String(rawParent).trim() !== '') {
      const parent = db
        .prepare('SELECT * FROM teams WHERE org_id = ? AND name = ?')
        .get(org.id, String(rawParent).trim());
      if (!parent) {
        throw validationError([fieldError('parent_team_invalid', messages.PARENT_TEAM_INVALID, 'parentTeam')]);
      }
      if (wouldCreateCycle(db, team, parent.id)) {
        // Rejected without writing: the original parent is kept (REQ-2-2-2).
        throw new ApiError(422, 'cyclic_team_hierarchy', messages.CYCLIC_TEAM_HIERARCHY);
      }
      parentTeamId = parent.id;
      parentName = parent.name;
    }

    transact(db, () => {
      db.prepare('UPDATE teams SET parent_team_id = ? WHERE id = ?').run(parentTeamId, team.id);
    });
    res.json({ team: { name: team.name, description: team.description, parent: parentName } });
  });

  /** Team Members tab (REQ-2-2-2): the team's direct members. */
  router.get('/:org/teams/:team/members', (req, res) => {
    const org = loadOrg(db, req.params.org);
    const team = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM teams WHERE org_id = ? AND name = ?').get(org.id, req.params.team);
    if (!team) throw notFound();
    const members = db
      .prepare(
        `SELECT u.username FROM team_members tm JOIN users u ON u.id = tm.user_id
          WHERE tm.team_id = ? ORDER BY u.username`,
      )
      .all(team.id);
    res.json({
      team: { name: team.name },
      members,
      viewerPermission: { organization: orgRole(db, req.user, org.id), canView: true },
    });
  });

  /** Add a team member (REQ-2-2-2) — Owner only; must be an organization member. */
  router.post('/:org/teams/:team/members', requireAuth, (req, res) => {
    const org = loadOrg(db, req.params.org);
    requireOrgOwner(db, req, org);
    const team = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM teams WHERE org_id = ? AND name = ?').get(org.id, req.params.team);
    if (!team) throw notFound();

    const account = findAccount(db, req.body?.username);
    if (!account) {
      throw validationError([fieldError('account_not_found', messages.ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND, 'username')]);
    }
    const isMember = db.prepare('SELECT 1 FROM org_members WHERE org_id = ? AND user_id = ?').get(org.id, account.id);
    if (!isMember) {
      throw validationError([
        fieldError('account_not_org_member', messages.ACCOUNT_NOT_ORG_MEMBER, 'username'),
      ]);
    }

    // Team membership is idempotent: adding twice leaves one relationship.
    transact(db, () => {
      db.prepare('INSERT OR IGNORE INTO team_members (team_id, user_id) VALUES (?, ?)').run(team.id, account.id);
    });
    res.status(201).json({ member: { username: account.username } });
  });

  /** Remove a team member (REQ-2-2-2) — Owner only, immediate, no confirmation. */
  router.delete('/:org/teams/:team/members/:username', requireAuth, (req, res) => {
    const org = loadOrg(db, req.params.org);
    requireOrgOwner(db, req, org);
    const team = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM teams WHERE org_id = ? AND name = ?').get(org.id, req.params.team);
    if (!team) throw notFound();
    const account = db.prepare('SELECT id FROM users WHERE username = ?').get(req.params.username);
    if (!account) throw notFound();
    transact(db, () => {
      db.prepare('DELETE FROM team_members WHERE team_id = ? AND user_id = ?').run(team.id, account.id);
    });
    res.json({ ok: true });
  });

  return router;
}

name: write
arguments: content: /**
 * Repository access grants (REQ-2-3, docs/architecture.md §4).
 *
 * Mounted at `/api/repos` *before* the M3 repository router and handles only the
 * `/:owner/:name/grants` subtree — every other request falls through with
 * `next()`, so both routers can coexist without merge conflicts.
 *
 * Every write operation requires an effective role of admin (organization Owner
 * or repository Admin). For a given subject and repository exactly one grant is
 * stored: POST is an upsert (saving again replaces the role) and PATCH changes
 * the role of an existing grant.
 */
import { Router } from 'express';
import { transact } from '../../db/index.js';
import { fieldError, forbidden, notFound, validationError } from '../../http/errors.js';
import { messages } from '../../contracts/messages.js';
import { isRepoRole, orgRole, roleAtLeast, effectiveRepoRole } from '../../permissions/index.js';

/** Resolve `/:owner/:name` to a repository row (user or organization owner). */
function loadRepo(db, owner, name) {
  const repo = db
    .prepare(
      `SELECT r.* FROM repos r
         LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = r.owner_user_id
         LEFT JOIN organizations o ON o.id = r.owner_org_id
        WHERE (u.username = ? OR o.name = ?) AND r.name = ?`,
    )
    .get(owner, owner, name);
  return repo ?? null;
}

function loadGrants(db, repoId) {
  return db
    .prepare(
      `SELECT g.id, g.role, g.subject_user_id, g.subject_team_id,
              u.username AS user_name, t.name AS team_name
         FROM repo_grants g
         LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = g.subject_user_id
         LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = g.subject_team_id
        WHERE g.repo_id = ?
        ORDER BY COALESCE(u.username, t.name)`,
    )
    .all(repoId)
    .map((row) =>
      row.user_name != null
        ? { id: row.id, subjectType: 'user', name: row.user_name, role: row.role }
        : { id: row.id, subjectType: 'team', name: row.team_name, role: row.role },
    );
}

export function createGrantsRouter({ db }) {
  const router = Router();

  router.get('/:owner/:name/grants', (req, res, next) => {
    const repo = loadRepo(db, req.params.owner, req.params.name);
    if (!repo) {
      // Not this router's concern beyond 404 semantics — no existence leak
      // difference: the caller needs admin anyway.
      next();
      return;
    }
    const role = effectiveRepoRole(db, req.user, repo);
    if (!roleAtLeast(role, 'admin')) {
      next(forbidden());
      return;
    }

    // Grant candidates: current organization members and the organization's
    // teams (REQ-2-3). Personal repositories offer all accounts and no teams.
    const members = repo.owner_org_id
      ? db
          .prepare(
            `SELECT u.username FROM org_members m JOIN users u ON u.id = m.user_id
              WHERE m.org_id = ? ORDER BY u.username`,
          )
          .all(repo.owner_org_id)
      : db.prepare('SELECT username FROM users ORDER BY username').all();
    const teams = repo.owner_org_id
      ? db.prepare('SELECT name FROM teams WHERE org_id = ? ORDER BY name').all(repo.owner_org_id)
      : [];

    res.json({
      grants: loadGrants(db, repo.id),
      members: members.map((row) => row.username),
      teams: teams.map((row) => row.name),
      viewerPermission: { repository: role },
    });
  });

  /** Add (or re-save) a grant. Same subject ⇒ same single record, role replaced. */
  router.post('/:owner/:name/grants', (req, res, next) => {
    const repo = loadRepo(db, req.params.owner, req.params.name);
    if (!repo) {
      next();
      return;
    }
    if (!roleAtLeast(effectiveRepoRole(db, req.user, repo), 'admin')) {
      next(forbidden());
      return;
    }

    const body = req.body ?? {};
    const subjectType = body.subjectType === 'team' ? 'team' : body.subjectType === 'user' ? 'user' : null;
    const subject = String(body.subject ?? '').trim();
    const errors = [];
    if (!subjectType) errors.push(fieldError('role_invalid', messages.ROLE_INVALID, 'subjectType'));
    if (!subject) errors.push(fieldError('subject_required', messages.ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND, 'subject'));
    if (!isRepoRole(body.role)) errors.push(fieldError('role_invalid', messages.ROLE_INVALID, 'role'));
    if (errors.length) throw validationError(errors);

    let subjectUserId = null;
    let subjectTeamId = null;
    if (subjectType === 'user') {
      const user = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM users WHERE username = ?').get(subject);
      if (!user) {
        throw validationError([fieldError('account_not_found', messages.ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND, 'subject')]);
      }
      if (repo.owner_org_id) {
        const isMember = db
          .prepare('SELECT 1 FROM org_members WHERE org_id = ? AND user_id = ?')
          .get(repo.owner_org_id, user.id);
        if (!isMember) {
          throw validationError([
            fieldError('account_not_org_member', messages.ACCOUNT_NOT_ORG_MEMBER, 'subject'),
          ]);
        }
      }
      subjectUserId = user.id;
    } else {
      const team = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM teams WHERE name = ?').get(subject);
      if (!team || team.org_id !== repo.owner_org_id) {
        throw validationError([
          fieldError('team_not_in_org', messages.TEAM_NOT_IN_ORG, 'subject'),
        ]);
      }
      subjectTeamId = team.id;
    }

    const grant = transact(db, () => {
      const column = subjectType === 'user' ? 'subject_user_id' : 'subject_team_id';
      const subjectId = subjectType === 'user' ? subjectUserId : subjectTeamId;
      const existing = db
        .prepare(`SELECT id FROM repo_grants WHERE repo_id = ? AND ${column} = ?`)
        .get(repo.id, subjectId);
      if (existing) {
        return db
          .prepare('UPDATE repo_grants SET role = ? WHERE id = ? RETURNING *')
          .get(body.role, existing.id);
      }
      return db
        .prepare(
          `INSERT INTO repo_grants (repo_id, subject_user_id, subject_team_id, role)
           VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?) RETURNING *`,
        )
        .get(repo.id, subjectUserId, subjectTeamId, body.role);
    });

    res.status(201).json({
      grant: {
        id: grant.id,
        subjectType,
        name: subject,
        role: grant.role,
      },
    });
  });

  /** Change the role of an existing grant (REQ-2-3 replacement scenario). */
  router.patch('/:owner/:name/grants/:grantId', (req, res, next) => {
    const repo = loadRepo(db, req.params.owner, req.params.name);
    if (!repo) {
      next();
      return;
    }
    if (!roleAtLeast(effectiveRepoRole(db, req.user, repo), 'admin')) {
      next(forbidden());
      return;
    }
    const grant = db
      .prepare('SELECT * FROM repo_grants WHERE id = ? AND repo_id = ?')
      .get(Number(req.params.grantId), repo.id);
    if (!grant) throw notFound();
    if (!isRepoRole(req.body?.role)) {
      throw validationError([fieldError('role_invalid', messages.ROLE_INVALID, 'role')]);
    }
    const updated = transact(db, () =>
      db.prepare('UPDATE repo_grants SET role = ? WHERE id = ? RETURNING *').get(req.body.role, grant.id),
    );
    res.json({ grant: { id: updated.id, role: updated.role } });
  });

  return router;
}

export default createGrantsRouter;

 * Governance seed (docs/seed-data.md — M2 share: organization members, teams,

 * Every write is keyed by business identity and insert-if-absent, so running
 * the seed again (every application start) never overwrites data a user
 * produced. The organization and the organization repositories use the same
 * business keys as the M3 repository seed (`seed/repos.js`): both seeds may run
 * in either order and the result is identical.
 */
import { registerSeed } from './index.js';

export const SEED_GOVERNANCE_ORG = { name: 'acme-demo', displayName: 'Acme Demo' };
export const SEED_GOVERNANCE_ORG_REPOS = {
  public: { name: 'org-handbook', visibility: 'public' },
  private: { name: 'org-private', visibility: 'private' },
};
export const SEED_GOVERNANCE_TEAMS = [
  { name: 'frontend-team', description: 'Frontend development team', parent: null },
  { name: 'platform-team', description: 'Platform and infrastructure team', parent: null },
  { name: 'frontend-child', description: 'Child team for hierarchy demonstrations', parent: 'platform-team' },
];

export function seedGovernance(db) {
  const userByUsername = (username) =>
    db.prepare('SELECT * FROM users WHERE username = ?').get(username);

  const alice = userByUsername('alice-dev');
  const bob = userByUsername('bob-reviewer');
  if (!alice || !bob) {
    throw new Error('seed(governance): accounts "alice-dev"/"bob-reviewer" must exist before this seed runs');
  }

  // Organization + memberships (same business keys as the M3 repository seed;
  // existing roles are never overwritten).
  db.prepare(
    'INSERT INTO organizations (name, display_name) VALUES (?, ?) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING',
  ).run(SEED_GOVERNANCE_ORG.name, SEED_GOVERNANCE_ORG.displayName);
  const org = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM organizations WHERE name = ?').get(SEED_GOVERNANCE_ORG.name);

  const ensureOrgMember = db.prepare('INSERT OR IGNORE INTO org_members (org_id, user_id, role) VALUES (?, ?, ?)');
  ensureOrgMember.run(org.id, alice.id, 'owner');
  ensureOrgMember.run(org.id, bob.id, 'member');

  // Organization repositories (one public, one private) — insert-if-absent so
  // the M3 seed and this seed can create/see the same rows in either order.
  for (const repo of Object.values(SEED_GOVERNANCE_ORG_REPOS)) {
    const existing = db
      .prepare('SELECT id FROM repos WHERE owner_org_id = ? AND name = ?')
      .get(org.id, repo.name);
    if (!existing) {
      db.prepare(
        `INSERT INTO repos (owner_org_id, name, description, visibility) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)`,
      ).run(org.id, repo.name, `Acme Demo ${repo.visibility} demonstration repository`, repo.visibility);
    }
  }

  // Teams + hierarchy (REQ-2-2-2 cycle scenario: frontend-child under platform-team).
  const teamIds = new Map();
  for (const team of SEED_GOVERNANCE_TEAMS) {
    db.prepare(
      'INSERT INTO teams (org_id, name, description) VALUES (?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING',
    ).run(org.id, team.name, team.description);
    const row = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM teams WHERE org_id = ? AND name = ?').get(org.id, team.name);
    teamIds.set(team.name, row.id);
  }
  const setParent = db.prepare('UPDATE teams SET parent_team_id = ? WHERE id = ? AND parent_team_id IS NULL');
  for (const team of SEED_GOVERNANCE_TEAMS) {
    if (team.parent) {
      // Only fills an unset parent, so a parent changed through the UI survives.
      setParent.run(teamIds.get(team.parent), teamIds.get(team.name));
    }
  }

  // Direct team membership (REQ-2-2 scenarios) — never removed by re-seeding.
  db.prepare('INSERT OR IGNORE INTO team_members (team_id, user_id) VALUES (?, ?)').run(
    teamIds.get('frontend-team'),
    bob.id,
  );

  // Existing Write grant for the REQ-2-3 role-replacement scenario.
  const handbook = db
    .prepare('SELECT id FROM repos WHERE owner_org_id = ? AND name = ?')
    .get(org.id, SEED_GOVERNANCE_ORG_REPOS.public.name);
  if (handbook) {
    db.prepare(
      `INSERT OR IGNORE INTO repo_grants (repo_id, subject_team_id, role) VALUES (?, ?, 'write')`,
    ).run(handbook.id, teamIds.get('frontend-team'));
  }
}

registerSeed('governance', seedGovernance);

describe('governance seed (idempotent)', () => {
  it('can run twice without changing or duplicating anything', () => {
    const db = createTestDb();
    const before = {
      orgs: db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM organizations').get().n,
      members: db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM org_members').get().n,
      teams: db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM teams').get().n,
      teamMembers: db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM team_members').get().n,
      repos: db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM repos WHERE owner_org_id IS NOT NULL").get().n,
      grants: db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM repo_grants').get().n,
    };
    runSeeds(db, { logger: { error: () => {} } });
    const after = {
      orgs: db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM organizations').get().n,
      members: db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM org_members').get().n,
      teams: db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM teams').get().n,
      teamMembers: db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM team_members').get().n,
      repos: db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM repos WHERE owner_org_id IS NOT NULL").get().n,
      grants: db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM repo_grants').get().n,
    };
    expect(after).toEqual(before);

    const child = db.prepare("SELECT parent_team_id FROM teams WHERE name = 'frontend-child'").get();
    const platform = db.prepare("SELECT id FROM teams WHERE name = 'platform-team'").get();
    expect(child.parent_team_id).toBe(platform.id);
    const grant = db
      .prepare(
        `SELECT g.role FROM repo_grants g JOIN teams t ON t.id = g.subject_team_id
         WHERE t.name = 'frontend-team'`,
      )
      .get();
    expect(grant?.role).toBe('write');
  });
});

    const server = await startTestServer();

      const client = createClient(server.baseUrl);
      await client.post('/api/auth/sign-in', { identifier: 'alice-dev', password: 'Valid-password-123!' });
      const result = await client.post('/api/orgs', { name: '-invalid-organization', displayName: 'X' });
      expect(result.status).toBe(422);
      expect(result.data.error.message).toBe('Organization name format is invalid');
      expect(result.data.error.field).toBe('name');
    } finally {
      await server.close();
    }
  });

    const server = await startTestServer();
    try {
      const client = createClient(server.baseUrl);
      const result = await client.post('/api/orgs', { name: 'mobile-guild', displayName: 'Mobile Guild' });
      expect(result.status).toBe(401);
    } finally {
      await server.close();
    }
  });

describe('REQ-2-1-1 organization repository visibility', () => {
  it('hides private repositories from visitors and ordinary members, shows them to the Owner', async () => {
    const server = await startTestServer();
    try {
      const visitor = createClient(server.baseUrl);
      const anonymous = await visitor.get('/api/orgs/acme-demo/repositories');
      expect(anonymous.status).toBe(200);
      expect(anonymous.data.repositories.map((repo) => repo.name)).toEqual(['org-handbook']);
      expect(anonymous.data.repositories[0]).toMatchObject({
        visibility: 'public',
        description: expect.any(String),
        updatedAt: expect.any(String),
      });

      const bob = createClient(server.baseUrl);
      await bob.post('/api/auth/sign-in', { identifier: 'bob-reviewer', password: 'Valid-password-123!' });
      const memberView = await bob.get('/api/orgs/acme-demo/repositories');
      expect(memberView.data.repositories.map((repo) => repo.name)).toEqual(['org-handbook']);

      const alice = createClient(server.baseUrl);
      await alice.post('/api/auth/sign-in', { identifier: 'alice-dev', password: 'Valid-password-123!' });
      const ownerView = await alice.get('/api/orgs/acme-demo/repositories');
      expect(ownerView.data.repositories.map((repo) => repo.name).sort()).toEqual(['org-handbook', 'org-private']);
    } finally {
      await server.close();
    }
  });
});

describe('REQ-2-2-3 direct member management', () => {
  async function ownerClient(server) {
    const client = createClient(server.baseUrl);
    await client.post('/api/auth/sign-in', { identifier: 'alice-dev', password: 'Valid-password-123!' });
    return client;
  }

  it('adds a member by username and by verified email, exactly once', async () => {
    const server = await startTestServer();
    try {
      const alice = await ownerClient(server);
      const first = await alice.post('/api/orgs/acme-demo/members', {
        usernameOrEmail: 'carol-writer',
        role: 'Member',
      });
      expect(first.status).toBe(201);
      const duplicate = await alice.post('/api/orgs/acme-demo/members', {
        usernameOrEmail: 'carol.writer@example.test',
        role: 'member',
      });
      expect(duplicate.status).toBe(422);
      expect(duplicate.data.error.message).toBe('Account is already a member');

      const people = await alice.get('/api/orgs/acme-demo/people');
      const carol = people.data.members.filter((member) => member.username === 'carol-writer');
      expect(carol).toEqual([{ username: 'carol-writer', role: 'member' }]);
    } finally {
      await server.close();
    }
  });

  it('reports unknown accounts and rejects non-owners', async () => {
    const server = await startTestServer();
    try {
      const alice = await ownerClient(server);
      const unknown = await alice.post('/api/orgs/acme-demo/members', {
        usernameOrEmail: 'unknown-reviewer',
        role: 'member',
      });
      expect(unknown.status).toBe(422);
      expect(unknown.data.error.message).toBe('Account not found');

      const bob = createClient(server.baseUrl);
      await bob.post('/api/auth/sign-in', { identifier: 'bob-reviewer', password: 'Valid-password-123!' });
      const denied = await bob.post('/api/orgs/acme-demo/members', {
        usernameOrEmail: 'carol-writer',
        role: 'member',
      });
      expect(denied.status).toBe(403);
    } finally {
      await server.close();
    }
  });

  it('a new member gains organization visibility but no private repository access', async () => {
    const server = await startTestServer();

      const carol = createClient(server.baseUrl);
      await carol.post('/api/auth/sign-in', { identifier: 'carol-writer', password: 'Valid-password-123!' });
