      const repos = await carol.get('/api/orgs/acme-demo/repositories');
      expect(repos.data.repositories.map((repo) => repo.name)).toEqual(['org-handbook']);

      const privateRepo = server.db
        .prepare("SELECT * FROM repos WHERE owner_org_id IS NOT NULL AND visibility = 'private'")
        .get();
      expect(effectiveRepoRole(server.db, { id: carolUser(server) }, privateRepo)).toBeNull();
    } finally {
      await server.close();
    }
  });

  function carolUser(server) {
    return server.db.prepare("SELECT id FROM users WHERE username = 'carol-writer'").get().id;
  }
});

describe('REQ-2-2-4 member removal cascade', () => {
  it('removes the membership, team memberships and direct grants — nothing else', async () => {
    const server = await startTestServer();
    try {
      const alice = createClient(server.baseUrl);
      await alice.post('/api/auth/sign-in', { identifier: 'alice-dev', password: 'Valid-password-123!' });

      const db = server.db;
      const orgId = db.prepare("SELECT id FROM organizations WHERE name = 'acme-demo'").get().id;
      const bob = db.prepare("SELECT id FROM users WHERE username = 'bob-reviewer'").get().id;
      // bob starts as org member + frontend-team member; add a direct grant too.
      const privateRepo = db
        .prepare("SELECT id FROM repos WHERE owner_org_id = ? AND visibility = 'private'")
        .get(orgId);
      db.prepare(
        `INSERT INTO repo_grants (repo_id, subject_user_id, role) VALUES (?, ?, 'write')`,
      ).run(privateRepo.id, bob.id);

      const removed = await alice.delete('/api/orgs/acme-demo/members/bob-reviewer');
      expect(removed.status).toBe(200);

      expect(db.prepare('SELECT 1 FROM org_members WHERE org_id = ? AND user_id = ?').get(orgId, bob)).toBeUndefined();
      expect(
        db
          .prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM team_members WHERE user_id = ? AND team_id IN (SELECT id FROM teams WHERE org_id = ?)')
          .get(bob, orgId).n,
      ).toBe(0);
      expect(
        db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM repo_grants WHERE subject_user_id = ? AND repo_id = ?').get(bob, privateRepo.id).n,
      ).toBe(0);
      // Teams themselves and their grants survive.
      expect(db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM teams WHERE org_id = ?').get(orgId).n).toBe(3);
      const teamGrant = db
        .prepare(
          `SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM repo_grants g JOIN teams t ON t.id = g.subject_team_id WHERE t.org_id = ?`,
        )
        .get(orgId).n;
      expect(teamGrant).toBe(1);
      // The account and personal repositories survive.
      expect(db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM users WHERE id = ?').get(bob).n).toBe(1);

      // The removed member loses organization visibility entirely.
      const bobClient = createClient(server.baseUrl);
      await bobClient.post('/api/auth/sign-in', { identifier: 'bob-reviewer', password: 'Valid-password-123!' });
      const orgs = await bobClient.get('/api/orgs');
      expect(orgs.data.organizations).toEqual([]);
    } finally {
      await server.close();
    }
  });

  it('refuses to remove the last Owner and keeps the membership', async () => {
    const server = await startTestServer();
    try {
      const alice = createClient(server.baseUrl);
      await alice.post('/api/auth/sign-in', { identifier: 'alice-dev', password: 'Valid-password-123!' });
      const result = await alice.delete('/api/orgs/acme-demo/members/alice-dev');
      expect(result.status).toBe(422);
      expect(result.data.error.message).toBe('Cannot remove the last Owner of the organization');
      const people = await alice.get('/api/orgs/acme-demo/people');
      expect(people.data.members.map((member) => member.username)).toContain('alice-dev');
    } finally {
      await server.close();
    }
  });

  it('a second Owner can be removed', async () => {
    const server = await startTestServer();
    try {
      const alice = createClient(server.baseUrl);
      await alice.post('/api/auth/sign-in', { identifier: 'alice-dev', password: 'Valid-password-123!' });
      await alice.post('/api/orgs/acme-demo/members', { usernameOrEmail: 'carol-writer', role: 'owner' });
      const result = await alice.delete('/api/orgs/acme-demo/members/carol-writer');
      expect(result.status).toBe(200);
    } finally {
      await server.close();
    }
  });
});

describe('REQ-2-2-1 / REQ-2-2-2 teams and hierarchy', () => {
  async function ownerClient(server) {
    const client = createClient(server.baseUrl);
    await client.post('/api/auth/sign-in', { identifier: 'alice-dev', password: 'Valid-password-123!' });
    return client;
  }

  it('creates a team and enforces the name rules', async () => {
    const server = await startTestServer();
    try {
      const alice = await ownerClient(server);
      const created = await alice.post('/api/orgs/acme-demo/teams', { name: 'mobile-team' });
      expect(created.status).toBe(201);

      const malformed = await alice.post('/api/orgs/acme-demo/teams', { name: '-bad-' });
      expect(malformed.status).toBe(422);
      expect(malformed.data.error.message).toBe('Team name format is invalid');

      const duplicate = await alice.post('/api/orgs/acme-demo/teams', { name: 'frontend-team' });
      expect(duplicate.status).toBe(422);
      expect(duplicate.data.error.message).toBe('Team name already exists');

      const invalidParent = await alice.post('/api/orgs/acme-demo/teams', {
        name: 'with-parent',
        parentTeam: 'no-such-team',
      });
      expect(invalidParent.status).toBe(422);
      expect(invalidParent.data.error.message).toBe('Parent team is invalid');
    } finally {
      await server.close();
    }
  });

  it('rejects cycles, keeps the original parent and rejects non-owners', async () => {
    const server = await startTestServer();
    try {
      const alice = await ownerClient(server);
      // Seed: frontend-child -> platform-team. Making platform-team a child of
      // frontend-child would create a cycle.
      const cyclic = await alice.patch('/api/orgs/acme-demo/teams/platform-team', {
        parentTeam: 'frontend-child',
      });
      expect(cyclic.status).toBe(422);
      expect(cyclic.data.error.message).toBe('Cyclic team hierarchy is not allowed');

      const self = await alice.patch('/api/orgs/acme-demo/teams/platform-team', {
        parentTeam: 'platform-team',
      });
      expect(self.status).toBe(422);

      const teams = await alice.get('/api/orgs/acme-demo/teams');
      expect(teams.data.teams.find((team) => team.name === 'platform-team').parent).toBeNull();
      expect(teams.data.teams.find((team) => team.name === 'frontend-child').parent).toBe('platform-team');

      const bob = createClient(server.baseUrl);
      await bob.post('/api/auth/sign-in', { identifier: 'bob-reviewer', password: 'Valid-password-123!' });
      const denied = await bob.patch('/api/orgs/acme-demo/teams/platform-team', { parentTeam: 'frontend-team' });
      expect(denied.status).toBe(403);
    } finally {
      await server.close();
    }
  });

  it('manages team members: org members only, duplicates collapse, removal works', async () => {
    const server = await startTestServer();
    try {
      const alice = await ownerClient(server);
      const added = await alice.post('/api/orgs/acme-demo/teams/frontend-team/members', {
        username: 'carol-writer',
      });
      expect(added.status).toBe(201);
      // Adding twice keeps a single membership row.
      await alice.post('/api/orgs/acme-demo/teams/frontend-team/members', { username: 'carol-writer' });
      const members = await alice.get('/api/orgs/acme-demo/teams/frontend-team/members');
      expect(members.data.members.filter((member) => member.username === 'carol-writer')).toHaveLength(1);

      const outsider = await alice.post('/api/orgs/acme-demo/teams/frontend-team/members', {
        username: 'dave-reader',
      });
      expect(outsider.status).toBe(422);
      expect(outsider.data.error.message).toBe('Account is not a member of this organization');

      const unknown = await alice.post('/api/orgs/acme-demo/teams/frontend-team/members', {
        username: 'nobody-here',
      });
      expect(unknown.status).toBe(422);
      expect(unknown.data.error.message).toBe('Account not found');

      const removed = await alice.delete('/api/orgs/acme-demo/teams/frontend-team/members/carol-writer');
      expect(removed.status).toBe(200);
      const after = await alice.get('/api/orgs/acme-demo/teams/frontend-team/members');
      expect(after.data.members.map((member) => member.username)).toEqual(['bob-reviewer']);
    } finally {
      await server.close();
    }
  });
});

describe('REQ-2-3 repository grants', () => {
  async function ownerClient(server) {
    const client = createClient(server.baseUrl);
    await client.post('/api/auth/sign-in', { identifier: 'alice-dev', password: 'Valid-password-123!' });
    return client;
  }

  it('adds a team grant, keeps it unique on re-save and replaces the role', async () => {
    const server = await startTestServer();
    try {
      const alice = await ownerClient(server);
      const added = await alice.post('/api/repos/acme-demo/org-private/grants', {
        subjectType: 'team',
        subject: 'platform-team',
        role: 'write',
      });
      expect(added.status).toBe(201);

      // Re-saving the same subject must not create a second record.
      const again = await alice.post('/api/repos/acme-demo/org-private/grants', {
        subjectType: 'team',
        subject: 'platform-team',
        role: 'write',
      });
      expect([200, 201]).toContain(again.status);

      const replaced = await alice.patch(
        `/api/repos/acme-demo/org-private/grants/${added.data.grant.id}`,
        { role: 'read' },
      );
      expect(replaced.status).toBe(200);

      const grants = await alice.get('/api/repos/acme-demo/org-private/grants');
      const platformRows = grants.data.grants.filter((grant) => grant.name === 'platform-team');
      expect(platformRows).toEqual([
        { id: added.data.grant.id, subjectType: 'team', name: 'platform-team', role: 'read' },
      ]);
      expect(grants.data.teams).toContain('frontend-team');
      expect(grants.data.members).toContain('bob-reviewer');
    } finally {
      await server.close();
    }
  });

  it('grants effective access to team members and keeps non-granted members out', async () => {
    const server = await startTestServer();
    try {
      const db = server.db;
      const bob = db.prepare("SELECT * FROM users WHERE username = 'bob-reviewer'").get();
      const carol = createUser(db, { username: 'carol-writer', email: 'carol.writer@example.test' });
      // carol is a plain organization member without grants.
      const orgId = db.prepare("SELECT id FROM organizations WHERE name = 'acme-demo'").get().id;
      db.prepare('INSERT OR IGNORE INTO org_members (org_id, user_id, role) VALUES (?, ?, ?)').run(
        orgId,
        carol.id,
        'member',
      );
      const orgPrivate = db
        .prepare("SELECT * FROM repos WHERE owner_org_id = ? AND visibility = 'private'")
        .get(orgId);
      expect(effectiveRepoRole(db, bob, orgPrivate)).toBe('write'); // via frontend-team
      expect(effectiveRepoRole(db, carol, orgPrivate)).toBeNull(); // plain member
    } finally {
      await server.close();
    }
  });

  it('rejects non-admin callers and non-member subjects', async () => {
    const server = await startTestServer();
    try {
      const bob = createClient(server.baseUrl);
      await bob.post('/api/auth/sign-in', { identifier: 'bob-reviewer', password: 'Valid-password-123!' });
      const denied = await bob.get('/api/repos/acme-demo/org-private/grants');
      expect(denied.status).toBe(403);

      const alice = await ownerClient(server);
      const outsider = await alice.post('/api/repos/acme-demo/org-private/grants', {
        subjectType: 'user',
        subject: 'dave-reader',
        role: 'read',
      });
      expect(outsider.status).toBe(422);
      expect(outsider.data.error.message).toBe('Account is not a member of this organization');

      const unknown = await alice.post('/api/repos/acme-demo/org-private/grants', {
        subjectType: 'user',
        subject: 'nobody-here',
        role: 'read',
      });
      expect(unknown.status).toBe(422);
      expect(unknown.data.error.message).toBe('Account not found');
    } finally {
      await server.close();
    }
  });
});

describe('permission model regression (M2 shared decisions)', () => {
  it('org Owner outranks grants; hierarchy never propagates; highest grant wins', () => {
    const db = createTestDb();
    const alice = createUser(db, { username: 'alice' });
    const bob = createUser(db, { username: 'bob' });
    const carol = createUser(db, { username: 'carol' });
    const org = db
      .prepare("INSERT INTO organizations (name, display_name) VALUES ('o1', 'O1') RETURNING *")
      .get();
    db.prepare("INSERT INTO org_members (org_id, user_id, role) VALUES (?, ?, 'owner')").run(org.id, alice.id);
    db.prepare("INSERT INTO org_members (org_id, user_id, role) VALUES (?, ?, 'member')").run(org.id, bob.id);
    const parent = db.prepare("INSERT INTO teams (org_id, name) VALUES (?, 'parent') RETURNING *").get(org.id);
    const child = db
      .prepare("INSERT INTO teams (org_id, name, parent_team_id) VALUES (?, 'child', ?) RETURNING *")
      .get(org.id, parent.id);
    const repo = db
      .prepare("INSERT INTO repos (owner_org_id, name, visibility) VALUES (?, 'r1', 'private') RETURNING *")
      .get(org.id);

    db.prepare("INSERT INTO repo_grants (repo_id, subject_user_id, role) VALUES (?, ?, 'read')").run(repo.id, carol.id);
    db.prepare('INSERT INTO team_members (team_id, user_id) VALUES (?, ?)').run(child.id, bob.id);
    db.prepare("INSERT INTO repo_grants (repo_id, subject_team_id, role) VALUES (?, ?, 'maintain')").run(repo.id, parent.id);
    db.prepare("INSERT INTO repo_grants (repo_id, subject_team_id, role) VALUES (?, ?, 'triage')").run(repo.id, child.id);

    // Owner → admin regardless of grants.
    expect(effectiveRepoRole(db, alice, repo)).toBe('admin');
    // Highest of direct + team grants (maintain from parent beats triage from own team).
    db.prepare("INSERT INTO repo_grants (repo_id, subject_user_id, role) VALUES (?, ?, 'read')").run(repo.id, bob.id);
    expect(effectiveRepoRole(db, bob, repo)).toBe('maintain');
    // A parent-team member gets nothing through the child team (no propagation).
    db.prepare('INSERT INTO team_members (team_id, user_id) VALUES (?, ?)').run(parent.id, carol.id);
    expect(effectiveRepoRole(db, carol, repo)).toBe('read'); // direct read only
  });
});

text: import { forwardRef } from 'react';
import type { ButtonHTMLAttributes } from 'react';
import { cx } from '../utils/cx';

export type ButtonVariant = 'primary' | 'default' | 'danger' | 'ghost';

const VARIANT_CLASS: Record<ButtonVariant, string> = {
  primary: 'btn-primary',
  default: 'btn-default',
  danger: 'btn-danger',
  ghost: 'btn-ghost',
};

export interface ButtonProps extends ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> {
  variant?: ButtonVariant;
}

/** Shared button. Always renders a real <button> so the accessible name is its text. */
export const Button = forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, ButtonProps>(function Button(
  { variant = 'default', className, type = 'button', ...rest },
  ref,
) {
  return <button ref={ref} type={type} className={cx(VARIANT_CLASS[variant], className)} {...rest} />;
});

export default Button;

/** List of non-field problems returned by the API, announced once. */
export function ErrorAlertList({ messages }: { messages: string[] }) {
  if (!messages.length) return null;
  return (
    <ul role="alert" className="alert-error mb-3 pl-5 m-0">
      {messages.map((message) => (
        <li key={message}>{message}</li>
      ))}
    </ul>
  );
}
import { Navigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useAuth } from '../auth/AuthContext';
import type { ReactNode } from 'react';

/**
 * Route guard for protected pages.
 *
 * It redirects to the account-access page while the session is unknown and when
 * the visitor is signed out, so browser back navigation to a protected page
 * after signing out restores the unauthenticated state (REQ-1-2).
 */
export function RequireAuth({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const { user, loading } = useAuth();
  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="page-shell">
        <p className="text-muted">Loading…</p>
      </div>
    );
  }
  if (!user) return <Navigate to="/login" replace />;
  return <>{children}</>;
}

arguments: content: /**
 * Typed client for the REQ-2 organization & governance API.
 * All shapes mirror `backend/src/modules/orgs/router.js` and
 * `backend/src/modules/repos/grants.js`.
 */
import { api } from '../../api/client';

export interface OrganizationSummary {
  name: string;
  displayName: string;
  role: 'member' | 'owner' | null;
}

export interface OrgRepository {
  name: string;
  description: string;
  visibility: 'public' | 'private';
  updatedAt: string;
}

export interface OrgMember {
  username: string;
  role: 'member' | 'owner';
}

export interface OrgTeam {
  name: string;
  description: string;
  parent: string | null;
}

export interface RepoGrant {
  id: number;
  subjectType: 'user' | 'team';
  name: string;
  role: string;
}

export interface OrgDetail {
  organization: { name: string; displayName: string; createdAt: string };
  viewerPermission: { organization: 'member' | 'owner' | null; canView: boolean };
}

export const orgApi = {
  listMine: () => api.get<{ organizations: OrganizationSummary[] }>('/api/orgs'),
  create: (body: { name: string; displayName: string }) =>
    api.post<{ organization: OrgDetail['organization'] }>('/api/orgs', body),
  get: (org: string) => api.get<OrgDetail>(`/api/orgs/${org}`),
  repositories: (org: string) =>
    api.get<{ organization: OrgDetail['organization']; repositories: OrgRepository[]; viewerPermission: OrgDetail['viewerPermission'] }>(
      `/api/orgs/${org}/repositories`,
    ),
  people: (org: string) =>
    api.get<{ organization: OrgDetail['organization']; members: OrgMember[]; viewerPermission: OrgDetail['viewerPermission'] }>(
      `/api/orgs/${org}/people`,
    ),
  addMember: (org: string, body: { usernameOrEmail: string; role: 'member' | 'owner' }) =>
    api.post<{ member: OrgMember }>(`/api/orgs/${org}/members`, body),
  removeMember: (org: string, username: string) => api.delete(`/api/orgs/${org}/members/${username}`),
  teams: (org: string) =>
    api.get<{ organization: OrgDetail['organization']; teams: OrgTeam[]; viewerPermission: OrgDetail['viewerPermission'] }>(
      `/api/orgs/${org}/teams`,
    ),
  createTeam: (org: string, body: { name: string; description?: string; parentTeam?: string }) =>
    api.post<{ team: OrgTeam }>(`/api/orgs/${org}/teams`, body),
  team: (org: string, team: string) =>
    api.get<{ team: OrgTeam; viewerPermission: OrgDetail['viewerPermission'] }>(`/api/orgs/${org}/teams/${team}`),
  updateTeam: (org: string, team: string, body: { parentTeam: string | null }) =>
    api.patch<{ team: OrgTeam }>(`/api/orgs/${org}/teams/${team}`, body),
  teamMembers: (org: string, team: string) =>
    api.get<{ members: { username: string }[] }>(`/api/orgs/${org}/teams/${team}/members`),
  addTeamMember: (org: string, team: string, body: { username: string }) =>
    api.post<{ member: { username: string } }>(`/api/orgs/${org}/teams/${team}/members`, body),
  removeTeamMember: (org: string, team: string, username: string) =>
    api.delete(`/api/orgs/${org}/teams/${team}/members/${username}`),
};

export const grantsApi = {
  list: (owner: string, repo: string) =>
    api.get<{ grants: RepoGrant[]; members: string[]; teams: string[]; viewerPermission: { repository: string | null } }>(
      `/api/repos/${owner}/${repo}/grants`,
    ),
  add: (owner: string, repo: string, body: { subjectType: 'user' | 'team'; subject: string; role: string }) =>
    api.post<{ grant: RepoGrant }>(`/api/repos/${owner}/${repo}/grants`, body),
  setRole: (owner: string, repo: string, grantId: number, role: string) =>
    api.patch<{ grant: RepoGrant }>(`/api/repos/${owner}/${repo}/grants/${grantId}`, { role }),
};

export function formatTimestamp(value: string | null | undefined): string {

        <Button variant="primary" onClick={() => undefined} asChild={false} />
      </div>
      {error ? <ErrorAlert>{error}</ErrorAlert> : null}
      {!organizations ? (
        <p className="text-muted">Loading…</p>
      ) : organizations.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="text-muted">You are not a member of any organization yet.</p>
      ) : (
        <ul className="list-none p-0 m-0 flex flex-col gap-2">
          {organizations.map((organization) => (
            <li key={organization.name} className="border rounded p-3 flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
              <div>
                <Link className="font-600" to={`/orgs/${organization.name}`}>
                  {organization.name}
                </Link>
                <span className="text-muted ml-2">{organization.displayName}</span>
              </div>
              <span className="text-sm text-muted">{formatRole(organization.role)}</span>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
      <p className="mt-3 mb-0">
        <Link className="menu-item px-0" to="/orgs/new">
          {orgCopy.newOrganization}
        </Link>
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

import type { FormEvent } from 'react';
import { Link, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { ApiError } from '../../api/client';
import { ErrorAlert } from '../../components/Alerts';
import { Button } from '../../components/Button';
import { TextField } from '../../components/TextField';
import { auth as authCopy, errors as errorCopy, org as orgCopy } from '../../contracts/copy';

/**
 * Create an organization (REQ-2-1-2). Field errors are attached to their input;
 * duplicate identifier + missing display name are reported together.
 */
export function NewOrganizationPage() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [name, setName] = useState('');
  const [displayName, setDisplayName] = useState('');
  const [nameError, setNameError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [displayNameError, setDisplayNameError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [generalErrors, setGeneralErrors] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  async function onSubmit(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    setSubmitting(true);
    setNameError(null);
    setDisplayNameError(null);
    setGeneralErrors([]);
    try {
      await fetchCreate(name, displayName);
      navigate(`/orgs/${name.trim()}`);
    } catch (caught) {
      applyErrors(caught);
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  }

  async function fetchCreate(nameValue: string, displayNameValue: string) {
    const { orgApi } = await import('./api');
    await orgApi.create({ name: nameValue.trim(), displayName: displayNameValue.trim() });
  }

  function applyErrors(caught: unknown) {
    if (caught instanceof ApiError) {
      setNameError(caught.fieldError('name') ?? null);
      setDisplayNameError(caught.fieldError('displayName') ?? caught.fieldError('display_name') ?? null);
      setGeneralErrors(caught.generalErrors());
    } else {
      setGeneralErrors([errorCopy.unknown]);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="app-card p-4 max-w-xl">
      <h2 className="section-title m-0 mb-3">{orgCopy.newOrganization}</h2>
      <ErrorAlertList messages={generalErrors} />
      <form onSubmit={onSubmit} noValidate>
        <TextField
          label={orgCopy.organizationName}
          name="name"
          value={name}
          onChange={(event) => setName(event.target.value)}
          error={nameError}
          autoComplete="off"
        />
        <TextField
          label={orgCopy.displayName}
          name="displayName"
          value={displayName}
          onChange={(event) => setDisplayName(event.target.value)}
          error={displayNameError}
          autoComplete="off"
        />
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-4">
          <Button type="submit" variant="primary" disabled={submitting}>
            {orgCopy.createOrganization}
          </Button>
          <Link className="menu-item" to="/settings/organizations">
            {authCopy.cancel}
          </Link>
        </div>
      </form>
    </div>
  );
}

function ErrorAlertList({ messages }: { messages: string[] }) {
  if (!messages.length) return null;
  return (
    <ul role="alert" className="alert-error mb-3 pl-5 m-0">
      {messages.map((message) => (
        <li key={message}>{message}</li>
      ))}
    </ul>
  );
}

/**
 * Organization overview shell (REQ-2-1). The heading is the organization
 * identifier; "Repositories", "People" and "Teams" are navigation links
 * (link role, visually styled as tabs).
 */
export function OrganizationLayout() {
  const { org = '' } = useParams();
  const [detail, setDetail] = useState<OrgDetail | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    orgApi
      .get(org)
      .then((result) => {
        if (!cancelled) setDetail(result);
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (!cancelled) setError('Not found');
      });
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [org]);

  if (error) {
    return (
      <div className="page-shell">
        <ErrorAlert>{error}</ErrorAlert>
      </div>
    );
  }
  if (!detail) {
    return (
      <div className="page-shell">
        <p className="text-muted">Loading…</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="page-shell">
      <h1 className="page-title mb-1">{detail.organization.name}</h1>
      <p className="text-muted mt-0">{detail.organization.displayName}</p>
      <nav aria-label={`${detail.organization.name} organization`}>
        <div className="flex gap-1 border-b mb-4">
          <NavLink to={`/orgs/${org}`} end className="org-tab">
            {orgCopy.repositories}
          </NavLink>
          <NavLink to={`/orgs/${org}/people`} className="org-tab">
            {orgCopy.people}
          </NavLink>
          <NavLink to={`/orgs/${org}/teams`} className="org-tab">
            {orgCopy.teams}
          </NavLink>
        </div>
      </nav>
      <Outlet context={detail} />
    </div>
  );
}

import { Link, useOutletContext, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { ErrorAlert } from '../../components/Alerts';
import { shell, org as orgCopy } from '../../contracts/copy';
import { formatTimestamp } from './format';
import { orgApi, type OrgRepository } from './api';

type OrgContext = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof orgApi.get>>;

/**
 * Repositories tab (REQ-2-1-1): "Find a repository" filters as the user types,
 * the visibility filter narrows further, and every result links to the
 * repository overview (`owner/repo`, M3 page). Only repositories visible to
 * the current user are listed (the API already enforces this).
 */
export function OrganizationRepositoriesPage() {
  const { org = '' } = useParams();
  const context = useOutletContext<OrgContext | null>();
  const [repositories, setRepositories] = useState<OrgRepository[] | null>(null);
  const [loadError, setLoadError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState('');
  const [visibility, setVisibility] = useState<'all' | 'public' | 'private'>('all');

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    orgApi
      .repositories(org)
      .then((result) => {
        if (!cancelled) setRepositories(result.repositories);
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (!cancelled) setLoadError('Not found');
      });
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [org]);

  const visible = useMemo(() => {
    const needle = filter.trim().toLowerCase();
    return (repositories ?? []).filter(
      (repo) =>
        (visibility === 'all' || repo.visibility === visibility) &&
        (!needle || repo.name.toLowerCase().includes(needle)),
    );
  }, [repositories, filter, visibility]);

  return (
    <div>
      {loadError ? <ErrorAlert>{loadError}</ErrorAlert> : null}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 items-center mb-3">
        <label className="sr-only" htmlFor="find-repository">
          {orgCopy.findRepository}
        </label>
        <input
          id="find-repository"
          className="form-input max-w-72"
          type="text"
          placeholder={orgCopy.findRepository}
          aria-label={orgCopy.findRepository}
          value={filter}
          onChange={(event) => setFilter(event.target.value)}
        />
        <label className="sr-only" htmlFor="visibility-filter">
          {orgCopy.visibilityFilter}
        </label>
        <select
          id="visibility-filter"
          className="form-input w-auto"
          aria-label={orgCopy.visibilityFilter}
          value={visibility}
          onChange={(event) => setVisibility(event.target.value as 'all' | 'public' | 'private')}
        >
          <option value="all">{orgCopy.visibilityAll}</option>
          <option value="public">{orgCopy.visibilityPublic}</option>
          <option value="private">{orgCopy.visibilityPrivate}</option>
        </select>
      </div>

      {!repositories ? (
        <p className="text-muted">Loading…</p>
      ) : visible.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="text-muted">{shell.noResults}</p>
      ) : (
        <ul className="list-none p-0 m-0 flex flex-col divide-y">
          {visible.map((repo) => (
            <li key={repo.name} className="py-3">
              <Link className="font-600 text-lg" to={`/${org}/${repo.name}`}>
                {repo.name}
              </Link>
              <div className="text-sm text-muted mt-1 flex flex-wrap gap-x-3">
                <span>{repo.description}</span>
                <span className="border rounded px-1 text-xs">{repo.visibility === 'private' ? 'Private' : 'Public'}</span>
                <span>Updated {formatTimestamp(repo.updatedAt)}</span>
              </div>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
      {context ? null : null}
    </div>
  );
}

[2] type: toolCall
id: call_d682bdd22cb94df09243aafe
name: write
arguments: content: import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import type { FormEvent } from 'react';
import { useParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { ApiError } from '../../api/client';
import { ErrorAlert } from '../../components/Alerts';
import { Button } from '../../components/Button';
import { Dialog } from '../../components/Dialog';
import { auth as authCopy, errors as errorCopy, org as orgCopy } from '../../contracts/copy';
import { formatRole } from './format';
import { orgApi, type OrgMember } from './api';

/**
 * People tab (REQ-2-2-3 / REQ-2-2-4). An Owner adds members directly (no
 * invitation step) and removes them through the per-member action menu; for a
 * non-Owner none of the management controls exist (absent, not disabled).
 */
export function PeoplePage() {
  const { org = '' } = useParams();
  const [members, setMembers] = useState<OrgMember[] | null>(null);
  const [viewerRole, setViewerRole] = useState<'member' | 'owner' | null>(null);
  const [loadError, setLoadError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [formOpen, setFormOpen] = useState(false);
  const [identifier, setIdentifier] = useState('');
  const [role, setRole] = useState<'member' | 'owner'>('member');
  const [fieldError, setFieldError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [generalError, setGeneralError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  const [removeTarget, setRemoveTarget] = useState<OrgMember | null>(null);
  const [removeError, setRemoveError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  async function reload() {
    try {
      const result = await orgApi.people(org);
      setMembers(result.members);
      setViewerRole(result.viewerPermission.organization);
      setLoadError(null);
    } catch {
      setLoadError('Not found');
    }
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    setMembers(null);
    reload();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [org]);

  async function onAddMember(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    setSubmitting(true);
    setFieldError(null);
    setGeneralError(null);
    try {
      await orgApi.addMember(org, { usernameOrEmail: identifier.trim(), role });
      setIdentifier('');
      setRole('member');
      setFormOpen(false);
      await reload();
    } catch (caught) {
      if (caught instanceof ApiError) {
        // Failure keeps the form open so the input can be corrected (REQ-2-2-3).
        setFieldError(
          caught.fieldError('usernameOrEmail') ??
            caught.fieldError('role') ??
            caught.generalErrors()[0] ??
            errorCopy.unknown,
        );
      } else {
        setFieldError(errorCopy.unknown);
      }
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  }

  async function onConfirmRemove() {
    if (!removeTarget) return;
    setRemoveError(null);
    try {
      await orgApi.removeMember(org, removeTarget.username);
      setRemoveTarget(null);
      await reload();
    } catch (caught) {
      setRemoveError(
        caught instanceof ApiError ? caught.generalErrors()[0] ?? caught.message : errorCopy.unknown,
      );
    }
  }

  const ownersCount = (members ?? []).filter((member) => member.role === 'owner').length;

  return (
    <div>
      {loadError ? <ErrorAlert>{loadError}</ErrorAlert> : null}
      {viewerRole === 'owner' ? (
        <>
          <p className="m-0 mb-3">
            <Button variant="primary" onClick={() => setFormOpen(true)}>
              {orgCopy.addMember}
            </Button>
          </p>
          {formOpen ? (
            <form onSubmit={onAddMember} noValidate className="app-card p-3 mb-3 max-w-xl">
              <div className="mb-3">
                <label className="form-label" htmlFor="add-member-identifier">
                  {authCopy.usernameOrEmail}
                </label>
                <input
                  id="add-member-identifier"
                  className="form-input"
                  value={identifier}
                  onChange={(event) => setIdentifier(event.target.value)}
                  aria-describedby={fieldError ? 'add-member-error' : undefined}
                  autoComplete="off"
                />
              </div>
              <div className="mb-3">
                <label className="form-label" htmlFor="add-member-role">
                  {orgCopy.role}
                </label>
                <select
                  id="add-member-role"
                  className="form-input w-auto"
                  value={role}
                  onChange={(event) => setRole(event.target.value as 'member' | 'owner')}
                >
                  <option value="member">{orgCopy.roleMember}</option>
                  <option value="owner">{orgCopy.roleOwner}</option>
                </select>
              </div>
              {fieldError ? (
                <p className="form-error" id="add-member-error" role="alert">
                  {fieldError}
                </p>
              ) : null}
              <Button type="submit" variant="primary" disabled={submitting}>
                {orgCopy.addMember}
              </Button>
            </form>
          ) : null}
        </>
      ) : null}

      {!members ? (
        <p className="text-muted">Loading…</p>
      ) : (
        <ul className="list-none p-0 m-0 flex flex-col divide-y">
          {members.map((member) => {
            const removable =
              viewerRole === 'owner' && !(member.role === 'owner' && ownersCount <= 1);
            return (
              <li key={member.username} className="py-3 flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                <div>
                  <span className="font-600">{member.username}</span>
                  <span className="text-muted ml-2 text-sm">{formatRole(member.role)}</span>
                </div>
                {removable ? (
                  <MemberMenu
                    username={member.username}
                    onRemove={() => {
                      setRemoveError(null);
                      setRemoveTarget(member);
                    }}
                  />
                ) : null}
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ul>
      )}

      <Dialog
        open={removeTarget != null}
        onOpenChange={(open) => {
          if (!open) setRemoveTarget(null);
        }}
        title={orgCopy.removeFromOrganization}
        description={orgCopy.removeDialogDescription}
        footer={
          <>
            <Button onClick={() => setRemoveTarget(null)}>{authCopy.cancel}</Button>
            <Button variant="danger" onClick={onConfirmRemove}>
              {orgCopy.remove}
            </Button>
          </>
        }
      >
        {removeError ? <ErrorAlert>{removeError}</ErrorAlert> : null}
        {removeTarget ? <p className="m-0 text-sm">{removeTarget.username}</p> : null}
      </Dialog>
    </div>
  );
}

/** Per-member disclosure menu: trigger `Member menu <username>` → menuitem. */
function MemberMenu({ username, onRemove }: { username: string; onRemove: () => void }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const rootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const onPointerDown = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      if (!rootRef.current?.contains(event.target as Node)) setOpen(false);
    };
    const onKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (event.key === 'Escape') setOpen(false);
    };
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', onPointerDown);
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousedown', onPointerDown);
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
    };
  }, [open]);

  return (
    <div className="relative" ref={rootRef}>
      <Button
        aria-label={orgCopy.memberMenu(username)}
        aria-haspopup="menu"
        aria-expanded={open}
        onClick={() => setOpen((value) => !value)}
      >
        ⋯
      </Button>
      {open ? (
        <div role="menu" aria-label={orgCopy.memberMenu(username)} className="menu-panel">
          <button
            role="menuitem"
            type="button"
            className="menu-item"
            onClick={() => {
              setOpen(false);
              onRemove();
            }}
          >
            {orgCopy.removeFromOrganization}
          </button>
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

export default PeoplePage;

/** Teams tab (REQ-2-2-1): the team list plus the Owner-only "New team" link. */
export function TeamsPage() {
  const { org = '' } = useParams();
  const [teams, setTeams] = useState<OrgTeam[] | null>(null);
  const [viewerRole, setViewerRole] = useState<'member' | 'owner' | null>(null);
  const [loadError, setLoadError] = useState<string | null>(null);

      .teams(org)

        <p className="text-muted">Loading…</p>
      ) : teams.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="text-muted">No teams yet.</p>
      ) : (
        <ul className="list-none p-0 m-0 flex flex-col divide-y">

                {team.name}
              </Link>
              {team.parent ? <span className="text-muted ml-2 text-sm">Parent: {team.parent}</span> : null}
              {team.description ? <div className="text-sm text-muted">{team.description}</div> : null}
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

arguments: content: import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import type { FormEvent } from 'react';
import { Link, useNavigate, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { ApiError } from '../../api/client';
import { ErrorAlert } from '../../components/Alerts';
import { Button } from '../../components/Button';
import { TextField } from '../../components/TextField';
import { auth as authCopy, org as orgCopy } from '../../contracts/copy';
import { orgApi, type OrgTeam } from './api';

/**
 * Create a team (REQ-2-2-1). Name is required; description and a parent team
 * from the same organization are optional.
 */
export function NewTeamPage() {
  const { org = '' } = useParams();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [name, setName] = useState('');
  const [description, setDescription] = useState('');
  const [parent, setParent] = useState('');
  const [teams, setTeams] = useState<OrgTeam[]>([]);
  const [nameError, setNameError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [generalError, setGeneralError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    orgApi
      .teams(org)
      .then((result) => setTeams(result.teams))
      .catch(() => setTeams([]));
  }, [org]);

  async function onSubmit(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    setSubmitting(true);
    setNameError(null);
    setGeneralError(null);
    try {
      await orgApi.createTeam(org, {
        name: name.trim(),
        description: description.trim() || undefined,
        parentTeam: parent || undefined,
      });
      navigate(`/orgs/${org}/teams/${name.trim()}`);
    } catch (caught) {
      if (caught instanceof ApiError) {
        setNameError(caught.fieldError('name') ?? caught.generalErrors()[0] ?? caught.message);
      } else {
        setGeneralError('Something went wrong');
      }
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="app-card p-4 max-w-xl">
      <h2 className="section-title m-0 mb-3">{orgCopy.newTeam}</h2>
      {generalError ? <ErrorAlert>{generalError}</ErrorAlert> : null}
      <form onSubmit={onSubmit} noValidate>
        <TextField
          label={orgCopy.teamName}
          name="teamName"
          value={name}
          onChange={(event) => setName(event.target.value)}
          error={nameError}
          autoComplete="off"
        />
        <TextField
          label={orgCopy.description}
          name="teamDescription"
          value={description}
          onChange={(event) => setDescription(event.target.value)}
          autoComplete="off"
        />
        <div className="mb-3">
          <label className="form-label" htmlFor="new-team-parent">
            {orgCopy.parentTeam}
          </label>
          <select
            id="new-team-parent"
            className="form-input w-auto"
            value={parent}
            onChange={(event) => setParent(event.target.value)}
          >
            <option value="">{orgCopy.noParent}</option>
            {teams.map((team) => (
              <option key={team.name} value={team.name}>
                {team.name}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-4">
          <Button type="submit" variant="primary" disabled={submitting}>
            {orgCopy.createTeam}
          </Button>
          <Link className="menu-item" to={`/orgs/${org}/teams`}>
            {authCopy.cancel}
          </Link>
        </div>
      </form>
    </div>
  );
}

import type { FormEvent } from 'react';
import { Link, useParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { ApiError } from '../../api/client';
import { ErrorAlert } from '../../components/Alerts';
import { Button } from '../../components/Button';
import { SegmentedNav } from '../../components/SegmentedNav';
import { auth as authCopy, errors as errorCopy, org as orgCopy } from '../../contracts/copy';
import { orgApi } from './api';

/**
 * Team Members tab (REQ-2-2-2). The heading is `org/team`; Members and Settings
 * are links. Only an organization Owner sees the member controls; the "Add
 * member" trigger is hidden while its form is open so exactly one actionable
 * "Add member" is exposed per step.
 */
export function TeamMembersPage() {
  const { org = '', team = '' } = useParams();
  const [members, setMembers] = useState<{ username: string }[] | null>(null);
  const [viewerRole, setViewerRole] = useState<'member' | 'owner' | null>(null);
  const [loadError, setLoadError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [formOpen, setFormOpen] = useState(false);
  const [username, setUsername] = useState('');
  const [fieldError, setFieldError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  async function reload() {
    try {
      const [memberResult, detail] = await Promise.all([
        orgApi.teamMembers(org, team),
        orgApi.team(org, team),
      ]);
      setMembers(memberResult.members);
      setViewerRole(detail.viewerPermission.organization);
      setLoadError(null);
    } catch {
      setLoadError('Not found');
    }
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    setMembers(null);
    reload();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [org, team]);

  async function onAddMember(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    setSubmitting(true);
    setFieldError(null);
    try {
      await orgApi.addTeamMember(org, team, { username: username.trim() });
      setUsername('');
      setFormOpen(false);
      await reload();
    } catch (caught) {
      setFieldError(
        caught instanceof ApiError
          ? caught.fieldError('username') ?? caught.generalErrors()[0] ?? caught.message
          : errorCopy.unknown,
      );
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  }

  async function onRemove(target: string) {
    try {
      await orgApi.removeTeamMember(org, team, target);
      await reload();
    } catch {
      // Immediate removal per REQ-2-2-2; failures surface on reload.
      await reload();
    }
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 mb-3">
        <h2 className="section-title m-0">
          {org}/{team}
        </h2>
      </div>
      <nav aria-label={`${org}/${team} team`}>
        <SegmentedNav
          items={[
            { label: orgCopy.members, to: `/orgs/${org}/teams/${team}`, active: true },
            { label: authCopy.settings, to: `/orgs/${org}/teams/${team}/settings` },
          ]}
        />
      </nav>

      {loadError ? <ErrorAlert>{loadError}</ErrorAlert> : null}
      {viewerRole === 'owner' && !formOpen ? (
        <p className="m-0 mb-3 mt-3">
          <Button variant="primary" onClick={() => setFormOpen(true)}>
            {orgCopy.addMember}
          </Button>
        </p>
      ) : null}
      {formOpen ? (
        <form onSubmit={onAddMember} noValidate className="app-card p-3 mb-3 mt-3 max-w-xl">
          <div className="mb-3">
            <label className="form-label" htmlFor="team-member-username">
              {authCopy.username}
            </label>
            <input
              id="team-member-username"
              className="form-input"
              value={username}
              onChange={(event) => setUsername(event.target.value)}
              aria-describedby={fieldError ? 'team-member-error' : undefined}
              autoComplete="off"
            />
          </div>
          {fieldError ? (
            <p className="form-error" id="team-member-error" role="alert">
              {fieldError}
            </p>
          ) : null}
          <Button type="submit" variant="primary" disabled={submitting}>
            {orgCopy.addMember}
          </Button>
        </form>
      ) : null}

      {!members ? (
        <p className="text-muted">Loading…</p>
      ) : members.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="text-muted">No members in this team yet.</p>
      ) : (
        <ul className="list-none p-0 m-0 flex flex-col divide-y">
          {members.map((member) => (
            <li key={member.username} className="py-3 flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
              <span className="font-600">{member.username}</span>
              {viewerRole === 'owner' ? (
                <Button variant="danger" onClick={() => onRemove(member.username)}>
                  {orgCopy.removeTeamMember(member.username)}
                </Button>
              ) : null}
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
      <p className="mt-4 mb-0">
        <Link className="menu-item px-0" to={`/orgs/${org}/teams`}>
          ← {orgCopy.teams}
        </Link>
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

arguments: content: import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import type { FormEvent } from 'react';
import { useParams } from 'react-router-dom';
import { ApiError } from '../../api/client';
import { ErrorAlert } from '../../components/Alerts';

import { auth as authCopy, errors as errorCopy, org as orgCopy } from '../../contracts/copy';
import { orgApi, type OrgTeam } from './api';

/**
 * Team Settings tab (REQ-2-2-2): the native select "Parent team" + "Save".
 * A rejected change (cycle) shows the error and keeps the original selection.
 */
export function TeamSettingsPage() {
  const { org = '', team = '' } = useParams();
  const [teamDetail, setTeamDetail] = useState<OrgTeam | null>(null);
  const [teams, setTeams] = useState<OrgTeam[]>([]);
  const [viewerRole, setViewerRole] = useState<'member' | 'owner' | null>(null);
  const [loadError, setLoadError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [selection, setSelection] = useState('');
  const [savedParent, setSavedParent] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    Promise.all([orgApi.team(org, team), orgApi.teams(org)])
      .then(([detail, list]) => {
        if (cancelled) return;
        setTeamDetail(detail.team);
        setTeams(list.teams);
        setViewerRole(detail.viewerPermission.organization);
        setSelection(detail.team.parent ?? '');
        setSavedParent(detail.team.parent ?? '');
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (!cancelled) setLoadError('Not found');
      });
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [org, team]);

  async function onSave(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    setSubmitting(true);
    setError(null);
    setSuccess(false);
    try {
      const result = await orgApi.updateTeam(org, team, { parentTeam: selection || null });
      setTeamDetail(result.team);
      setSavedParent(result.team.parent ?? '');
      setSuccess(true);
    } catch (caught) {
      // Rejected: keep the selection as it was before the attempt.
      setSelection(savedParent);
      setError(
        caught instanceof ApiError
          ? caught.fieldError('parentTeam') ?? caught.generalErrors()[0] ?? caught.message
          : errorCopy.unknown,
      );
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 mb-3">
        <h2 className="section-title m-0">
          {org}/{team}
        </h2>
      </div>
      <nav aria-label={`${org}/${team} team`}>
        <SegmentedNav
          items={[
            { label: orgCopy.members, to: `/orgs/${org}/teams/${team}` },
            { label: authCopy.settings, to: `/orgs/${org}/teams/${team}/settings`, active: true },
          ]}
        />
      </nav>

      {loadError ? <ErrorAlert>{loadError}</ErrorAlert> : null}
      {viewerRole === 'owner' && teamDetail ? (
        <form onSubmit={onSave} noValidate className="max-w-xl mt-3">
          <div className="mb-3">
            <label className="form-label" htmlFor="parent-team-select">
              {orgCopy.parentTeam}
            </label>
            <select
              id="parent-team-select"
              className="form-input w-auto"
              value={selection}
              onChange={(event) => {
                setSelection(event.target.value);
                setSuccess(false);
                setError(null);
              }}
            >
              <option value="">{orgCopy.noParent}</option>
              {teams
                .filter((candidate) => candidate.name !== team)
                .map((candidate) => (
                  <option key={candidate.name} value={candidate.name}>
                    {candidate.name}
                  </option>
                ))}
            </select>
          </div>
          {error ? (
            <p className="form-error" role="alert">
              {error}
            </p>
          ) : null}
          {success ? (
            <p className="alert-success m-0 mb-3" role="status">
              Saved
            </p>
          ) : null}
          <Button type="submit" variant="primary" disabled={submitting}>
            {authCopy.settings === orgCopy.save ? orgCopy.save : orgCopy.save}
          </Button>
        </form>
      ) : null}
      {viewerRole !== 'owner' && !loadError ? (
        <p className="text-muted mt-3">Only an organization Owner can change team settings.</p>
      ) : null}
      {teamDetail ? (
        <p className="text-sm text-muted mt-3">
          {orgCopy.parentTeam}: {teamDetail.parent ?? orgCopy.noParent}
        </p>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

/**
 * Manage access (REQ-2-3): grant repository roles to organization members and
 * teams. The route is `/:owner/:repo/settings/access`, reached from the
 * repository Settings page ("Manage access" link — added by the repository
 * module's Settings page; see docs/task-packets/m2-issue-4.md).
 */
export function ManageAccessPage() {
  const { owner = '', repo = '' } = useParams();
  const [grants, setGrants] = useState<RepoGrant[] | null>(null);
  const [members, setMembers] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [teams, setTeams] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [loadError, setLoadError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [pickerOpen, setPickerOpen] = useState(false);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [subject, setSubject] = useState<{ type: 'user' | 'team'; name: string } | null>(null);
  const [role, setRole] = useState<string>('read');
  const [formError, setFormError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  async function reload() {
    try {
      const result = await grantsApi.list(owner, repo);
      setGrants(result.grants);
      setMembers(result.members);
      setTeams(result.teams);
      setLoadError(null);
    } catch (caught) {
      if (caught instanceof ApiError) {
        setLoadError(
          caught.status === 403
            ? errorCopy.forbidden
            : caught.status === 404
              ? errorCopy.notFound
              : errorCopy.unknown,
        );
      } else {
        setLoadError(errorCopy.unknown);
      }
    }
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    setGrants(null);
    reload();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [owner, repo]);

  const candidates = useMemo(() => {
    const needle = search.trim().toLowerCase();
    const match = (name: string) => !needle || name.toLowerCase().includes(needle);
    return [
      ...teams.filter(match).map((name) => ({ type: 'team' as const, name })),
      ...members.filter(match).map((name) => ({ type: 'user' as const, name })),
    ];
  }, [search, members, teams]);

  async function onAdd() {
    if (!subject) {
      setFormError(errorCopy.accountNotFound);
      return;
    }
    setSubmitting(true);
    setFormError(null);
    setSaved(false);
    try {
      await grantsApi.add(owner, repo, { subjectType: subject.type, subject: subject.name, role });
      setSubject(null);
      setSearch('');
      setPickerOpen(false);
      await reload();
      setSaved(true);
    } catch (caught) {
      setFormError(
        caught instanceof ApiError
          ? caught.fieldError('subject') ?? caught.fieldError('role') ?? caught.generalErrors()[0] ?? caught.message
          : errorCopy.unknown,
      );
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  }

  async function onRowSave(grant: RepoGrant, nextRole: string) {
    setFormError(null);
    setSaved(false);
    try {
      await grantsApi.setRole(owner, repo, grant.id, nextRole);
      await reload();
      setSaved(true);
    } catch (caught) {
      setFormError(
        caught instanceof ApiError ? caught.generalErrors()[0] ?? caught.message : errorCopy.unknown,
      );
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="page-shell">
      <h1 className="page-title mb-1">{orgCopy.manageAccess}</h1>
      <p className="text-muted mt-0">
        {owner}/{repo}
      </p>
      {loadError ? <ErrorAlert>{loadError}</ErrorAlert> : null}
      {saved ? <SuccessAlert>Saved</SuccessAlert> : null}

      {!loadError ? (
        <>
          {!pickerOpen ? (
            <p className="m-0 mb-3">
              <Button variant="primary" onClick={() => setPickerOpen(true)}>
                {orgCopy.addPeopleOrTeams}
              </Button>
            </p>
          ) : null}
          {pickerOpen ? (
            <div className="app-card p-3 mb-3 max-w-xl">
              <div className="mb-3">
                <label className="form-label" htmlFor="grant-search">
                  {orgCopy.search}
                </label>
                <input
                  id="grant-search"
                  className="form-input"
                  value={search}
                  onChange={(event) => setSearch(event.target.value)}
                  autoComplete="off"
                />
              </div>
              <div className="mb-3 flex flex-col gap-1 max-h-56 overflow-auto" role="listbox" aria-label={orgCopy.addPeopleOrTeams}>
                {candidates.length === 0 ? (
                  <p className="text-sm text-muted m-0">No results</p>
                ) : (
                  candidates.map((candidate) => {
                    const selected = subject?.type === candidate.type && subject?.name === candidate.name;
                    return (
                      <button
                        key={`${candidate.type}:${candidate.name}`}
                        type="button"
                        role="option"
                        aria-selected={selected}
                        className="menu-item"
                        onClick={() => setSubject(candidate)}
                      >
                        {candidate.type === 'team' ? '▸ ' : ''}
                        {candidate.name}
                        <span className="text-muted ml-1 text-xs">
                          {candidate.type === 'team' ? 'team' : 'member'}
                        </span>
                      </button>
                    );
                  })
                )}
              </div>
              <div className="mb-3">
                <label className="form-label" htmlFor="grant-role">
                  {orgCopy.role}
                </label>
                <select
                  id="grant-role"
                  className="form-input w-auto"
                  value={role}
                  onChange={(event) => setRole(event.target.value)}
                >
                  {ROLE_OPTIONS.map((option) => (
                    <option key={option} value={option}>
                      {ROLE_LABEL[option]}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>
              {formError ? (
                <p className="form-error" role="alert">
                  {formError}
                </p>
              ) : null}
              <div className="flex gap-2">
                <Button variant="primary" onClick={onAdd} disabled={submitting}>
                  {orgCopy.add}
                </Button>
                <Button onClick={() => setPickerOpen(false)}>{authCancel}</Button>
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : null}

          {!grants ? (
            <p className="text-muted">Loading…</p>
          ) : grants.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="text-muted">No grants yet.</p>
          ) : (
            <ul className="list-none p-0 m-0 flex flex-col divide-y">
              {grants.map((grant) => (
                <GrantRow key={grant.id} grant={grant} onSave={(nextRole) => onRowSave(grant, nextRole)} />
              ))}
            </ul>
          )}
        </>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

/** One existing grant: the row's accessible name includes the subject name. */
function GrantRow({ grant, onSave }: { grant: RepoGrant; onSave: (role: string) => void }) {
  const [role, setRole] = useState(grant.role);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    setRole(grant.role);
  }, [grant.role]);

  return (
    <li className="py-3 flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
      <div>
        <span className="font-600">{grant.name}</span>
        <span className="text-muted ml-2 text-sm">
          {grant.subjectType === 'team' ? 'team' : 'member'}
        </span>
      </div>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
        <label className="sr-only" htmlFor={`grant-role-${grant.id}`}>
          {orgCopy.role}
        </label>
        <select
          id={`grant-role-${grant.id}`}
          className="form-input w-auto"
          aria-label={orgCopy.role}
          value={role}
          onChange={(event) => setRole(event.target.value)}
        >
          {ROLE_OPTIONS.map((option) => (
            <option key={option} value={option}>
              {ROLE_LABEL[option]}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>
        <Button
          onClick={() => {
            setSaving(true);
            onSave(role);
            setSaving(false);
          }}
          disabled={saving}
        >
          {orgCopy.save}
        </Button>
      </div>
    </li>
  );
}

export default ManageAccessPage;

/**
 * SQLite access layer: connection, pragmas, migrations, transaction helper.
 * All business writes must go through `transact()` so a failed operation leaves
 * no partial state (requirements: writes are atomic).
 */
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import Database from 'better-sqlite3';
import { migrations } from './migrations.js';

/**
 * @param {string} dbPath file path, or ':memory:' for tests
 * @returns {import('better-sqlite3').Database}
 */
export function openDb(dbPath) {
  if (dbPath !== ':memory:') {
    fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(dbPath), { recursive: true });
  }
  const db = new Database(dbPath);
  db.pragma('journal_mode = WAL');
  db.pragma('foreign_keys = ON');
  db.pragma('busy_timeout = 5000');
  return db;
}

/** Apply every migration that has not been applied yet. Idempotent. */
export function migrate(db) {
  db.exec(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS schema_migrations (
    version INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    name    TEXT    NOT NULL,
    applied_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
  )`);
  const applied = new Set(db.prepare('SELECT version FROM schema_migrations').all().map((r) => r.version));
  for (const migration of migrations) {
    if (applied.has(migration.version)) continue;
    db.transaction(() => {
      db.exec(migration.sql);
      db.prepare('INSERT INTO schema_migrations (version, name) VALUES (?, ?)').run(migration.version, migration.name);
    })();
  }

[3] newText:   it('org Owner outranks grants; hierarchy never propagates; highest grant wins', () => {
    const db = createTestDb();
    const alice = createUser(db, { username: 'alice' });
    const bob = createUser(db, { username: 'bob' });
    const carol = createUser(db, { username: 'carol' });
    const dave = createUser(db, { username: 'dave' });
    const org = db
      .prepare("INSERT INTO organizations (name, display_name) VALUES ('o1', 'O1') RETURNING *")
      .get();
    db.prepare("INSERT INTO org_members (org_id, user_id, role) VALUES (?, ?, 'owner')").run(org.id, alice.id);
    const parent = db.prepare("INSERT INTO teams (org_id, name) VALUES (?, 'parent') RETURNING *").get(org.id);
    const child = db
      .prepare("INSERT INTO teams (org_id, name, parent_team_id) VALUES (?, 'child', ?) RETURNING *")
      .get(org.id, parent.id);
    const repo = db
      .prepare("INSERT INTO repos (owner_org_id, name, visibility) VALUES (?, 'r1', 'private') RETURNING *")
      .get(org.id);

    db.prepare("INSERT INTO repo_grants (repo_id, subject_team_id, role) VALUES (?, ?, 'maintain')").run(repo.id, parent.id);
    db.prepare("INSERT INTO repo_grants (repo_id, subject_team_id, role) VALUES (?, ?, 'triage')").run(repo.id, child.id);
    db.prepare("INSERT INTO repo_grants (repo_id, subject_user_id, role) VALUES (?, ?, 'read')").run(repo.id, carol.id);

    // Owner → admin regardless of grants.
    expect(effectiveRepoRole(db, alice, repo)).toBe('admin');
    // bob is a direct member of the child team only: the parent team's grant
    // never propagates down the hierarchy, so he gets the child's triage.
    db.prepare('INSERT INTO team_members (team_id, user_id) VALUES (?, ?)').run(child.id, bob.id);
    expect(effectiveRepoRole(db, bob, repo)).toBe('triage');
    // dave is a direct member of the parent team: he gets its maintain grant.
    db.prepare('INSERT INTO team_members (team_id, user_id) VALUES (?, ?)').run(parent.id, dave.id);
    expect(effectiveRepoRole(db, dave, repo)).toBe('maintain');
    // carol has only her direct read grant; team hierarchy gives her nothing.
    expect(effectiveRepoRole(db, carol, repo)).toBe('read');
    // The highest of direct + team grants wins for a user holding both.
    db.prepare("INSERT INTO repo_grants (repo_id, subject_user_id, role) VALUES (?, ?, 'write')").run(repo.id, bob.id);
    expect(effectiveRepoRole(db, bob, repo)).toBe('write');
  });

            <p className="m-0 mt-1">
              <span className="text-muted">{repoCopy.descriptionLabel}:</span> {current.description || '—'}
            </p>
            <p className="m-0 mt-1">
              <span className="text-muted">{repoCopy.visibility}:</span>{' '}
              {current.visibility === 'public' ? repoCopy.publicVisibility : repoCopy.privateVisibility}
            </p>
            <p className="m-0 mt-1">
              <span className="text-muted">{repoCopy.defaultBranch}:</span> {current.defaultBranch ?? '—'}
            </p>
          </div>

          <ErrorAlertList messages={general} />

          {isAdmin ? (
            <div className="mt-6 rounded-md border border-solid border-danger/50 p-3">
              <h3 className="m-0 text-base font-600 text-danger">Danger Zone</h3>
              <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
                <div>
                  <p className="m-0 font-600">Change repository visibility</p>
                  <p className="m-0 text-sm text-muted">
                    A public repository is visible to everyone; a private one stays restricted.
                  </p>
                </div>
                <Button variant="danger" onClick={openDialog}>
                  {repoCopy.changeVisibility}
                </Button>
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : null}
        </section>
      </div>

      <Dialog
        open={dialogOpen}
        onOpenChange={setDialogOpen}
        title={repoCopy.changeVisibility}
        description={`Choose the new visibility of ${current.owner}/${current.name}.`}
        footer={
          <>
            <Button onClick={() => setDialogOpen(false)}>Cancel</Button>
            <Button variant="primary" onClick={confirm} disabled={busy}>
              {repoCopy.confirmVisibility}
            </Button>
          </>
        }
      >
        <RadioGroup
          legend={repoCopy.visibility}
          name="next-visibility"
          value={nextVisibility}
          onChange={(value) => setNextVisibility(value as Visibility)}
          options={[
            { value: 'public', label: repoCopy.publicVisibility },
            { value: 'private', label: repoCopy.privateVisibility },
          ]}
        />
        <TextField
          label={repoCopy.repositoryName}
          help={repoCopy.confirmNameHelp}
          value={confirmation}
          error={confirmationError}
          onChange={(event) => setConfirmation(event.target.value)}
          autoComplete="off"
        />
      </Dialog>
    </div>
  );
}

/** True on the settings root and on "General" (both render this page). */
function isGeneral(pathname: string, settingsBase: string): boolean {
  return pathname === settingsBase || pathname === `${settingsBase}/general`;
}

export default RepoSettingsPage;
